games.title: Build and Crush
games.description: Build and Crush is a multiplayer game in which you can, you guessed it, build and crush stuff. Choose your own fun!
games.long_description: Build and Crush is a multiplayer game in which you can, you guessed it, build and crush stuff. Choose your own fun! How to Play Build and Crush Build Place blocks or animals to build something cool. There are normal blocks (bricks, granite, glass, wood, leaves, etc.) and color blocks. Each block can have multiple variations: column, stair, and triangle. Don't forget to save what you build. When you are happy with it, you can make your creation public with a single click on the "Make public" button. Crush This is where the fun begins. Select a random creation, and use the various weapons to blow everything up. Explode everything with TNT, shoot it with a cannon, trigger an earthquake, or put everything on fire! Pst, if you want a 1-click annihilation, use the atomic bomb ;) A real-time multiplayer mode will also be added soon, where you can compete against other players, defend from zombies, and do other cool stuff! Multiplayer: Work together with other players in various game modes. Release Date November 2019 Developer Ctrl4ltDel made Build and Crush. games.title: Getaway Shootout
games.description: Getaway Shooter is a chaotic two-player game where you race three others to the finish line. Your moves are limited, and you can only move by jumping left or right, making the race tricky!
games.long_description: Getaway Shooter is a chaotic two-player game where you race three others to the finish line. Your moves are limited, and you can only move by jumping left or right, making the race tricky! Pick up guns and other weapons along the way to use against the others. May the best player win! How to play Getaway Shootout You can only use the keys W and E to move your character: clicking them will orient the character towards either left (W) or right (E), while releasing them after a longer pressing will make it jump in the same direction. The concept of the game is that the four characters are escaping a dangerous situation, which might be a falling aeroplane, where you need to be the first to get to the parachute, but only the first one reaching the goal will be saved. So it’s fair to use all of the available resources to prevent the others from advancing, while keeping the focus on being fast and efficient in your moves. Easier said than done! Use the time trial as a training to practice the eight different available maps. Play solo or with a friend This 2-player game created double the fun when you team up with a friend using the same keyboard. Don't have a partner to play with? The game is available in one-player mode. Choose one of the characters at the beginning of the game and jump right in. Jump to move You will literally be "jumping" in the game. Gameplay dynamics are limited to left and right ragdoll-like jumps, making it difficult to race to the finish. You will soon see that jumping left or right creates quite a chaotic scene! The degree to which you move depends on how long you hold in either direction. Anything goes There are multiple rounds in the race, each taking place in a different location. Race to the finish line and pick up weapons and upgrades as you come across them. Use your weapons to attack the other racers on your way to the end! Character and weapons There are multiple characters to choose from, with over 30 options. Characters will be equipped with weapons such as sniper guns, shotguns, bombs, etc., to protect themselves from opponents and obstacles - you are, after all, on the lam! Features Goofy ‘jump to move’ mechanics Weapons and power-ups Multiple race locations Unlockable characters More Games Like This Check out our vast category for more 2 player games , or choose other top games on our platform, such as Geometry Dash or Snow Rider 3D . Release Date August 2018 Developer Getaway Shootout is made by New Eich Games, who also made other challenging physics-based games: Rooftop Snipers , House of Hazards , and Ping Pong Chaos . New Eich Games has stopped developing games in March 2025. Platforms Web browser iOS

games.title: Mr. Dude: Online Multiverse Challenge
games.description: Mr. Dude: Online Multiverse Challenge is a casual multiplayer game where pretty much anything can happen.
games.long_description: Mr. Dude: Online Multiverse Challenge is a casual multiplayer game where pretty much anything can happen. Play with other people from around the world, or with your friends in one of the many challenging yet wacky game modes. How to Play Mr. Dude: Online Multiverse Challenge You’ll need to wait in each game mode until enough other players are found to join you. You don’t directly interact with them, but you can get inspired by their moves. Choose your mode: Random Map Colored Floor (Disco Version) Dangerous Bridge Escape (From Hell!) Panic Room (Horror Movie Style) Disco Mode In Disco, a colorful floor awaits, but every few seconds, most of the colors disappear. If you are standing on a tile that is gone, the bouncers will fling you off the dance floor. Collect as many coins as possible while staying on the safe colors. Dangerous Bridge Mode Cross the bridge in various settings: a construction site, a rooftop, or an island with shark-infested waters below. One wrong move and it's game over. Make precise jumps and do not rush until you have built confidence. Hell Mode Start on a stone slab with molten lava flowing beneath you. Jump across other slabs while avoiding the lava unless you want to stay in hell for eternity. Horror Movie Mode This mode places you in a seemingly normal home, but it is anything but normal. You must find the key to escape. You have 10 seconds to search without anyone chasing you. If you take longer, a villain on a bicycle will start chasing you. If they catch you, it is game over. Interact with objects using the E key. Random This mode sends you to any one of the games above. This multiplayer game is perfect for playing with players worldwide or with friends and family. Want to play with friends? Access private rooms to keep the game among familiar faces. Tip You’ll receive a suitcase full of daily rewards. Spin the Wheel of Fortune to see what gift you get. Gifts can include coins, dynamite, shoes with a bit of extra pep, lifelines, and more. More Games Like This We have plenty more games with a similar vibe in our casual collection . Try some popular games like Little Alchemy (and its sequel Little Alchemy 2 ), Friday Night Funkin , Sprunki , and more.

games.long_description: Far Orion: New Worlds is an action game where you can command a team of brave heroes and lead your world to victory! The year is 2121, and technology has advanced far beyond the bounds of our wildest fantasies, but great progress also demands a great sacrifice. Use your strategy to set up your heroes and power card, beat all your opponents, and explore other worlds in search of treasure and limitless power! How to Play Far Orion: New Worlds In Far Orion: New Worlds, danger is everywhere, and Preston needs allies to survive. Skills are powered by energy, which refills over time, so you must time your moves wisely. The journey starts with Chapter 1: Woeful News, where you take your first steps into a world full of challenges. To use a skill, tap on a hero to pick a target. Positive skills help your allies, while negative ones hit your enemies. You’ll also choose defense weapons from the options at the bottom of the screen. Asteroids deal 25 damage to a target and 60 damage to a random enemy. Lightning stuns enemies for 0.8 seconds and deals 30 damage. Golden Armor boosts a hero’s armor by 7 for 10 seconds. You’ll soon meet Ellena, a curious and skilled archer impressed by your strange armor. She’ll offer to join your squad. Follow the hints to build a squad of heroes and a deck of battle cards. Complete missions to earn money for unlocking new heroes and upgrading your cards. Think about team strategy—pairing a healer with a tank can make a huge difference in battles. Pick power cards to supercharge your team, or go for basics to heal and deal damage. You’ll also earn gold from missions, daily quests, and fighting in the tower or arena. With dozens of heroes, unique battle cards, missions across multiple worlds, a PvP arena, a tough tower mode, and clan battles, there’s always something exciting to tackle. Build your team, power up, and see how far you can go in Far Orion! games.title: Battleship
games.description: Battleship is a classic two-player naval strategy game that you can play for free in your web browser. You are the commanding officer of an elite fleet of battleships at war with an equally capable enemy.
games.long_description: Battleship is a classic two-player naval strategy game that you can play for free in your web browser. You are the commanding officer of an elite fleet of battleships at war with an equally capable enemy. Take turns to fire on your opponent's territory using an array of ranged weaponry. How to Play Place your battleships The battle takes place on a grid divided into squares. Each player starts with the same fleet of ships. The ships in the fleet are different sizes. Place the battleships strategically around your side of the board in a way that will avoid enemy attacks. You can place the ships horizontally or vertically. Commence the battle You and the opposing player will take turns at guessing what squares are occupied by enemy naval units. Both players get three guesses each. If you guess a square correctly, the square you picked will show the word “hit”. Sink the enemy fleet Once you’ve guessed a square correctly, that’s one of their ships narrowed down. You can keep firing until their full ship is revealed in red, which means you’ve sunk it. The more squares you reveal, the easier it gets to find the rest of their ships. But be quick - it’s a race against your opponent! Level up and unlock new weapons Keep seeing those epic aquatic battles to the end to earn XP and level up your character. You will unlock new weapons that deal damage to a greater area as you progress. Tips Try to space your ships apart as much as possible - don’t group them all together in one place Think logically when picking squares. What ship sizes are remaining, and is it possible they would fit into the area you are attacking? Utilize your more powerful weapons as you level up More Games Like This Do you enjoy playing fun and strategic board games ? Other popular board games that will satisfy your strategic itch are Chess Online and Mahjong Solitaire. You might also love to play the family favorite Ludo King online with other players. Developer Battleship was made by Hasbro. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

Train this duckling to peak athletic form so you can earn money to rebuild the farm. While training, you’ll also find coins. Try to pick up as many as possible! Nourish Nourishment is essential for a duck of the athlete variety. You can buy the blue seed which gives your energy a huge boost and is 100% approved by the duck Olympic committee. There’s also regular grains for general feeding. Feed your duck these seeds to increase your energy score before competing in any races. Compete When you think your duck is ready for a real competition, you can enter various races to earn money. Here you get to sit back and watch your duck go! Races yield you plenty of coin and unlock new items in the shop. More Games Like This Check out the next game in the Duck Life series, Duck Life 2 . games.title: Cuphead
games.description: Cuphead is a sidescrolling action game developed by StudioMDHR. Play one of the biggest boss battles where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead.
games.long_description: Cuphead is a sidescrolling action game developed by StudioMDHR. Play one of the biggest boss battles where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead. Choose your desired difficulty level and jump into the dog fight. How to Play Difficulty and controls Start by choosing your difficulty level. There are four basic difficulties to choose. These are: Simple Regular Expert Invisible Challenge The fourth option, “invisible challenge” features invisible ammunition, making it harder to avoid attacks. Once you’ve selected your difficulty level, there are various control schemes to choose from to suit your playing style. Gameplay Fight an airborne battle on a side-scrolling level. The boss battle against Wally Warbles begins immediately when you start and ramps up through three phases. You have three lives, so do your best to avoid and repel his attacks while landing your own. After the frantic battle, Wally will pass away on a stretcher, ready to eat! Aviary Action This free web version of Cuphead is based on a boss battle from the original game. Aviary Action is an epic boss battle fought in three phases against a cuckoo-clock known as Wally Warbles. Each phase poses new challenges as Wally evolves into a new form with more challenging attacks. About Cuphead Cuphead is a sidescrolling action game released in 2017, where the player fights various bosses interspersed between run-and-gun battles. As you progress through the game, you acquire more power and abilities that can be equipped in limited number during battle. The game features an art style inspired by the golden era of American animation. This cartoonish aesthetic won Cuphead several awards for its unique and eye-catching appearance. If you like cartoon-style games, check out some other popular titles like Friday Night Funkin' and Square Bird . Features Play the Aviary Action boss battle from Cuphead Fight through the three phases to defeat Wally Warbles Select your difficulty level from 4 modes Play Cuphead for free on the web! games.title: House of Hazards
games.description: House of Hazards is a fun local multiplayer game where each player completes tasks around the house while avoiding hazards. How far will you get before one of your friends trips you up?
games.long_description: House of Hazards is a fun local multiplayer game where each player completes tasks around the house while avoiding hazards. How far will you get before one of your friends trips you up? How to Play House of Hazards Health and safety? There is none here. There are dodgy light fittings, misfiring taps, and flying toast slices trying to knock you down. This isn’t a fever dream. It’s the daily struggle for those living in the House of Hazards. Step up and see what menial household tasks you can achieve today. We recommend that new players start with the Time Trial mode, as it will help you familiarize with the game and its controls. Try to live your daily life Ultimately, your goal is to accomplish some tasks inside and around your house. These are simple things - making coffee, checking the mailbox, watering flowers. But, the other house members will be waiting - watching for you to walk into their trap before you can do it. Cause chaos for your housemates Regular play can accommodate up to 4 players: two use a keyboard and two use a Gamepad. But you can also play on your own with up to 3 AI-controlled opponents. You'll have to escape tricks done by other players to prevent you from completing the tasks assigned to you but also cause damage to the other players to try and win the game. If you’re in the position of causing hazards, there is plenty you can do to make your housemates' lives miserable. You can fire taps, toast, and lasers at them. Drop lights on their heads. You can even pick up their limp bodies off the floor and lock them in a chest! Available characters in House of Hazards You can use some regular-looking guys, 2 males and 2 females, to play this game. As you progress and accumulate experience, special characters will be unlocked for you. Dom Marissa Jerry Samantha Robo Rob (needs to be unlocked) Buster (needs to be unlocked) Rocking Grandma (needs to be unlocked) Super Sam (needs to be unlocked) More Games Like This There is a great range of local multiplayer games on CrazyGames. games.title: Dead Land: Survival
games.description: Dead Land: Survival is a survival horror game set in a zombie-infested apocalyptic world where you fight for survival with powerful skills you accumulate throughout gameplay. Fortify your shelter against relentless undead attacks and scavenge through desolate territories in search of valuable resources.
games.long_description: Dead Land: Survival is a survival horror game set in a zombie-infested apocalyptic world where you fight for survival with powerful skills you accumulate throughout gameplay. Fortify your shelter against relentless undead attacks and scavenge through desolate territories in search of valuable resources. Craft weapons, armor, and essential gear to give yourself an edge in these hostile lands. With danger around every corner, your aim is to keep calm and survive the end of the zombie apocalypse. How to Play Dead Land: Survival Set out on a treacherous quest through the desolate lands of Dead Land: Survival, where the world has fallen to ruin, and the infected ones lurk around every corner. Once-beautiful landscapes are now wastelands filled with relentless threats, stretching from the eerie remnants of your hometown, Nightstone, to the harsh quarantine zones. Each step into these dangerous territories demands courage as you fight tooth and nail to survive in an unforgiving, apocalyptic world. To stay alive, you must harvest resources from whatever nature has left behind. Gather essential materials from trees and other natural sources to upgrade your hero, repair broken vehicles, and restore key structures like your shelter and workshop. Loot is scattered throughout zombie-infested areas, and every scrap could be crucial to your survival. From metal to wood, each resource strengthens your chance of fighting back against the apocalypse. Combat is fierce as you face off against infected enemies with a range of weapons at your disposal. Craft melee weapons and guns, each designed for the brutal, turn-based struggles you’ll encounter. But survival takes more than brute force; you’ll need health packs and food to sustain your strength in prolonged battles. Weapons wear down over time, so be vigilant and repair them as needed, ensuring you're always ready for the next deadly encounter. Nightstone, your starting refuge in this bleak world, is home to fellow survivors who offer a glimmer of hope. Here, you’ll meet resilient characters who trade with you and assign quests that test your survival skills. You'll earn rewards as you complete these missions and unlock the chance to journey to other survivor outposts. Each quest brings you closer to understanding this dark world and forming alliances in a fight for humanity’s future. Engage in turn-based battles with zombies, craft powerful weapons and equipment, earn ratings to compete with clans, and complete a variety of quests in Dead Land: Survival. More Games Like This Dead Land: Survival is a game that can have you hooked for days. However, if you're looking for something new, you can browse more adventure games . Two other games in this category that will keep your attention for just as long include Battle Arena , a game where you collect powerful heroes and dominate real-time battles in this dynamic RPG; Magic World , an exciting Magical World, where battles with mythical creatures and epic clan wars will keep you on the edge of your seat. The only way to succeed is to strategically match at least three gems of the same color, aligning them horizontally or vertically, which will aim fire at your opponent in an attempt to defeat them. Matching gems that correspond to your heroes' elemental colors will unleash even stronger attacks, so try to match those as soon and as often as you can. Use touch/swipe controls on mobile or the left mouse button on the desktop to create your matches and plan your moves. The game offers a variety of modes to explore. Engage in thrilling PvP battles against players worldwide, join or form clans to exchange resources, share strategies, and hold friendly matches. Participate in cooperative clan raids to face off against powerful bosses like dragons, trolls, and goblins. Along the way, you'll tackle an exciting story campaign, advancing through hundreds of levels packed with challenges and adventures. Your journey combines strategic battles with the addictive fun of match-3 gameplay. games.title: Castle Craft
games.description: Castle Craft is a mystical adventure puzzle game where you merge resources while looking for Fiona's missing husband, Michael, all the while uncovering plenty of mysteries along the way. Begin in a fog-covered land, using ancient keys to explore hidden realms and trace the path of your lost family through different eras.
games.long_description: Castle Craft is a mystical adventure puzzle game where you merge resources while looking for Fiona's missing husband, Michael, all the while uncovering plenty of mysteries along the way. Begin in a fog-covered land, using ancient keys to explore hidden realms and trace the path of your lost family through different eras. Discover mysterious lands and piece together an enchanting legacy. How to Play Castle Craft Step into the wondrous world of Castle Craft, where you play as farmer Fiona, determined on her heartfelt mission to reunite with her husband after a mysterious separation. Your adventure begins in a simple garden, where you combine garden beds and plants to breathe new life into the land—this is the merge element of the game. As you cultivate your wheat fields, you will harvest crops to trade for mystical keys that dispel the fog, revealing hidden territories and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Fiona restores the land, her journey takes her toward new clues about her husband Michael’s whereabouts, such as his misplaced headphones, and she encounters friendly helpers along the way. Among them is Aiden, a kind woodsman who helps her clear obstacles like a stubborn tree stump. Together, Fiona and Aiden gather timber and merge logs to create essential tools and craft materials, unlocking treasure chests filled with valuable rewards to continue on her quest. Every decision you make shapes Fiona’s path, allowing her to rebuild and expand her world. What begins as a small garden evolves into a thriving medieval kingdom, complete with bustling marketplaces and grand castles. As you progress, the adventure deepens, introducing new lands teeming with hidden treasures, mysterious puzzles, and historical figures who assist in unraveling the mysteries of time and family. To embark on this journey, start by merging three wheat sprouts to cultivate a full wheat crop, then continue merging similar items to develop the garden further. Harvest the wheat to trade for keys that unlock new areas, dispelling the fog and revealing untapped potential. Treasure chests, once opened, offer unique items and heroes to aid Fiona in reclaiming and revitalizing the land. Each merge brings you closer to tracing your family’s footsteps through history and unraveling the secrets of the past. More Games Like This Browse our adventure category for more fun titles. games.title: Daily Room Escape
games.description: Daily Room Escape offers a brain-teasing puzzle adventure game where you are in a unique room filled with intricate riddles and hidden clues. Sharpen your problem-solving skills and unravel mind-bending puzzles to find the key to freedom.
games.long_description: Daily Room Escape offers a brain-teasing puzzle adventure game where you are in a unique room filled with intricate riddles and hidden clues. Sharpen your problem-solving skills and unravel mind-bending puzzles to find the key to freedom. Each day brings a new theme, a different set of challenges, and fresh surprises waiting to be discovered. Keep coming back for your daily dose of brain-teasing fun, and see if you have what it takes to outsmart each escape room. How to Play Daily Room Escape Daily Room Escape is an exciting puzzle game where your objective is to—well, escape! The only way to get out is by solving mini-mysteries throughout the room. Each clue leads to another clue. There are safes in the room that need to be opened, items that can be combined, items that needs inspecitng, locks that require codes—the mysteries are endless, until you crack the code and get out. Explore every corner of the room to uncover objects that will aid you on your path to freedom. With each step, keep your eyes peeled for items tucked away in surprising places, waiting to be picked up and used in clever ways. A simple book, an odd key, or a piece of paper could hold the secret to unlocking a tricky door or solving a cryptic puzzle. Look closely, as even the smallest detail could provide the breakthrough you need! In Daily Room Escape, no two days are alike, so don't get too confident on each new gameplay. Embark on an epic journey through this magical world, brimming with perilous encounters and thrilling adventures at every turn. Traverse through the looking glass into a realm of enigmatic puzzles and terrifying foes. Unravel the mysteries, aid mythical beings, vanquish villains, and safeguard the universe of Mirrorland. With stunning visuals, an immersive storyline, diverse hero selection, and engaging multiplayer features, prepare for an unforgettable quest where bravery and cunning are your greatest weapons. How to Play Mirrorland First things first. To play Mirrorland, you will need to create an online account and select your character (and sidekick). The adventure begins as you ride on horseback along a mysterious, winding path. Your first challenge awaits when the Cheshire Cat, a mischievous yet endearing creature, falls into a hole. Demonstrate your courage and compassion by rescuing him, and in return, he will pledge his unwavering loyalty, becoming your trusted companion and guide throughout the game (sidekick!). As you ride further into Mirrorland, the landscape comes alive with the promise of riches. Treasure chests brimming with rewards, glittering gold, and radiant crystals are scattered across your path, waiting to be claimed. Cheshire often spots these hidden troves, so listen to him so you won't miss an opportunity to increase your bounty. The road is far from quiet, and cries for help are common. You will need to respond to these pleas to form allies. Battle goblins to protect defenseless victims, shield the White Rabbit as he flees from ominous pursuers, and deliver urgent messages to reunite estranged brothers. Each act of bravery and kindness enriches your story, offering rewards that strengthen your resolve and resources. The gameplay is a captivating mix of strategy and direction. Carefully follow the prompts to guide your decisions and immerse yourself in the unfolding narrative. When combat arises, engage in intuitive battles by dragging and dropping attacks to strike down foes. Victory requires precision and skill as you navigate these skirmishes. Beyond the thrill of battle, gather gold, hoard crystals, and complete quests to uncover the deeper layers of Mirrorland’s magic. With every step, your character evolves, and the enchanting world around you reveals its secrets. More Games Like This The adventure doesn’t have to stop here. Continue playing adventure games . How to Play Line up your shots carefully, and fire! Starting with the basic arrows and baseline stats, you will be faced with various enemies. Some of these enemies are trickier than others to beat due to armor, position, and other factors. Occasionally, you will encounter a giant enemy. This is like a mini-boss level, and you will earn lots of skulls for defeating them. Survive for as long as possible Your goal is to survive for as long as possible and earn as many skulls as you can. The best way to survive for a long time is to keep hitting the apples. Throughout the game you will notice flying apples. Shoot your arrow through the apples to replenish your health, stamina, or both. Here’s how the apples work: Red apple = health Green apple = stamina Golden apple = health and stamina Customize your ammunition There is an ever-increasing range of arrows to unlock the more you play the game. It’s best to keep playing and switching the arrow types to learn which ones are more powerful and suit your playing style. There is everything from electric and poison to balloon and axe and you can increase your arrow slots to hold more of them at once. Use your skulls to upgrade your abilities You earn skulls by killing enemies, which rewards a specific amount based on the power of the foe you defeated. You can upgrade your health, stamina, damage, and more using this currency. More Games Like This Ragdoll Archers is one of many games featuring ragdoll physics . games.long_description: Arkadium's Bubble Shooter is an exciting casual bubble shooter game. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them and increase your score. Let's get popping! Building up on the success of Taito’s Puzzle Bobble, which became known in the Western world as Bust a Move, Arkadium’s Bubble Shooter represents an exciting twist in this peculiar genre. This version differs from those that inspired it mainly because there are no time constraints: you can carefully plan your move using all the time in this world, because your only limit is the number of moves you avail of. How to Play Arkadium's Bubble Shooter The objective of the game is to shoot your way through the levels by matching three or more bubbles with the same color. Think carefully about where you shoot and consider what color is coming next by looking below the bubble loaded. If this secondary bubble works better, you can switch to it. Choose your moves wisely The challenge is to complete each level within the moves limit. The fewer moves it takes you to complete a level, the more moves you get for the next stage. If you use all your moves, the game ends, and you're back at level 1 to try again! Tackle each unique level Every level in Arkadium's Bubble Shooter has a unique design and layout. There are conventional bubbles, but also rocks, ice balls, bombs, and other bubble types to help or hinder your progress. These unique bubbles, combined with the moves limit, add an element of problem-solving to the game. Additional novelties brought by this version of the bubble shooting classic are obstacle bubbles: Stone Bubbles cannot be popped but can only be cleared by removing the bubbles they are attached to. Ice Bubbles are frozen ones and need to be thawed before they can be popped. Once you thaw them, their color is revealed, and you can treat them as ordinary bubbles. Arkadium’s version introduces a few power-ups you can use too: Lighting bubbles, once cleared, will get rid of the whole row they are placed onto Bomb bubbles will explode when impacted, clearing a circular area around them Rainbow bubbles are wild cards; they can match any color that touches them More Games Like This Check out the classic Bubble Shooter for another free online bubble shooting game! Geometry Dash will instead give you a buzz, as you avoid obstacles on your route while moving your shape rhythmically. Features Fun, satisfying, bubble-popping gameplay! games.title: Geometry Game
games.description: Geometry Game is a free side-scrolling platformer played in sync with musical rhythms. Groove your way over and under obstacles to keep the musical momentum alive.
games.long_description: Geometry Game is a free side-scrolling platformer played in sync with musical rhythms . Groove your way over and under obstacles to keep the musical momentum alive. If you slip up, it’s back to the beginning! Inspired by the original Geometry Dash, this is a Scratch version, bringing the classic rhythm-based gameplay to your browser. "This game became our family obsession during lockdown, but we have recently returned to play it. Combining simple controls and a high level of challenge makes for a fun experience we can all enjoy. Because the play is in time with the music, it’s also a good way to develop children’s sense of timing and musicality. Sometimes we’ve even played it once the kids are in bed, to see if we can improve our skills for the next family session." Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play Geometry Game Geometry Dash is a 2D platformer game where you are in charge of moving a shape through a bunch of obstacles, all to the beat of the music. The square actually moves by itself, and all you have to do is click to jump when necessary and use the up/down arrows to steer vehicles. The way you dodge obstacles is often in sync with the beat, so make sure your sound is on and enjoy the experience! The key to the game is timing. The levels themselves scroll automatically, and hitting spikes, walls, or other hazards results in an instant crash and restart. If you fail, it's back to the beginning. The constant die-and-retry loop will have you quickly memorizing the patterns of each level and, more importantly, the precise timing of crucial jumps. This dynamic is what makes the game addictive. Listen to the beat Geometry Game is a music game, and many jumps and movements are synced to the beat of the background music, so paying attention to the rhythm is not really an option. Practice Mode lets you place checkpoints to learn tricky sections without starting over, so it's a good place to start or go back to if you're having trouble completing levels. Watch the obstacles Levels also feature unique objects like portals, pads, and orbs. Portals can flip gravity, change speed, or switch vehicle modes. Jump pads automatically launch you, and orbs trigger special actions mid-air. These elements replace traditional power-ups, creating dynamic challenges that keep each level pretty much unpredictable. Tips & Tricks Practice Mode. Use Practice Mode to break a level into smaller sections. Place checkpoints at tricky spots and repeat until you can clear each segment consistently. This builds muscle memory and makes full runs much easier. Follow the Rhythm. The game’s music often cues obstacle timing. Pay attention to beats and sync your jumps to the song. You can try humming the beat to get the rhythm down. Geometry Game Reviews The game has received positive reviews from critics. Softpedia praised the game's style, saying, "While it can get a bit frustrating sometimes, you can always complete the stages using the practice mode and then jump into the many different user-generated levels." Geometry Game History Geometry Dash started without a clear vision, according to the developer RobTop. It could have moved in any direction. It started as a template with a cube that could crash and jump, and evolved into the smash-hit game it is today. When the game was first launched, it was called Geometry Jump and only had seven levels. Later on, it was renamed "Geometry Dash." Currently, there are four free versions of the game, one being "Geometry Dash Lite," which now includes the first 13 levels from the full version. Features Challenging levels that vary in difficulty from hard to almost impossible Simple controls make the game intuitive to learn from the start Excellent music that compels you to reach the next part of the track Fun gameplay synced to the beat! More Geometry Games If you like playing Geometry Dash for free in your web browser, check out Geometry Dash Subzero. More Games Like This For more games played in time with musical rhythms, check out FNF , a popular freestyle music game. If you want to have a bit of silly fun, Blob Opera will provide plenty of entertainment! Other music-centric games to try include Friday Night Funkin', where you rap battle it out with other musically inclined players. And for more musical rhythm games, Sprunki will hit the spot, as you'll get to create your own vibrant sounds and melodies. Platforms Geometry Dash is available across all platforms: web, Android, iOS, and Windows phones. Developer The game was created by RobTop Games for mobile, before being ported to PC as Geometry Game. This Scratch version is made by Griffpatch.

games.long_description: Getting Over It is a challenging casual arcade climbing game that puts your patience—and skill—to the ultimate test. Armed with only a hammer, you’ll tackle a steep, obstacle-laden mountain, relying on precise physics to swing, push, and propel yourself upward. Every inch you gain will make you sweat but will be well worth it, and one small mistake can send you tumbling back to the start. How to Play Getting Over It Getting Over It is a physics-inspired game where you need to climb over a series of obstacles with careful precision in the movement of your mouse. You get over obstacles using a hammer that balances your character's weight on the head of a hammer. Precision and patience are key, as the path is filled with tricky spots that demand careful maneuvering. Keep a cool head, and if you find yourself slipping back, don’t lose hope; it’s all part of the challenge. You’ll need to try and try again, building your skills and resilience with each attempt. Effective hammer use is essential to progress. With every swing, you’ll carefully leverage yourself over obstacles, pulling yourself upward, inch by inch. The mechanics may seem simple, but mastering them takes practice. Each movement requires finesse and control, so take it slow and stay focused—one wrong move could undo all your hard work. Take your time—trying to move too quickly can easily send you hurtling back to where you started! This fan-made version of Getting Over It delivers the same intense challenge as the original but with a lighthearted twist. Instead of navigating the surreal landscape as the infamous man in a pot, you play as an adorable cat planted in a flower pot, scaling a world of vibrant blocks and oversized fruit. The playful visuals add a fun, fresh spin to the gameplay, creating a setting that’s as charming as it is challenging. But don’t let the cute exterior fool you—this game is just as punishing as the original! Every fall, every slip, every unexpected tumble reminds you that success won’t come easily. The satisfaction of conquering each section of this colorful world is hard-earned, demanding patience, skill, and maybe a bit of luck. It’s an experience that will test your determination and keep you coming back for one more attempt. Each level presents a new challenge that requires patience, logic, and careful planning to succeed. Be vigilant! The number of additional holes is limited, so you'll need to think a few steps ahead before making a move. Every action counts, and rushing in without a plan could leave you stuck! Once all the bolts are sorted correctly, you’ll complete the level and move on to even trickier puzzles. Can you master every challenge and become the ultimate bolt-sorting expert? How to Play Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts Your main goal in Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is to fill all the screw containers at the top but be careful: if the extra (unmatched) screw slots fill up completely, you’ll lose the round. At the top of the screen, you have a set of empty screw holders, each with a specific color. Below, you'll see various shapes secured by colored screws. Your task is to unscrew each shape strategically, so that when all its screws are removed, the shape falls away. The trick? Only unscrew screws that match the colors of the empty slots above. Any screw without a matching color gets tossed into your limited "extra" container space. If that space fills up, and you try to unscrew more with no room left, it’s game over. Key Rules: Always have a place to put your screws. Match screw colors to top containers whenever possible. Once a container is fully filled, it refreshes with a new color, giving you more room to play, so try to fill them quickly. Special Tools & Power-Ups: Magnet – Instantly fills one container (1,500 points) Drill – Adds one additional hole (1,200 points) Hammer – Breaks and removes an entire shape (1,800 points) Skip Level – Skip to the next level (3,000 points) This game is a true brain teaser that tests your logic, timing, and strategy. games.title: Wood Block Journey
games.description: Wood Block Journey is a puzzle, tetris-style game fused with the essence of Sudoku. Clear rows, columns, and squares and keep trying to beat your highest score.
games.long_description: Wood Block Journey is a puzzle, tetris-style game fused with the essence of Sudoku. Clear rows, columns, and squares and keep trying to beat your highest score. Complete unique missions in Journey mode. Enjoy familiar graphics, soothing sounds, and stress-free gameplay. Solve 60+ engaging puzzles with realistic wood tiles. It's a free, no-registration gaming delight. How to Play Wood Block Journey Wood Block Journey is a Tetris-inspired puzzle game where the goal is to clear the board by forming lines using various wooden shapes made up of tiles in different configurations. To clear a row, you need to align shapes like a 4-tile row, T-shaped, L-shaped, or a single tile. When you fill a row, it disappears. Each round of Wood Block Journey starts with a target score, with the progress bar at the top of the screen that tracks how close you are to reaching that score. If you place shapes on the board in the right positions, the more likely you are to clear whole lines or entire 3x3 blocks. Once you hit the target and you pass the round, you unlock the next level on the Journey map. Your current score sits on the left side of the board, with your best score displayed just below it, so you always know how well (or not well) you’re doing. Journey mode lays out its levels on a numbered map, and you work through them in order, with completed levels marked off as you go. You have a set of hearts that act as your lives, so if you fail a round, you will lose a life and the counter at the top of the map shows how many you have left. If a round slips away from you, the game offers a Second Chance before it's over. There is a timer that counts down and if you really don’t want to lose your progress, you can watch an ad and keep your current score or tap ‘No, thanks’ and end the round to start all over again. If you want to see how you’re doing compared to other players, the leaderboards button on the Journey screen pulls up a ranked list of scores. You can find your position at the bottom. It's a nice extra push to keep clearing lines and climbing. games.description: 2048 is a single-player sliding tile puzzle game developed by Gabriele Cirulli. Merge tiles with the same power of 2 to get the total sum.
games.long_description: 2048 is a single-player sliding tile puzzle game developed by Gabriele Cirulli. Merge tiles with the same power of 2 to get the total sum. The goal is to keep merging tiles this way until you reach 2048! My kids enjoy the simple challenge of merging the numbers to clear space and stay alive. It’s great to see them figure out strategies to merge bigger and bigger numbers efficiently. They don’t realize it, but they are learning to make quick additions. There’s also a lot of geographical thinking ahead to avoid making a move that gets you stuck. Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play 2048 The game begins on a simple 4x4 grid, with two numbered tiles appearing at random spots. Each tile is either a 2 or a 4. You will need to slide these tiles around the board and merge matching numbers until you eventually create the ultimate 2048 tile. It's not easy at first, but once you discover the patterns and better understand the rules of the game, you will find a solid rhythm you can keep going back to. Moves are easy to make. All you need to do is swipe or press the arrow keys to slide the tiles in one direction or another. Note that every move you make shifts the entire board; this means that all tiles travel until they hit either the wall or another tile. If two tiles of the same number collide, they merge into a single tile with double the value. For example, a 2 and a 2 combine to form a 4, two 4s become an 8, and so on. After each move, a new tile, again a 2 or a 4, appears on the board, slowly filling up the empty spaces. Use your arrow keys to move all the tiles in the specified direction. Note that every time you move, another two are spawned into the game. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one, doubling the value. Consider your movements and avoid sliding tiles around haphazardly. Strategy is key in this game. The board keeps filling up each time you move! If the board fills all the way without you reaching 2048, it's game over. The challenge is pretty much keeping the board from filling up completely. If there are no more moves left (no empty spaces and no adjacent matches), the game is over. The further you go, the more challenging it becomes to manage the board, as high-value tiles start to crowd out smaller numbers you still need for merging. Keep your higher-value tiles tucked away in one corner, build around them, and resist the temptation of false merges. Think a few steps ahead: merging a pair might look good now, but it could also block future moves. What is 2048? 2048 is an open-source puzzle game with math elements where players slide numerical tiles around a grid to create larger numbers. The game took the world by storm in March 2014 when it was released, surprising the developer who had made it in just a weekend. Thanks to the open-source project, many variations have been created and distributed since then. The 2048 game on this page is the original, but you can find more versions below. History of 2048 When 2048 first made its way onto the game scene, it may have seemed familiar to some players. The game drew its inspiration from Threes , an iOS game released around the same time. According to a post in The Guardian, Gabriele Cirulli, the creator of 2048, openly acknowledged the similarity, stating, "Threes is the reason 2048 exists". The clones soon started pouring in, but 2048's gameplay seemed to have created a loyal following, leaving its imitators in its wake. Tips & Tricks Focus on the edge of the grid. You want the highest number in a lovely corner for easy access. Keep making the larger numbers around that corner so you can combine them when they match. If you end up with the higher numbers towards the middle, you can quickly get lost with inaccessible numbers, and eventually, you will have to start a new game. More Games Like This If you’re a fan of puzzle games and enjoy a good brain workout, you’re in luck! Try Word Wipe , where you frantically clear words before time runs out, or Word Search , where you look for words in a sea of scrambled letters. For a different twist, 10x10 will have you scratching your head as you fit pieces like a puzzled Tetris master. And if you love word games, Word Scramble will have you rearranging letters so much that you’ll start dreaming in anagrams. Dive into these brain teasers and prepare for some serious fun! Other versions of 2048 Check out our 2048 games for more versions of this web classic! You can play a unique version of 2048 online in Cubes 2048.io , or play the delicious sushi variation of the original in Sushi Drop . Developer Gabriele Cirulli created 2048. It is based on 1024 by Veewo Studio and is conceptually similar to Threes by Asher Vollmer. games.title: Little Alchemy 2
games.description: Little Alchemy 2 is an intuitive online crafting game developed by Recloak. The aim is to combine elements to create new ones.
games.long_description: Little Alchemy 2 is an intuitive online crafting game developed by Recloak. The aim is to combine elements to create new ones. Start by mixing Earth, air, fire, and water to produce new elements. Discover over 720 items and unlock the recipes to time, matter, and the Universe! How to Play Little Alchemy 2 Little Alchemy 2 is a creative merge game where you mix and match elements to discover new, unique ones. You start with air, earth, fire, and water, then drag and drop them together to see what they produce. You can easily create simple things like mud or more complex things like humans! Every time you create something new, it becomes part of your roster of items, so you can get more and more complex. Some creations are fairly simple, but others are a bit more complicated to uncover... like zombies! Gameplay is simple. All you have to do is drag the items you want to combine from the menu on the right into the middle screen. Then, drag one object onto the other to try to combine them both. Voila! You've just become an alchemist. Remember your combinations A valid combination rewards you with new items and provides the merge in your roster of elements. You can use the encyclopedia to track your progress and read about the items you've discovered. Clean your canvas Being an alchemist will start to get messy, so thankfully, there's also a "clean up" button located in the top left to clear your canvas. The search feature in the top right is also handy when you're losing track of your creations! The sky's the limit The game has no levels, time limits, or penalties, so it’s a relaxed, open-ended experience that encourages trial and error. Humorous captions accompany each new find, adding charm while rewarding curiosity and logical thinking. With over 720 elements to uncover and optional hints when stuck, the goal is simply to keep experimenting until you’ve built an entire world from scratch. Combine the elements Alchemy Combinations Recloak is constantly updating Little Alchemy 2 with new items to craft. There are currently over 720 items. Some combinations will be more evident than others, and there are often more ways than one to create a new item. Some combinations rely on logic and others require more creative, out-of-the-box thinking. Here are some basic creations so you understand how Little Alchemy 2 works: Fire + Mist = Air Earth + Air = Dust Earth + Fire = Lava Earth + Lava = Volcano Fire + Stone = Metal These are all logical combinations. However, some combos don't seem as obvious, like water + horse creating a hippo. Sometimes you have to think outside the box and mix elements you wouldn't expect to create something. Easter Eggs The game hides fun cultural references. Dog + Internet = Doge Ring + Volcano = The One Ring Turtle + Ninja = Ninja Turtle Cat + Music = Keyboard Cat Little Alchemy Tips Click the 'hints' button in-game to get Little Alchemy tips Check out the Fandom page for more in-depth knowledge Combine elements creatively - some combos make more sense than others! Little Alchemy vs Little Alchemy 2 Little Alchemy was released in June 2016, and its sequel followed in August 2017. Both games share the same core concept of sandbox-style experimentation. You begin with four basic elements: earth, fire, air, and water. By combining them, you discover new ones. Although the foundation is the same, the sequel introduces enough changes to create a fresh experience. Little Alchemy 2 offers a brighter, more colorful design with subtle animations that give it a more playful atmosphere. It also expands the number of possible discoveries, with 720 elements compared to the original’s 589. The sequel also introduces special content such as the Myths and Monsters pack, which adds imaginative new items and makes experimentation even more engaging. Tips & Tricks Mix Everything with New Items. Each time you unlock a new element, try combining it with everything you already have. You're bound to find a new, unexpected element. Think in Categories. Items often combine logically across or within categories (ex., plant + tool = garden, fish + blade = sushi). Prioritize Key Elements. Some elements unlock dozens of recipes. Tier 1 elements and recipes Earth + Air = Dust Fire + Fire = Energy Soil + Soil = Land Earth + Fire = Lava Air + Water = Mist Water + Earth = Mud Air + Air = Pressure Water + Water = Puddle Fire + Wood = Smoke Water + Heat = Steam Tier 2 elements and recipes Mud + Fire = Brick Land + Big = Continent Earth + Motion = Earthquake Pressure + Lava = Eruption Steam + Earth = Geyser Pressure + Stone = Granite Charcoal + Mineral = Gunpowder Fire + Science = Heat Lava + Water = Obsidian Puddle + Puddle = Pond Earth + Pressure = Stone Lava + Earth = Volcano Motion + Air = Wind Tier 3 elements and recipes House + Fireplace = Chimney Mud + Sand = Clay Fire + Gunpowder = Explosion Pond + Water = Lake Stone + Fire = Metal Big + Hill = Mountain Continent + Continent = Planet Science + Star = Plasma Stone + Air = Sand Storm + Storm = Tornado Brick + Brick = Wall Heat + Air = Warmth There are 15 tiers of elements and combinations. To get the full list, refer to the fandom page. More Games Like This If you enjoy combining materials and mixing ingredients, check out our science and logic games for more challenging titles to occupy your intellect. You may also want to explore our casual category with classic games like Bubble Shooter , something a bit more challenging like Eggy Car , or something a bit more whimsical like Friday Night Funkin' . All great choices for the next play. Check out the original Little Alchemy , for more creative challenges! games.title: Word Scramble
games.description: Word Scramble is a classic word game where you unscramble letters to find words. Find one word after the next and see how many you can find before the timer runs out!
games.long_description: Word Scramble is a classic word game where you unscramble letters to find words. Find one word after the next and see how many you can find before the timer runs out! How to Play Word Scramble The gameplay in Word Scramble is relatively easy. All you need to do is click and drag letters from a series of tiles to rearrange them into a word. You may spot the word immediately and move the tiles to suit. Or you may need a bit more help to make sense of the tiles, in which case, you can choose to move the letters around until something "clicks" and you spot a word, or if you are really stumped, click the hint button and get the definition of the word - there isn't a better hint than that! Once you know the word, move the letters to form a valid word, and then click submit. The main caveat is the timer. You must form the word before the timer runs out; otherwise, the game will end, and you will have to start over again! The words vary from easy to difficult, and the game gets trickier over time. Use your problem-solving skills to determine as many as possible and get your highest score yet! Hints in Word Scramble Word Scramble can get a bit tricky, and there ain't no shame in using the hint - it is actually quite a useful piece of info. If you get stuck, you can request a hint that will help you by providing the meaning of the word in question. There is no limit to using hints, but it's always good to save hints as a last resort. Some examples of hints include: Hint: A device used to produce music. Word: Instrument Hint: A substance used to polish. Word: Polish Hint: Conversation or debate concerning a particular topic. Word: Discussion Hint: A place where items may be stored. Word: Store Hint: A device pulled through the ground to break it open into the furrows for planting. Word: Plough Hint: A container typically made of glass with a tapered neck is used for holding liquids. Word: Bottle Hint: (Uncountable) Water in frozen (solid) form. Word: Ice Hint: (Anatomy) The caudal appendage of an animal that is attached to its posterior near the anus. Word: Tail More Games Like This If you enjoy solving word puzzles, there are plenty more games like this in our word game or casual game category . Popular games you are sure to like include Word Wipe , Word Search , and Google Feud . games.description: Candy Riddles is a puzzle match-3 puzzle game bursting with tasty-looking, mouth-watering sweets! Prepare for a world of sugary fun as you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels.
games.long_description: Candy Riddles is a puzzle match-3 puzzle game bursting with tasty-looking, mouth-watering sweets! Prepare for a world of sugary fun as you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels. With each successful match of three or more treats, you'll clear the board and make way for even more delicious combinations. The more matches you make, the bigger your rewards, so keep matching and savor the sweet satisfaction of getting to the next level! How to Play Candy Riddles Candy Riddles Gameplay Candy Riddles is similar to Candy Crush but with its own unique style of gameplay. Match three or more candies to eliminate the row and unlock new candies that give you special abilities. Each level comes with a unique design that makes you think differently. Candy Riddles Levels As you move through the levels as a candy-matching machine, you'll unlock new items and challenges that keep the gameplay fresh. These can be collectible elements like honey or special sweets for matching longer chains of candy. For example, in level 3, matching five sweets will give you a rainbow cake! This eliminates all of the matched colors, creating a tasty avalanche of treats. There's much more to discover at each level, so give the game a try! More Games Like This Match-three puzzle games originated from popular tile-matching games like Tetris. The first match-three game was Shariki, released in 1994. Today, they have been hugely popularized by the likes of the Candy Crush Saga. Check out more popular merge and match-3 games like Little Alchemy . Explore our puzzle games for even more fun. games.description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items.
games.long_description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items. Whether completing quests or exploring the lush landscape, every match brings you closer to transforming your island into a perfect tropical haven. With hundreds of objects to discover and merge, the possibilities are endless—start building your dream island today! How to Play Tropical Merge Tropical Merge features various exotic objects that you can combine with other items in groups of 3 or more. Merging these three ingredients creates an entirely new object. That object, too, can be combined with two others to produce further upgrades. Each upgrade becomes more valuable as you continue to build your tropical paradise! Merging more than three items at a time will deliver a bigger number of items. Plan your merging moves strategically by trying to merge multiple objects at the same time to speed up your progression. Get rid of the weeds, earn amulets and level up to unlock more areas and expand your island. The more areas you open, the more freedom you have to merge and build until you’ve created the perfect utopian island society. As you progress, you'll unlock new characters that will help Lisa with her job. Keep an eye out for rarities and unlockable items scattered around the map. Complete quests Merging and discovering new items is a ton of fun, and many are part of quests that will reward you for building new items. There are so many quests to keep you hooked and daily quests to keep you coming back for a fresh challenge! How to Play Basic Solitaire rules The rules of Solitaire are simple, but it can be a tricky game to master. The objective is to successfully remove all the cards from the playing field by placing them in number order by their respective suit. Move the visible cards around to create a complete set in order from King to Ace. The cards must be placed in the same suit, in numerical order. If you cannot move any card, you need to click the pile of cards that is face down to add a new card to each row. If you are stuck, you can always use the reset button to start from scratch! Can you master Spider Solitaire 2 Suits? Spider Solitaire rules Unlike basic Solitaire, Spider Solitaire is trickier. It features two decks of cards and 10 rows. Playing with only two suits ramps up the difficulty even further. Other than these limitations, the rules are the same as regular Solitaire. You must stack cards of the same suit in descending order on the tableau. You’ll win the game when all the cards have been put in order. About this game This simple Spider Solitaire 2 Suits game features a clean, retro interface. There are no hints, so you should be experienced at playing Spider Solitaire before jumping into this one. games.long_description: Golf Solitaire is a fun and challenging solo card game. Clear all the cards by placing them in order and returning them to the pile until none are remaining. This game uses a regular 52-card deck, but the rules differ from regular Solitaire. How to Play Golf Solitaire The objective of Golf Solitaire is to get all cards from the seven columns into the single face-up pile at the bottom. Cards can be moved to this pile if they are one number higher or lower than the top card. When there are no cards to play, you can flip a card from the face-down pile until you get one that can be played. How do I win? You win the game when you successfully move all the cards from the seven columns into your face-up pile. The game is lost when you get stuck with no more cards left to play. However, there are hints and a "card steal" button for when you're stuck. Steal takes a card from one of the columns at random, regardless of what it is. The hint button will show you the best move when there are moves available. More Solitaire Games Solo card games are a popular way to pass the time and stimulate the mind when at home. games.title: Sandtrix
games.description: Sandtrix is a Tetris game with a twist—the pieces transform into sand when they touch down. The objective is to align blocks of the same color until they form one continuous color from left to right.
games.long_description: Sandtrix is a Tetris game with a twist—the pieces transform into sand when they touch down. The objective is to align blocks of the same color until they form one continuous color from left to right. When you make a horizontal line of color, the pixels disappear, and you earn points. How to Play Game modes There are three game modes to enjoy in Sandtrix. The first is the classic endless mode . In this mode, you clear sand endlessly until the inevitable filling of the game area. As time progresses, the speed increases. Once the blocks reach the top, it’s game over. The other game modes follow similar rules but have fundamental differences. In the high-score game mode , the objective is to get the highest possible score within 3 minutes. Other than that, the rules are the same. In clear 40 it is precisely as the name suggests—clear 40 rows. There is no time limit in this mode. Just make sure you don’t fail! You get one point for a pixel cleared in any game mode. If you clear a row again before the meter runs out, you can reach combos up to 10x. Difficulty There are three difficulty levels in Sandtrix. In easy mode, you have the whole game space to place your blocks, and the speed is normal. However, the medium and hard difficulties ramp up the speed and limit the available play space. Hard mode is particularly challenging. We strongly recommend staying on the first difficulty setting for a while before attempting the others. About Sandtrix Sandtrix is also known as Sandtris, Setris, and Sand Tetris, among other names. In part, it’s due to the game going viral under various names on TikTok and other social platforms. It might seem to defeat the purpose of Tetris for the pieces to turn into sand, but the more you play, the more you realize the smaller details about how each shapes land, and learn to maximize each piece more effectively. games.description: BlockBuster Puzzle is a Tetris-like game where you match colorful blocks so they disappear from the game screen. Unlock new realms and challenges as you progress, enjoying vibrant graphics and immersive gameplay.
games.long_description: BlockBuster Puzzle is a Tetris-like game where you match colorful blocks so they disappear from the game screen. Unlock new realms and challenges as you progress, enjoying vibrant graphics and immersive gameplay. Prove your skills as a true puzzle master with every level you advance. How to Play BlockBuster Puzzle There are a few tutorials throughout the game to help guide you with controls and strategy, but this may not be necessary as the game is fairly straightforward. You get a series of blocks in various geometric shapes placed on the side of the game screen. Click on the one you want to move and carry it to the game board. Each geometric shape may or may not fit together on the main game board - this is where your strategic eye comes in. Place each geometric shape on the board in a position to get one full line of gapless blocks. When you do this, that entire line will disappear. Various rounds will allow you to collect more points, as some blocks are bedazzled with jewels worth more. You may have prompted a few moves, like clearing the board or undoing your last move. Take the suggestion, as it usually gets you out of a jam. Score points by performing combos, which happen when you clear more than one line with one move, and set your high score that you can use to benchmark your game the next time you try this puzzle. games.long_description: Creepy Granny Scream Scary Freddy is an intense and scary action horror game in which you must try to escape the evil killer lurking in the building. You have somehow become locked in a creepy house - you are not alone! A killer is lurking, and he wants to find you as you have disturbed his peaceful night! How to Play Creepy Granny Scream: Scary Freddy In Creepy Granny Scream: Scary Freddy, your mission is to escape from a terrifying house with five nights to do so. Each night ends when you are caught, so use your nights wisely. As you navigate the eerie environment, you’ll need to carefully observe your surroundings and solve challenging puzzles to find your way out. The 3D graphics add to the intensity, and the game can, at times, get pretty scary. Can you outsmart Freddy and escape before time runs out? You find yourself trapped in an old, creepy house without memory of how you got there. You’re not alone, and the eerie presence of Freddy looms over you as you desperately seek a way out. The tools and clues you need to escape are hidden throughout the house, but escaping won’t be easy. Stay quiet, hide whenever you can, crouch, hide, and most of all, be cautious of Freddy’s every move. This game offers a thrilling 3D horror experience with a tense atmosphere and multiple gameplay options. Choose between two modes: normal, which presents a standard environment, and dark, where ghostly apparitions make the experience even more frightening, not for the faint of heart. With four difficulty levels to choose from and a variety of puzzles to solve, you’ll need to rely on stealth and quick thinking to survive. Will you escape Freddy's clutches, or will the house become your final resting place? Remember, you only have five days to break free—so make each moment count. games.title: Bolts and Nuts
games.description: Bolts and Nuts is a simple and fun puzzle game in which you test your logic and strategic thinking by solving unique puzzles, all with a ticking timer breathing down your neck.How to Play Bolts and NutsThe game is a classic puzzle game where you aim to strategically remove bolts so that the panels they are holding up all fall off the game screen.
games.long_description: Bolts and Nuts is a simple and fun puzzle game in which you test your logic and strategic thinking by solving unique puzzles, all with a ticking timer breathing down your neck. How to Play Bolts and Nuts The game is a classic puzzle game where you aim to strategically remove bolts so that the panels they are holding up all fall off the game screen. Once you remove a bolt, you need to add it to a free hole. The only obstacle is that there is a limited number of free holes, and some inadvertently get covered by the panels you freed up. This means you need to think a few steps ahead before acting fast. As you advance in levels, the task becomes more complicated, and you need to discern how best to beat the clock. There are over a hundred levels in the game, which become increasingly more complex. No need to worry; the levels may get more complex over time, but you also accumulate more points, which you can use to buy help, such as screwdrivers to remove bolts for which there is no room, or time freezers. This is one of those games where finishing a level brings satisfaction, but then you quickly want to move on to the next round and test your skill once again. It is an addictive game of logic, risk, and quick thinking. Bolts and Nuts is a feel-good game suitable for children, but it also provides adults with the opportunity to challenge their problem-solving skills. Beat the clock Each level has a countdown timer, and when it runs down, you will lose the progress made on that level, but you will be able to start the level over, so use what you’ve learned and don’t get trapped in the same time constraints. A stopwatch is located at the bottom of the screen, allowing you to pause time. This will be useful when you have a few strategic moves left but not enough time to finish the level. Tips You can unlock bolt holes by clicking on one of the advertisement bolts. You’ll have to watch a quick ad to get a free hole. It’s worth it if you are in a jam. Another alternative is the bonus screwdriver at the bottom of the screen. The more points you gain, the more bonus bolt removals you will get. Use them sparingly because you’ll need them further down the line. Re-fill some holes with bolts. Moving bolts around to different empty holes is part of the strategy. Find which bolts can be removed that won’t cover any open holes. When you lift a bolt and decide where to place it, panels may shift, so don’t hesitate too long. Features 100+ levels of varying difficulty, starting from the easiest, where you can relax and prepare for the more challenging levels, where you must give your best to solve the puzzle. Helpful tools will assist you in tricky situations and help you overcome the task. Ability to change the appearance of the bolts. Release Date April 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile) More Games Like This Are you looking for similar brain teasers? games.title: Cut the Rope
games.description: Cut the Rope to feed large pieces of candy to a hungry creature called Om Nom. Collect all the stars for the highest rating and progress to more challenging levels with new puzzles.
games.long_description: Cut the Rope to feed large pieces of candy to a hungry creature called Om Nom. Collect all the stars for the highest rating and progress to more challenging levels with new puzzles. This is the first game in the Cut the Rope franchise, a series of physics-based puzzle games where you must cut ropes, collect stars, and feed your hungry monster friend. How to Play Cut the Rope After you pass the tutorial, the game begins with the monster Om Nom inside a box, which gets opened in front of you. Inside the box, there are candies and stars. You'll have to cut the ropes holding the candies in the correct order so the candies swing and collect all the stars, then feed Om Nom. Sometimes, you must slice through the rope at the right moment so it falls in the right direction. You need a certain number of stars to continue progress in Cut the Rope. As you get further, you’ll encounter new puzzle elements like bubbles and air cushions. Use these devices to secure all the stars before feeding little Om Nom. "Seasons" and boxes in Cut the Rope There are 3 "seasons" in Cut the Rope. Each season features different types of boxes in which Om Nom is contained and where the magic needs to happen. For each box, there are 25 different puzzles for a total of 75 stars to collect, and each one introduces a new feature to the puzzles. The types of boxes available are: Season 1 Cardboard Box Fabric Box Foil Box Magic Box Valentine's Box Season 2 Toy Box Gift Box Cosmic Box Tool Box Buzz Box Season 3 DJ Box Spooky Box Steam Box Lantern Box Cheese Box Pillow Box Mechanical Cut the Rope is different from similar games because you do not necessarily need to start from the 1st type of box in the first season, but can kick off playing in any of the available seasons. So if you are stuck on some hard-to-beat level, you can start playing a different puzzle and then get back to it at a later stage. games.description: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques.
games.long_description: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques. Whether you’re aiming to outwit a friend or conquer global rivals, every shot counts in your quest to become the ultimate billiards champion. How to Play 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer 8 Ball Pool Billiards is just like your classic pool game, where your objective is to pot your balls into the pockets. This game adds a fun twist in that you can play with random players from all around the world, helping you enhance your game to a pro-level with continued practice. The game begins with a break shot where you hit the cue ball to scatter the other balls. Your objective is to pot the balls into pockets using the cue ball where possible. The first break will tell you whether you are stripes or solids, depending on what ball you get in the pocket first. In each turn, aim to strike the cue ball to hit your target ball into a pocket. If successful, you continue your turn; otherwise, your opponent takes their turn. The key is to use strategic shots to position the cue ball for the next play and try to control the table by positioning balls to your advantage. The direction of where your ball will land is outlined from the stick to the ball with an arrow, giving you an indication of the target path. The player who pots all their balls first wins the game. Choose from numerous game rooms, such as a private two-player game between you and your friend, a quick play game where you choose your level and play against the public quickly, or a local play where you may need to wait a bit to be matched with a live partner. games.description: 8-Ball Billiards is a free online pool game in our sports category, ideal for one or two players. You can play solo against AI or challenge other players in two-player mode.
games.long_description: 8-Ball Billiards is a free online pool game in our sports category, ideal for one or two players. You can play solo against AI or challenge other players in two-player mode. The game is easy for anyone to play, so pick up a cue and line up your first shot. How to Play 8 Ball Billiards Classic 8 Ball Billiards Classic is much like the classic in-person game: your goal is to pocket all your balls (either solids or stripes) and sink the 8-ball to win. Use your mouse to aim the cue stick and adjust the power of your shot. Click and drag the cue stick back to set your shot’s power, then release it to strike the cue ball. This is a 2-player game, so carefully plan each shot to outmaneuver your opponent and clear the table before they do! You can use the settings to choose the ability of your AI-controlled opponents and, if you are good at it, you can also remove the visual help that allows you to understand the trajectory of your shots. Pick a ball 8-Ball Billiards is an intuitive billiards game where you must pot all the striped or spotted balls, depending on the color assigned to you. The balls you’re assigned depend on what ball is potted first, so shoot for the win! Line up your cue The controls are easy. Simply click and drag to find the right level of force, then line up the angle with the ball that seems easiest to pot next. Remember that this is pool, so save the 8-ball until you have potted all your balls, otherwise, you will lose!
