games.title: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer
games.description: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer is a board connect game. Similar to the table game, you need to line up four chips in a row before your opponent does to win!
games.long_description: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer is a board connect game. Similar to the table game, you need to line up four chips in a row before your opponent does to win! You can play with friends, against the computer or against online players. How to Play Connect 4 Online Multiplayer The goal is simple: get four of your pieces in a row before your opponent does. Horizontal, vertical, or diagonal, they all count. Whoever connects four first takes the round. From the home screen, you pick how you want to play: Play Online to get matched with another player Play Bots to practice against the computer Create Room to set up your own game Play in Person to take on a real person instead of a bot Every game you finish earns XP and coins, and you spend those coins in the shop on cosmetics. You start small (a fresh account starts with 90 coins), and the catalog runs from cheap items like the 50-coin Teal Board all the way up to 40,000-coin characters. How to drop discs and win in Connect 4 Online Multiplayer Pick a mode from the home screen. If you hit Play Online and change your mind, click Cancel Search. For a bot game, choose Public or Private and set the Bot Difficulty. Pick your side: ghosts or pumpkins. Click the half-ghost, half-pumpkin face if you want the game to choose for you. Click Start Game. Left-click the board to drop a disc into a column (tap if you're on mobile). Watch the timer under your name. If it runs out, you lose your turn. Connect four of your pieces to win. After the game, you can share a replay, leave the room, or wait for the countdown to send you back to the lobby. Bots, Rooms, and Ways to Play When you choose to play bots, you'll face bot opponents like Bulby and Rival Hare, and you can set the difficulty before you start (Average is one of the options). Just know the difficulty level isn't constant so it will get more difficult. The room panel shows a difficulty number during the game, and it can change, so one bot match might feel easier or tougher than the last. It's still the best place to warm up before you take on a real person. If you want to play with someone specific, Create Room gives you an invite code, and your friend can get in with Join by Code. You can also click Show Rooms to see what's open right now. Rooms can be Public or Private, so you control who gets in. XP and Leveling Up Every game feeds two XP bars: one for 4 in a Row Connect itself and one for your overall account. A single win against a bot was worth +64 game XP and +12 account XP. The first game level takes 150 XP, and the first account level takes 500, so you'll level up after just a few games. Hover over the level icons at the top of the screen to see your current level and how much XP you need to reach the next one. The Shop: Coins, Gems, and Rarity You earn coins by playing games, and you spend them on items in the shop. Gems buy unique cosmetics, and the game jokes that they're scientifically proven to make you cooler. Hit the GET GEMS button at the top of the shop if you want more. Items come in Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic rarities, and some are on sale with discounts from 10% to 50% off. The shop refreshes on a countdown timer, so if you don't see something you like, check back later. Here's what's in the shop: Cursors range from the 10,000-coin Hand Cursor to the 30,000-coin Kebab and Marker Cursors, while gem cursors like the Pen Cursor cost 200 gems. Frames (like the Pirate Frame, Crab Frame, and Cat Headset Frame) dress up your profile picture. Chat Colors are the cheap entry point: Mint Whisper is 280 coins, Seafoam Breeze is 220, and Silver is 100 gems. The shop also carries items for other games, like Carrom boards and pieces, Checkers pieces, Chess boards and piece sets, Foonopoly tokens, and Foony Brawl Fighters (Tad is 4,000 coins, Shelly and Tava are 40,000 each). There's also a Marketplace button next to the shop if you want to look beyond the current lineup. Ghosts vs. Pumpkins: The Halloween Theme For a limited time, the board has a full Halloween makeover: witch hat, bubbling cauldron, broom, jack-o'-lanterns, and tombstones around the frame. Instead of plain discs, one side plays ghosts and the other plays pumpkins. Hover over your ghost and you'll see it's called the Boo Piece, marked Unsellable. The Halloween look is seasonal, so enjoy it while it lasts. The game keeps getting new content, so expect more to show up. Chat and Community Every game has a chat panel on the right where you can type to your opponent, and there's a Join our Discord button on the home screen if you want to find other players. The game gives you a random username, which keeps you anonymous from the start. Like any online game with open chat, not everybody's going to be pleasant. If someone gets weird or rude, you don't have to stick around: click Leave room and move on. For games with people you actually know, use a Private room and share the code directly.Similar games More Games Like This If you like this game you will love our puzzle category where you will find games like Word Wipe or Uno Online which ranks among our favorite multiplayer games, as well as 2048 , Block Blast and plenty more. Release Date July 2022 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Empire City
games.description: Empire City is a casual management game where you strategically construct and govern a thriving empire from nothing. Build magnificent cities, develop resources, and create a unique culture while engaging in trade and diplomacy.
games.long_description: Empire City is a casual management game where you strategically construct and govern a thriving empire from nothing. Build magnificent cities, develop resources, and create a unique culture while engaging in trade and diplomacy. Expand your influence, make historic discoveries, and craft wonders that will be remembered for centuries. Your choices shape the future of your empire: lead wisely! How to Play Empire City Empire City is a classic management game set in ancient times where you get to build an entire city, including roadways, residential homes, waterways, workshops, and more -- all from a blank slate with a bit of help from two close advisors: Julia and Flavius. The game starts with a full intro from Julia and Flavius, which will walk you through step by step how to build your city. Once you have the hang of it, you're on your own. But not to worry, help from your advisors is just a click away. Julia and Flavius guide you through the following directions: Julia: "Welcome to the city, Prefect! I’m Julia. I run an inn here, and I know everything about everyone. This is Flavius, the architect." Flavius: "My projects can do the talking for me! The first one is a residential building. Let’s get to work!" Julia: "Remember, every building in the city must be connected to a road." Action: You get to build a road. Flavius: "Congratulations, Prefect! The building is ready. We can house people in it now." Julia: "People?! There’s barely room for one citizen. The building needs to be upgraded." Action: Build a house. Flavius: "Prefect, we have a problem. We need clay to make the house more spacious, but it’s mined outside the city." Julia: "If it’s even mined at all! The clay quarry is in bad shape, and the tool storage is totally dilapidated. But our Prefect can solve that, right?" Action: Fix the clay quarry. Julia: "Now we can hire a manager! But that can happen later. First, we need to build a road to deliver the clay to the city." Action: Build a road. Flavius: "The road is wonderful, Prefect! Collect the mined clay, and my people will deliver it to the construction site right away." Action: Collect the clay. Flavius: "Thank you for the help. I’ll get to work upgrading the house right now!" Julia: "You and Flavius are doing wonderfully! Let’s upgrade another house. games.title: Gridpunk - 3v3 Battle Royale
games.description: Gridpunk - Battle Royale 3v3 PvP is an IO battle game where lightning-fast reflexes and precision will determine how far you make it through to the end of this real-time shooter action. This high-intensity game requires you to stay sharp, aim true, and master the art of drone attacks to outwit and overpower your opponents.
games.long_description: Gridpunk - Battle Royale 3v3 PvP is an IO battle game where lightning-fast reflexes and precision will determine how far you make it through to the end of this real-time shooter action. This high-intensity game requires you to stay sharp, aim true, and master the art of drone attacks to outwit and overpower your opponents. Each 3v3 PvP match puts you against players in real-time in multiplayer battles. There’s no room for luck—it's all about skill, strategy, and timing. How to Play Gridpunk - 3v3 Battle Royale Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping fighting adventure in Gridpunk - Battle Royale 3v3 PvP, where electrifying music sets the stage for high-stakes battles in a cyberpunk arena. This is not just a game—it's an intense, fast-paced showdown that will test your reflexes and strategy. One false move, and you’re out. This multiplayer game splits six players into green and red teams so they can battle it out in real-time. You’ll automatically join the green team and control one of its members, with health indicators displayed above every player. Opponents on the red team are equally equipped, so don’t let your guard down because competition is fierce. You will be in a multi-room scenario where you need to go through doors and passageways to confront your enemy. There is no hiding in this game. If you don’t go to them, they will come to you and in numbers! Move your fighter using the arrow keys, and aim with precision using your mouse to unleash a barrage of shots. Get to know the controls well before attempting to win your opponents. The gameplay can get complex if you don’t master the keys. Explore the arena to collect glowing rewards that instantly boost your strength. Arm yourself with powerful weapons, pick up health packs to stay in the game, and enhance your arsenal with drones and super gadgets. Strategy and quick reflexes are your greatest allies as you navigate the vibrant map. Before each match begins, the game ensures a full roster of six players for the ultimate test of skill. Every second counts as you race to dominate the battlefield. With a scoreboard tracking team progress, adapt your tactics and aim to outplay your opponents in this fast-paced fight for victory. Gridpunk delivers an unmatched battle royale experience, blending quick rounds, real-time multiplayer gameplay, and a cyberpunk aesthetic. Engage in intense action, launch devastating attacks, and prove your worth in this skill-driven, free-to-play showdown. More Games Like This Io games can be addictive, which is why we stock up on a collection of fun titles. Try Bloxd io , a game featuring popular Minecraft graphics and plenty of game modes; Narrow One , a game where you fight fast battles using your handy bow and arrows; or Smash Karts , a multiplayer game where you take down opponents to claim victory. Release Date November 2022 (WebGL) Developer Gridpunk - 3v3 Battle Royale is developed by neverGames. Platforms Web browser Android iOS

games.title: Guess Their Answer
games.description: Guess Their Answer is a casual quiz game where your goal is to outsmart opponents by predicting the most popular answers. Tackle three head-scratching questions per round across diverse topics, earn rewards, and unlock unique skins to personalize your experience.
games.long_description: Guess Their Answer is a casual quiz game where your goal is to outsmart opponents by predicting the most popular answers. Tackle three head-scratching questions per round across diverse topics, earn rewards, and unlock unique skins to personalize your experience. With daily quizzes and competitive matches, every game is a chance to prove you know your trivia. How to Play Guess Their Answer Guess Their Answer is a guessing game similar to Family Feud, where you try to predict the most popular answers given to specific questions. You start by giving your character a name and meet your opponent. You’re presented with a question or prompt with an audience watching you. You have to type your answer, and when you get the right answer, the audience will rally by your side. The more audience you have on your side, the more you know you’re winning. You will be told when your opponent gets wrong answers, and there is a barometer letting you know as well, so keep an eye out. Some of the questions you can be asked are "Name a superhero”. The key is you are trying to guess the most common answer, not just any old answer. If your answer is the most common, the very audience members who responded with your guess will back you up. You have to think of answers that the audience or survey participants might have chosen. Each round features a different category, and your goal is to type responses that align with the most common answers. Points are awarded based on how popular your answers are. The game typically includes multiple rounds, with the final rounds offering double or triple points. The person or team with the most points at the end wins. Creativity and speed are key since you have limited time to respond. The game allows for some flexibility with misspellings or variations, which can lead to unexpected wins. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the challenge is to think quickly, predict what others might say, and sometimes laugh at how quirky or close-to-wrong answers can still score points. More Games Like This There are plenty more casual games to keep you entertained. Try another quiz game like Google Feud , where you need to use your search skills to guess a Google search term, or go for Text Twist , a game developed by GameHouse where you are meant to unscramble as many words as possible with the provided letters before your time runs out, or Friday Night Funkin , a game where you test your rhythm in good old fashioned music battles.

Card Swap: Swap one meme with another from your collection. Swap All Cards: Replace all your current memes with new ones. Choosing a Meme Pick the meme you want to play; it goes anonymously into a common pool. Voting Once everyone submits their meme, they are revealed without showing who played which. Vote for the funniest — but not your own. Round Winner The meme with the most votes wins. Its author earns likes. New Round Each player receives 1 new card, and a new scenario appears. Ending the Game After 3 rounds, the total likes are counted. The player with the highest number is the winner.

games.title: Planet Smash Destruction
games.description: Planet Smash Destruction is a casual game in which you wield cosmic power to create and destroy planets. You can try out different weapons, design custom planetary systems, and release black holes.
games.long_description: Planet Smash Destruction is a casual game in which you wield cosmic power to create and destroy planets. You can try out different weapons, design custom planetary systems, and release black holes. With easy-to-use controls, it suits both beginners and seasoned players. Unleash your creativity and discover the wonders of space in this captivating physics simulator. How to Play Planet Smash Destruction Your goal in Planet Smash Destruction is to destroy planets, essentially for the fun of it. You will journey to various planets and celestial bodies with nothing but courage and weapons to accompany you. Your weapons will help you on your path to destruction, but they also help reshape planets from their original form. Planet Smash Destruction can be categorized as a sandbox game, so you get a significant amount of freedom to explore space, making each gameplay quite unique. Your imagination is the only limit to full space domination. The game starts with a view from space of Earth -- it's just sitting there waiting to be destroyed. Fret not; if all feels overwhelming while destroying your homeland, you can always press reset while repeating the mantra - it's only a game, it's only a game. Choose your weapon There are several ways to destroy Earth and other planets. On the right side of the screen, select a weapon to destroy your chosen planet. For example, you can choose an alien monster drill to create a donut-like hole in the center of Mars. Or, if the planet is rotating close enough to you, you may want to detonate a bomb. Say goodbye to one or all seven continents with a few consistent laser shots. Want to practice your aim? Send a rocket out to see just how much you can destroy in one go. The more planets you destroy, the more money you earn. Currency will get you weapon upgrades and new planets to explore via a store purchase, allowing you to destroy even more worlds. You can tweak your weapons via settings. You might enlarge your laser beam and change its color, make meteorites hit a wider area, move faster, or expand the blast radius of missiles. You can even unleash dozens of missiles for those peskier planets that are more difficult to destroy. In Planet Smash Destruction you can also enter creative mode and create a brand new planet, populate it with people, set its terrain, add satellites and other human artifacts in its orbit, before turning it into dust! Weapons Categories in Planet Smash Destruction: Monsters Stars Planets Bombs Rockets Lasers More Games Like This Browse our casual game selection to continue the fun. Popular titles include Little Alchemy and Little Alchemy 2 , which let you mix and match elements to create new discoveries, while 2048 challenges you to reach the number 2048 by adding up multiples of 2 by putting them in adjacent positions. Release Date January 2024 Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android

games.title: BodyCamera Shooter
games.description: BodyCamera Shooter is an FPS shooting game where you see everything from a body camera fixed on your fighter, taking you through a pretty realistic experience through abandoned buildings and rubble, aiming to kill or be killed. You'll understand the concept if you're familiar with the Bodycam game.
games.long_description: BodyCamera Shooter is an FPS shooting game where you see everything from a body camera fixed on your fighter, taking you through a pretty realistic experience through abandoned buildings and rubble, aiming to kill or be killed. You'll understand the concept if you're familiar with the Bodycam game. Enter the battlefield and enjoy a unique gaming experience! BodyCamera Shooter offers ultra-realistic first-person shooter action directly in your browser and on your phone. How to Play BodyCamera Shooter The goal of a BodyCamera Shooter is to stay alive by neutralizing threats and surviving waves of enemies in unfamiliar territory. The emphasis is often on tactical decision-making, realism, and immersion, with a strong focus on precision and careful movement. You must navigate through environments, often with limited resources and visual awareness, to complete these objectives while maintaining your own survival. The key to this game is combined reaction time and precision. There are numerous moves to make, and uncertainty greatly outweighs tactical precision, forcing you to adapt and react quickly to unpredictable situations. WASD or arrow keys will navigate your player, but your strength lies in using your keypad or mouse to aim and shoot. Focus on mastering movement while aiming and shooting at first. You'll likely get killed while practicing this, but it is hard to move on to more skillful moves until this is down pat. Once you gain a bit of momentum, incorporate a bit of running (shift key) and jumping (space bar) to avoid enemy fire and navigate your surroundings more quickly. The R key will be vital once you master your craft; it will reload your weapon quickly. Use this when surrounded by enemy fire to avoid wasting time with automatic reloads. You can upgrade your soldier through six different levels, each corresponding to a new weapon that will be unlocked as you progress through the levels. There are four different scenarios for the combat: the first two will be available immediately, while to access the Counter-Strike looking map, you will have to reach level 5, and the last one will only be accessible after reaching level 10. FPS perspective Game graphics are hyper-realistic and will get your adrenaline pumped. The gameplay is sometimes so real that you question whether the graphics were based on realistic scenarios and scenery. The bodycam is positioned at chest level, providing a more realistic field of view, although it is still relatively limited due to the nature of your environment. You can use surrounding sounds as guidance, but you’re more likely to hear your footsteps than your opponents. content_guide.how_to: The goal of a BodyCamera Shooter is to stay alive by neutralizing threats and surviving waves of enemies in unfamiliar territory. The emphasis is often on tactical decision-making, realism, and immersion, with a strong focus on precision and careful movement. You must navigate through environments, often with limited resources and visual awareness, to complete these objectives while maintaining your own survival. The key to this game is combined reaction time and precision. There are numerous moves to make, and uncertainty greatly outweighs tactical precision, forcing you to adapt and react quickly to unpredictable situations. WASD or arrow keys will navigate your player, but your strength lies in using your keypad or mouse to aim and shoot. Focus on mastering movement while aiming and shooting at first. You'll likely get killed while practicing this, but it is hard to move on to more skillful moves until this is down pat. Once you gain a bit of momentum, incorporate a bit of running (shift key) and jumping (space bar) to avoid enemy fire and navigate your surroundings more quickly. The R key will be vital once you master your craft; it will reload your weapon quickly. Use this when surrounded by enemy fire to avoid wasting time with automatic reloads. You can upgrade your soldier through six different levels, each corresponding to a new weapon that will be unlocked as you progress through the levels. There are four different scenarios for the combat: the first two will be available immediately, while to access the Counter-Strike looking map, you will have to reach level 5, and the last one will only be accessible after reaching level 10.

How to Play Tanks 3D Tanks 3D throws you into a tense, action-packed battlefield where it's every tank for itself. You're up against players from around the globe, and the goal is simple: survive and eliminate as many enemy tanks as possible. Your tank is built for rough terrain. It can climb steep hills and drop into deep valleys. These low areas might offer protection from enemy fire, but they can also be dangerous ambush zones if enemies are lurking nearby. While your tank can take a few hits, too much damage will destroy it. Once you're taken out, you'll have to restart, so choose your movements carefully and stay alert at all times. You can communicate with other players in real time using the chat box located at the bottom of the screen. The leaderboard in the top right corner shows the scores of all players currently in the match, helping you track your progress. The minimap on the screen gives you a sense of where enemy tanks are located and how close they are to your position. Use this to plan your attacks or your escape. You’ll also see soldiers walking around the map. They’re easy to take out, but they can also act as warnings that an enemy tank might be nearby. games.long_description: Wild Hunter 3D is an action-packed hunting simulation game that takes you on an immersive adventure into the wilderness. Your mission is to track and hunt various wild animals, including bears, crocodiles, deer, buffalo, and wolves. With 100 challenging levels set across three distinct game worlds such as dense forests, icy tundras, and arid deserts, you'll experience a variety of environments that test your skills and strategy. How to Play Wild Hunter 3D Step into the wild and take on the role of a skilled hunter. Each hunt presents different animals to track and shoot, but the rugged landscape makes them difficult to spot. Staying alert is key, as the terrain provides plenty of cover for your targets. Your hunting goals appear in the top-left corner, showing how many deer, boars, or other animals you need to hunt. Completing these objectives earns reward points, and after each successful shot, you’ll see a distance meter displaying how far you were from the target. You can move around to find a better position, but the most rewarding shots come from a distance. Precision is everything. If you miss, the animal will be startled and run, making it much harder to hit. Moving targets requires skill, and a poorly timed shot could turn the hunt against you. If an animal becomes aware of your presence, it might charge, and a wild boar stampede could end the round instantly. To improve your aim, you can adjust both general sensitivity and scope sensitivity. Moving closer may give you an easier shot, but true hunters thrive on long-range accuracy. Survive 100 rounds, master the wild, and prove yourself as the ultimate hunter. Sharpen your aim, manage your resources, and prepare for the thrill of the hunt in Wild Hunter 3D! games.long_description: Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War is an action tower defense battle game where you fight your opponent throughout the ages, starting from the Stone Age, making your way all the way to modern marvels. Your main task is strategically dominating the battlefield to constantly upgrade your army and conquer enemies in an epic 1v1 battle. Lead your army to victory in this strategic game and show your earned skills to the modern world. The old Flash game from 2007, Age of War , by Max Game Studios, has clearly been a source of inspiration for Age of Tanks Warriors. How to Play Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War Age of Tanks Warriors is a one-click battle game, so the actual combat portion of the game is fairly simple. The difficulty lies in devising a strategy for utilizing your army and weapons to eliminate your opponents before they can eliminate you and destroy your fortress. Once you do this, you get to upgrade your army and weapons for an even more effective strategy. The game begins with your stone cave, which is directly opposite your opponent's cave. You can deploy your soldiers by clicking the small icon on the bottom right of your screen. The only hitch is that you may not have enough soldiers to send out in time to match your opponent's troops! Your task on each level is to defeat the opposing army and destroy their shelter. As the levels advance, so do the fortresses, making it even more difficult throughout the ages. Fighting begins with sticks and stones, but eventually turns into tanks and artillery. Tips Collect as many coins and as much food as possible by watching some of the ads. This will help strengthen your troop. Otherwise, it's a bit difficult, as the opponent starts with an advantage. Don't deploy too many troops straight away. It's best to deploy when the enemy is closer to home territory. You can defeat multiple enemies with one of your soldiers, so be skillful in how many you send out simultaneously and which ones. Once you do this, you get to upgrade your army and weapons for an even more effective strategy. The game begins with your stone cave, which is directly opposite your opponent's cave. You can deploy your soldiers by clicking the small icon on the bottom right of your screen. The only hitch is that you may not have enough soldiers to send out in time to match your opponent's troops! Your task on each level is to defeat the opposing army and destroy their shelter. As the levels advance, so do the fortresses, making it even more difficult throughout the ages. Fighting begins with sticks and stones, but eventually turns into tanks and artillery.
tips: Collect as many coins and as much food as possible by watching some of the ads. This will help strengthen your troop. Otherwise, it's a bit difficult, as the opponent starts with an advantage. Don't deploy too many troops straight away. It's best to deploy when the enemy is closer to home territory. You can defeat multiple enemies with one of your soldiers, so be skillful in how many you send out simultaneously and which ones.

games.title: Waffle Words
games.description: Waffle Words is a puzzle game ideal for word-game fanatics. This is no edible waffle but the kind whose crevices are filled with letters waiting for hidden words that lie within to be revealed.
games.long_description: Waffle Words is a puzzle game ideal for word-game fanatics. This is no edible waffle but the kind whose crevices are filled with letters waiting for hidden words that lie within to be revealed. You have to draw lines with your mouse to form as many words as possible. How to Play Waffle Words Waffle Words is an addictive word game where you have to create words from a waffle grid of letters. The words can be created as long as the line you draw is not interrupted. Lines can be horizontal, vertical, L-shaped, U-shaped - you name it! Do not limit yourself to one straight, left-to-right line/letter combination. Note that you can't create diagonal ones. Your words must be at least three characters in length, so avoid relying on two-letter words to get through the game. Time Limit There is a two-minute time limit to find as many words as possible. Can you see the longest possible word? How about the word with the highest score in this short time frame? Six Languages Waffle Words can be played in six different languages. The words are available in the following languages: English German Spanish French Italian Portuguese How is the Waffle Words Game Scored? You will receive a score based on the total points earned from the letters you use. A number on each tile indicates how much your letter is worth. Your accumulated word list will be on the game board's right. You will be scored on: How many words you found The longest word you found The best word you found Go for long words. They are harder to identify but will reap the most significant rewards. More Games Like This Browse our casual games for more word games. games.title: Agar.io
games.description: Agar.io is the original .io grow game. Play as a simple agar cell fighting to become the largest cell in a multiplayer game arena.
games.long_description: Agar.io is the original .io grow game. Play as a simple agar cell fighting to become the largest cell in a multiplayer game arena. Avoid the bigger cells and consume the smaller ones to grow larger. This is a simple game about growing your single-cell organism bigger than other players. We love it in our family because there is a surprising amount of strategy and collaboration. You need to pay attention to other players to decide if you are bigger or smaller than them. Taking your time and hiding behind virus cells is a tactic our youngest used a lot. Best of all, though, splitting your cell to offer another player a way to grow is commonly seen as a sign to work together. We’ve had long games where we end up hunting in packs with others. It’s a great way to learn cooperation. Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play Agario In Agar.io, you begin as a tiny cell in a massive arena filled with pellets and other players. At the start, your best move is to quietly gather pellets scattered around the map. This lets you grow without drawing too much attention from larger predators. Avoid chasing other small players right away—most beginners get eaten this way. Patience pays off: focus on steady growth until you’re big enough to hunt. The game has 2 simple rules to follow: You can only consume targets that are smaller than you to evolve Larger agar will eat you Slide around the Agario battleground, trying to exist as a single cell looking to evolve. Think like a survivor - don’t just avoid bigger agar, go in for the kill and eat as much as you can! Pick up all the smaller blobs and eat the other players to grow larger in size. Avoid blobs bigger than you as they will consume you, which means game over! But you can always start the game over and go for your next best record. Once you reach medium size, movement slows, so you’ll need to be more tactical. Use your ability to split (Space key or split button) to lunge at smaller cells just out of reach. A successful split doubles your number of cells but halves their size, so choose your targets wisely. Always make sure the prey is small enough that even your split cell can absorb them; otherwise, you’ll just leave yourself vulnerable. To climb higher, learn to use viruses to your advantage. As a small cell, viruses act as safe zones where big predators won’t dare follow. As a larger cell, you can eject mass into a virus to fire it toward enemies, popping them into pieces and giving you a chance to swallow their fragments. This is one of the most effective ways to topple giants on the leaderboard. Winning in Agar.io isn’t about brute force; it’s about survival, timing, and positioning. Hug the edges of the map when you’re small, move toward the center once you’re stronger, and always look for opportunities to trap opponents against the map’s borders. The ultimate goal is to balance risk and reward: grow big enough to dominate, but not so reckless that a single virus or split leaves you scattered and eaten. About Agar.io Initially, Agar.io user feedback was mixed. According to Engagdet.com, it was seen as "a good abstraction of the fierce survival-of-the-fittest competition that you sometimes see on the microscopic level." However, there was also some criticism of the simplicity of the gameplay. This was mainly targeted towards the repetitiveness and the controls of the mobile version. Tom Christiansen of Gamezebo said, "Personally, I found nothing to hold my attention in Agar.io but that shouldn’t stop you from giving it a shot if it looks even remotely interesting to you." Nevertheless, Agar.io quickly became a success, likely due in part to its frequent discussion on social media platforms, particularly Twitch and YouTube. The mobile version of the game was downloaded more than ten million times during its first week, and in 2015, Agar.io was Google's most-searched video game. In the same year, it was even listed as the fifth top game on YouTube’s list of top games. So, it's safe to say it's got some appeal! Did you know? Agar.io was also featured in the Netflix TV series House of Cards! It made its appearance in Season 4, Episode 9 (Chapter 48) with Frank Underwood shown playing the game while meeting with Will Conway. Game Modes There are four game modes in Agar.io. Donate your mass to the pellets to get more bits in return! More Games Like This If you like Agario, you should definitely try out our other .io games like Paper.io , a real-time multiplayer game where you capture as much territory as possible by painting it. Other games with a similar idle vibe include Idle Breakout or casual games like Word Search , 2048 , or Bubble Shooter . Features Eat smaller cells to become bigger Fast-paced online gameplay Four game modes to enjoy Play with your friends Agar.io Developer Matheus Valadares announced Agar.io on 4chan on 28 April 2015. Matheus, back then a 19-year-old Brazilian developer, wrote the game in a few days using JavaScript and C++. The game was announced without a name, and users had to connect to Valadares' IP address to play. It was only later that the name "Agar.io" was suggested by an anonymous user on 4chan. Matheus continued adding new features to the game. One week later, Agar.io entered Steam Greenlight. Release Date April 2015 Platforms Web browser iOS app Android app

content_guide.summary: Agar.io is the original .io grow game. Play as a simple agar cell fighting to become the largest cell in a multiplayer game arena.
content_guide.how_to: In Agar.io, you begin as a tiny cell in a massive arena filled with pellets and other players. At the start, your best move is to quietly gather pellets scattered around the map. This lets you grow without drawing too much attention from larger predators. Avoid chasing other small players right away—most beginners get eaten this way. Patience pays off: focus on steady growth until you’re big enough to hunt. The game has 2 simple rules to follow: You can only consume targets that are smaller than you to evolve Larger agar will eat you Slide around the Agario battleground, trying to exist as a single cell looking to evolve. Think like a survivor - don’t just avoid bigger agar, go in for the kill and eat as much as you can! Pick up all the smaller blobs and eat the other players to grow larger in size. Avoid blobs bigger than you as they will consume you, which means game over! But you can always start the game over and go for your next best record. Once you reach medium size, movement slows, so you’ll need to be more tactical. Use your ability to split (Space key or split button) to lunge at smaller cells just out of reach. A successful split doubles your number of cells but halves their size, so choose your targets wisely. Always make sure the prey is small enough that even your split cell can absorb them; otherwise, you’ll just leave yourself vulnerable. To climb higher, learn to use viruses to your advantage. As a small cell, viruses act as safe zones where big predators won’t dare follow. As a larger cell, you can eject mass into a virus to fire it toward enemies, popping them into pieces and giving you a chance to swallow their fragments. This is one of the most effective ways to topple giants on the leaderboard. Winning in Agar.io isn’t about brute force; it’s about survival, timing, and positioning. Hug the edges of the map when you’re small, move toward the center once you’re stronger, and always look for opportunities to trap opponents against the map’s borders. The ultimate goal is to balance risk and reward: grow big enough to dominate, but not so reckless that a single virus or split leaves you scattered and eaten.

Use your coins to buy various skins and upgrades for the next game! How to Play Worm Hunt Squirm your worm around the big arena. Pick up food to grow and boosts to give you a temporary advantage over your slithering opponents. Block the path of another worm to kill it and feast on all the food they have picked up. games.title: Kour.io
games.description: Kour.io is a multiplayer IO FPS game that plunges you into intense battles across various maps with many guns and modes to play!It's one of the most accessible first-person shooters, available on both web browsers and mobile.
games.long_description: Kour.io is a multiplayer IO FPS game that plunges you into intense battles across various maps with many guns and modes to play! It's one of the most accessible first-person shooters, available on both web browsers and mobile. This game offers numerous game modes, including free-for-all, team deathmatch, gun-game, and Hardpoint. Choose from various classes, each with unique weapons, to match your play style and aim to become the #1 Kour! How to Play Kour.io In Kour.io, your main goal is to earn KP (Kour Points) by racking up kills and completing missions. The more KP you collect, the more you can unlock! Spend your KP on various customizations like skins, crates, hats, characters, and emotes. You'll level up as you gather points in games, gaining access to even more content and perks. Want to team up with friends? Create or join clans to form a powerful squad and take on challenges together. The competition is fierce, so aim for the top spots on the daily, monthly, and all-time leaderboards to prove your dominance in the Kour.io universe. Whether you’re playing solo or with your clan, every match is a chance to climb the ranks and earn bragging rights. For a personal touch, dive into the map editor to create your own custom maps and challenge other players in your unique arenas. You can also explore the server finder to discover and join lobbies across Kour.io, offering endless opportunities for adventure and competition. Whether you’re customizing your experience or conquering leaderboards, Kour.io offers a dynamic and engaging world to master! Kour.io Characters You can choose from nine unlocked players, each equipped with a different weapon. Players and weapons include: Soldier: AK-47 Gun, 100 HP Hitman: Sniper Rifle, 90 HP Gunner: P90 Gun, 90 HP Heavy: Machine Gun, 150 HP Rocketeer: Rocket Launcher, 90 HP Agent: Silenced MP5, 100 HP Brawler: Shotgun, 120 HP Assassin: FAMAS, 100 HP Investor: Scar Rifle, 90 HP (free unlock with an ad) If you get 10+ kills, you'll unlock even more characters. Juggernaut: Minigun, 100 HP Recon: Vector, 80 HP Pyro: Flamethrower, 100 HP Rayblader: Laser Gun, 110 HP Have a go at each player, as they all possess different qualities and various weapons. Once you've chosen your player, you can get down to business. Choose Your Map Havana: Based on the Cuban city, it's the first and most competitive map, set in a tropical paradise. Ghost Town: Inspired by Nuke Town from Call of Duty, this map features an abandoned desert town in Arizona with rooftop warfare. Snowstorm: Set in Iceland, this winter map lets you engage enemies amid freezing ocean views and purple skies. Kour House: The newest map with boost pads, shipment containers, and buildings for strategic fights. Legion HQ: Modeled after the Legion Platforms headquarters, this office space map is perfect for fun trick shots. Game Modes Official game modes: Free For All Team Deathmatch Gun Game, only played with guns Hardpoint, played in teams, points are accrued for killing enemies and for touching a base on the map ParKour, where shooting happens while parkouring between buildings MoonSnipe, a low-gravity mode played on Earth’s most ancient satellite KourSurf, where surf and shooting happen simultaneously Kour io has a vibrant community of players, and they are also creating game modes. Among those available, there is: KourCraft, inspired by Minecraft and Fortnite, allows you to build structures to help you fight FFA 35, a 35-minute Free For All Pool Map More Games Like This IO games can be addictive, that's why we have a vast selection of titles for you to enjoy! Try other shooting mechanics in Bubble Shooter or experiment with a different type of game altogether, like Little Alchemy . Release Date March 2024 Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android

games.title: Diep.io
games.description: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon. The aim is simple: move around the map and destroy the other players whilst improving and upgrading your own circle.
games.long_description: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon. The aim is simple: move around the map and destroy the other players whilst improving and upgrading your own circle. How to Play Diep.io Shoot to level up Diep is a simple .io game set in a vast arena. You start as one basic level 1 tank. Upgrades can reach up to level 45, and with every fifteen levels, you get to choose a new tank with special features. Check the bottom left of your screen to see if you are eligible for an update. Venture around the map, shooting various geometric shapes to level up. It’s best to do this for a while before trying to take on other opponents, as each level-up rewards you with an upgrade point to spend on one of 8 areas to upgrade. Upgrade your Diep circle There are eight different stats you can upgrade: Health Regen - health recovers faster Max Health - increases the maximum health Body Damage - increases the damage dealt by clashing with other items on the map Bullet Speed - improves the speed of projectiles Bullet Penetration - allows bullets to pass through more objects and other bullets before disappearing Bullet Damage - grows the damage dealt by each projectile Reload - decreases the time between shots Movement Speed - increases the tank's speed Consider your choices carefully, as you only have a limited number of skill points, and these are harder to acquire as you level up. A player may want to focus on their bullet damage and speed to increase firepower. Alternatively, you could concentrate on health and regeneration to improve your survivability. Players earn more skill points as they do damage and level up. Try different game modes The main mode is a free-for-all, where every player is for themselves. Other game modes are: Tag - you will be assigned to one of the two teams, and when a player is killed, they respawn in the opposite team. The winning team will have converted all their opponents into members of their squad. Maze - free-for-all with impenetrable walls and small corridors, easier to ambush and be ambushed. Sandbox - a private game mode where players can test builds and classes with their friends. 2 teams or 4 teams - you will be assigned to one of the teams (Red, Blue, Green, Purple). The bases in the corners of the map offer a safe area to respawn and recover. Domination - Dominators is the name of special turrets that teams in this mode fight to capture and control. Try out the different game modes and see which ones suit your play style. Don’t forget to choose your circle color and a gamer tag too! More Games Like This This game is available on web browser and also through the app store. Check out Agar.io for another legendary IO game or check out some other top titles like FNF - Friday Night Funkin' or Little Alchemy . Developer Matheus Valadares made Diep.io. Release April 2016 Platforms Diep.io is available as a web browser game (utilizing HTML5), as well as Android and iOS apps.

games.long_description: EvoWorld.io is the multiplayer survival game previously known as FlyOrDie.io. You start as a small fly and level up as you eat more food. As you evolve, other players become part of your diet. Each level comes with a new special ability and more things to eat. The choice is simple, you Fly or Die! How to Play EvoWorld.io Eat items and animals outlined in green, earn XP and progress on the evolution ladder. Avoid animals with a red outline, because they will eat you! You’ll be fighting for survival against hundreds of other players, so make sure you keep moving and keep eating. Keep an eye on your water level, as you’ll need plenty of water to survive. There is just one playing mode: free-for-all. Special Abilities As you progress through the game, each animal will have its own unique and remarkable ability. You can use that special ability, and activate it by pressing the space bar or the S key, to get through the game quicker. When you start out as a fly, you’ll have “beginner’s luck”. This gives you a 50% chance to avoid a predator's attack. Use the special abilities to your advantage. Game Levels There are 45 different animals and eight stages of evolution in EvoWorld.io. You start as a simple fly, and fight your way up through the animal kingdom. Once you’ve played through the ordinary and real animals, there are demons, mythical beasts, cosmic entities, and the undead. The grim reaper sits right at the top of the food chain with his scythe, which he uses to take down prey. Biomes There are multiple biomes in EvoWorld.io. Each one has an entirely different landscape. You’ll find different prey in each location, so don’t be afraid to explore the map and see what’s out there. About the Developer EvoWorld was made by Pixel Voices, an .io games developer. Tips Don’t stay in one place for too long Use the special abilities to your advantage Hide in the clouds or inside bushes to avoid being eaten Drink plenty of water Eat as much prey as you can! games.title: Backgammon Online
games.description: Backgammon Online is a casual game adapted from the original board game for online players. This is a game of logic that allows you to play the classic and ancient board game of backgammon against other players worldwide.
games.long_description: Backgammon Online is a casual game adapted from the original board game for online players. This is a game of logic that allows you to play the classic and ancient board game of backgammon against other players worldwide. This game has been around for years, almost 5000 to be exact, and this classic title has all of the standard gameplay and rules. How to Play Backgammon Online Backgammon is an ancient game with modernized versions for online gameplay. Your board may be virtual, but the rules and goals are identical. The objective of backgammon is to move all your checkers into your home board and then remove them from the board completely before your opponent does. The Backgammon Online board has been set up for you from the beginning. All you have to do is concentrate on strategy. Each player has 15 checker pieces placed across the board. Your "home" board is directly opposite your opponent's "home" board. Keep your eye on this area; it is key to winning the game. Each player rolls the dice on every turn. You move the checkers across the board to your home board based on the dice count. You can move one checker to the total of both dice or split the moves between two different checkers. If you roll doubles, stakes are raised as you get the double gameplay moves, meaning you can move one piece of the total of both dice multiplied by two, or you can move four different checkers, the total of one dice. Move your checkers to open spots Checkers can only be moved to the following spots: Spots with no occupying checkers Spots that your pieces currently occupy Spots that are occupied by your opponent with only one checker Checkers cannot be moved to spots where your opponent has two or more checkers. Capturing your opponent's checker If you move your checker to a spot where an opponent has only one checker, you capture your opponent's piece, and they will be removed from the board until they can get back in on a dice roll and begin at the beginning of the board again. How to win the game The first person to get all their checkers to the home board and remove each checker via dice rolls wins the game. Try out your Backgammon skills today and challenge people from all around the world! More Games Like This Backgammon Online is part of our casual game collection , where you can find more fun classics based on original real-life series. If you're a fan of backgammon, you may like Ludo King (aka Parchisi), the dice game of kings; or how about a good old game of Uno Online , the card game where you aim to be the first one with no cards. Release Date October 2018 Developer Code This Lab made this game. Features Two game modes, including a multiplayer mode Simple controls and interface Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.long_description: Chess Online Multiplayer is a casual free chess game you can play online with a friend or against an AI opponent. Earn gold to buy stylish new chess boards and pieces! How to Play English Checkers Free In this game, you have several options: you can play with the computer, play online, play with friends, or play together. The mandatory rules are simple but important. You must jump over your opponent’s checker to capture it. A simple checker moves diagonally forward by one square and can only move forward. If there’s an empty square behind your opponent’s checker, you can jump over it and land there. If you have multiple capturing opportunities, you can choose which one to take. You continue jumping until no more captures are possible. If your checker reaches the last row, it is crowned and becomes a king. A king can move diagonally both forward and backward. When jumping, the king can capture multiple opponent’s pieces and must continue capturing as long as possible. The player must jump whenever possible, and if there are several jumping options, they can pick any of them. You can choose your opponent and enable hints or apply a handicap, such as making captures mandatory. You can also select your side (black or white) before starting the game. There are eight difficulty levels, ranging from Beginner to World Champion, and interactive tips are provided to help you improve your gameplay. You can cancel a move and go back if needed, replay the game from any point, and interact with your opponent through funny cartoon emotions. The game can be played with real live players, and you can choose between different time control modes like unlimited, bullet, blitz, rapid, or classic. In terms of gameplay, when a checker reaches the last row, it is crowned and can move both forward and backward. If your checker is next to your opponent’s checker and there’s an open square behind it, you must jump and capture the checker. If one jump leads to another, you continue with the next jump as part of the same turn. If your checker reaches the last row and is crowned, you cannot make further jumps during that turn. Jumping is mandatory, and if you have more than one option, you can choose which one to take. Regular checkers can only capture forward, while kings can capture both forward and backward. You win the game by capturing all of your opponent’s checkers or by blocking your opponent completely so they cannot move. games.title: Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks
games.description: Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks is a casual puzzle solitaire game whose objective is to stack all cards on the game table in sequence. This game is ideal for card players, especially solitaire fans, as it is intuitive to pick up quickly with similar solitaire gameplay but with a slight twist—cards are not in laid out the same way, suits don't matter and rank order can go from high to low to high again!
games.long_description: Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks is a casual puzzle solitaire game whose objective is to stack all cards on the game table in sequence. This game is ideal for card players, especially solitaire fans, as it is intuitive to pick up quickly with similar solitaire gameplay but with a slight twist—cards are not in laid out the same way, suits don't matter and rank order can go from high to low to high again! How to Play Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks The aim of the game is to match cards by rank. Tap a card that is either one rank higher or lower than the card you are working from. For example, if you have a 5, you can play a 6 or a 4. This sequence can continue in either direction (e.g., 4 → 5 → 6 or 6 → 5 → 4). The Table Setup The game begins with a dynamic layout of cards on the table, blending uncovered cards. You can play with covered cards waiting to be revealed. Your objective is to build sequences using only the uncovered cards, so strategize carefully to unlock new possibilities. At the bottom of the game board, you’ll find your home base card, the foundation of your sequences. Every move you make starts here, guiding your progress through the game. Next to your home base is the deck of cards, your lifeline when you run out of moves on the table. Draw from this deck to refresh your strategy and keep the game moving forward. Pay close attention to how the cards are arranged, and start planning your moves to reveal hidden opportunities and outsmart the deck! Suits don’t matter, so you can match cards regardless of their suit, focusing solely on their numerical value. The key to winning is to strategize your moves. It’s often best to start with a lower-numbered card so you have more flexibility to build sequences. Aim to clear as many cards as possible with each move by carefully planning increases and decreases (e.g., a sequence like 4 → 5 → 4 → 6 removes multiple cards). If no moves are available, you will be prompted to draw a card from the deck. The card you draw becomes the new card you must build from. If no uncovered cards are playable, you’ll also need to draw from the deck. The game becomes more challenging as you go. Occasionally, you may receive prompts to add five more cards to the table, increasing the difficulty. If you make a move you regret, use the Undo button to revise your strategy. Kings and Queens Solitaire TriPeaks Tip If you have several sequence options, prioritize moves that remove the most cards from the table or deck. For example, a sequence like 4 → 5 → 4 → 6 can clear more cards than a straight increase like 4 → 5 → 6. More Games Like This Want more casual game fun? We've got you covered! games.description: Mr. Mine is an addictive idle mining clicker arcade game that puts you in charge of building a mining empire from the ground up!
games.long_description: Mr. Mine is an addictive idle mining clicker arcade game that puts you in charge of building a mining empire from the ground up! Start by drilling deep into the Earth’s crust, extracting valuable minerals and hidden treasures. With each click, you’ll uncover riches that can be sold to fund the expansion and upgrading of your mining operations. As your business grows, you’ll be able to unlock new technologies and hire workers to dig even deeper, inching ever closer to the Earth’s core. How to Play Mister Mine The goal of the game is to mine for resources. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards. Mine deeper underground to obtain more resources and minerals to sell. You'll also encounter treasure chests the further you dig. These chests contain random rewards from small to vast amounts of money and resources. Unlike your typical idle game, Mister Mine requires active participation from players. This is evident in two ways: miners must find stones or minerals that require clicking, and players will encounter Bosses in the mines' depths that need to be fought back. You also need to monitor closely the percentage of capacity you reach. Once it’s at 100% your miners will stop working, so you’ll need to either sell all or some of your resources or use them to build or upgrade your tools. Your miners will be digging through 3 different worlds: Earth, up to 1032 km of depth Moon, from 1032 to 1132 km of depth Titan, after 1132 km of depth. Complete quests There are 112 different quests to complete, each of which will give you a different reward, enabling you to improve your business further. Upgrade your gear You start the game with a humble shovel for digging. As you earn enough currency, you can upgrade your digging methods, progressing from a shovel to a jackhammer, and then to a drill, and finally to a nuclear excavator. Beyond that point, upgrades get supernatural, replacing workers with aliens and demons! Hidden gems Dig until km 50 to encounter the Golem (talking to it is one of the quests!) and reach km 400 to meet the first of six Earth bosses. More Games Like This Browse our clicker games for many more addictive idle and clicker titles. Other popular games include Idle Breakout and Little Alchemy . Developer Playsaurus developed Mr. Mine. games.title: Money Factory
games.description: Money Factory is a fast-paced, clicker incremental game where you build your financial empire by strategically connecting tokens on the game board. Each connection generates cash, and the more valuable the tokens you combine, the faster your earnings soar.
games.long_description: Money Factory is a fast-paced, clicker incremental game where you build your financial empire by strategically connecting tokens on the game board. Each connection generates cash, and the more valuable the tokens you combine, the faster your earnings soar. Plan your moves carefully, optimize your token placements, and watch as your money factory transforms into a booming financial powerhouse! How to Play Money Factory Money Factory is a physics-based puzzle game where your goal is to amass a fortune by strategically multiplying your earnings. Money rains down from the sky—truly a dream come true—but most of it starts in small amounts, just single dollars. To grow your wealth, you'll need to make the most of the eight obstacles on your screen, each temporarily catching the falling money and boosting its value. Some obstacles add a fixed amount, like +1, while others multiply your earnings, such as x1.1 or x2. For example, if a dollar hits the +1 obstacle, you earn an extra dollar, but hitting x1.1 will increase your total by 10%. You start with blank slots that you’ll need to fill strategically. Place bumper chips in the most effective spots to maximize your returns, and use the bumper button to acquire new chips that add value. As you play, you can unlock additional slots by watching ads or earning enough money to open prime real estate. The $5k chip, for example, speeds up your progress, but getting there requires smart planning and precise placement. Your ultimate goal is to earn $250k and advance to the next round. Each new level brings more challenges and demands smarter decisions. With careful strategy, well-placed multipliers, and a bit of patience, you’ll turn those falling dollars into a mountain of wealth. More Games Like This Clicker games are irresistibly engaging, combining simple mechanics with endless fun. Check out some of our most popular clicker games: Planet Clicker , where you boost energy production to colonize distant planets; Mr. Mine , an idle arcade game that lets you build a thriving mining empire from scratch; or Idle Breakout , a modern twist on classic brick-breaking gameplay with satisfying upgrades.

games.long_description: Bloons Tower Defense 4, aka BTD 4, is a classic tower defense game initially released in Flash. Defend the path by avoiding Bloons from reaching the end. Tactically place various defenses around the map to pop the balloons. Upgrade them and unlock more as you get further through the game. How to Play Bloons Tower Defense 4 Pop balloons to earn dollars, use your dollars to buy defensive towers or upgrade your existing ones. Bloons TD 4 features nine tracks with varying levels of difficulty. The three easier tracks feature more convenient locations for placing your defenses and tend to be longer. You can also set the difficulty level, reducing the cost of purchases and the number of levels, and increasing your lives. There are 16 unlockable new defenses and upgrades the further you get in the level. These items can be upgraded to handle new threats better and eliminate enemies more effectively. Practice Makes Perfect Bloons Tower Defense 4 has three difficulty levels to choose from. The beginner level is a good place to solidify your game and work your way up. This game can take time to perfect, so start slowly and build your skills. What to expect from the Easy level You get 200 lives There are 50 rounds Items are cheaper to purchase What to expect from the Medium level You get 150 lives There are 60 rounds Items are moderately priced to purchase What to expect from the Hard level You get 100 lives There are 75 rounds Items are more expensive to purchase Sandbox Mode Sandbox is unlocked at rank 26. You get unlimited money and lives. You also get to choose which bloons come and when. Apopolypse Mode Apopolypse is unlocked at round 31. You get bloons non-stop until you run out of lives. games.title: TimeWarriors
games.description: Time Warriors is a strategy game where you lead your army through history, from the Stone Age to futuristic battles. Upgrade your troops, build powerful bases, and use unique units and tactics to defeat your enemies.
games.long_description: Time Warriors is a strategy game where you lead your army through history, from the Stone Age to futuristic battles. Upgrade your troops, build powerful bases, and use unique units and tactics to defeat your enemies. Master every era, outsmart your opponents, and rise to become the ultimate commander in this epic war game. How to Play TimeWarriors In TimeWarriors, your mission is to lead an evolving army through the ages, starting from the Stone Age. Your ability to deploy troops is directly tied to your food supply. For every three pieces of food, you can send out one soldier. This means you’ll need to manage your rations: stockpiling food carefully is your priority. At the start of the game, resources are scarce, but watching ads can give you a helpful boost, allowing you to send out more soldiers and gain an early advantage. The key to winning battles is timing and strategy. Deploy your troops when you have enough food, overwhelming your opponent before they can strengthen their defenses. Early levels allow you to outpace your enemies by cutting off their stronger units, such as soldiers on horseback, before they even have a chance to leave their base. This tactic works particularly well in Level 1, where the enemy wields essential clubs in the Stone Age. An example of soldier deployment is based on food at level 1: 1-2 pieces of food: No troops can be sent. 3 pieces of food: Deploy one soldier. 6 pieces of food: Deploy two soldiers, and so on. As you progress into Level 2, the game shifts into the Farm Age, where your foes are equipped with shovels and better weaponry. To keep up, you’ll need to use the rewards you’ve earned to upgrade your army. Invest in advanced tools and weapons that match the technology of the age, but balance this with maintaining a steady flow of soldiers to ensure you’re not overwhelmed. The longer battles progress, the more critical it becomes to upgrade your troops and your base to increase food production and withstand enemy attacks. Several upgrades can give you a significant edge in battle. A grindstone sharpens your soldiers’ weapons, allowing them to inflict more damage, while a war banner rallies your troops to fight harder as a unified force. You can also invest in faster food production to deploy soldiers at a quicker pace or increase your base health to hold out against enemy assaults. Victory in TimeWarriors depends on finding the perfect balance between attacking, defending, and resource management. With each successful battle, you’ll move closer to mastering the game’s historical ages. From the Stone Age(70,000–20,000 BC), where tools and settlements were in their infancy, to the Farm Age (12,000–4,000 BC), where agriculture and domestication laid the foundation for civilizations, every level challenges you to adapt and evolve. Lead your army wisely, and you’ll rewrite history with your conquests! More Games Like This There's no reason to stop here. If you liked TimeWarriors, you'll want to browse our action or battle category for more of the same. Battle Arena is a fun game that requires a strategic approach, where you create your team from over 50 unique heroes, each inspired by iconic characters you know and love. You may also like Mirrorland , where you explore Mirrorland's enchanted world, filled with challenges and adventures.. Bloons Tower Defense is another one to bookmark: it's a casual game where you build powerful defenses to stop the balloon invasion in this iconic TD game.

games.title: City Takeover
games.description: City Takeover is an addictive casual strategy game where your ultimate goal is to dominate the entire city by building your buildings as you occupy enemy buildings with your community. Strategically connect buildings to expand your influence, build the largest and most powerful army, and outmaneuver your opponents.
games.long_description: City Takeover is an addictive casual strategy game where your ultimate goal is to dominate the entire city by building your buildings as you occupy enemy buildings with your community. Strategically connect buildings to expand your influence, build the largest and most powerful army, and outmaneuver your opponents. Every decision counts as you grow your forces and launch tactical assaults to crush enemy strongholds. How to Play City Takeover In City Takeover, you are the blue team, and your mission is to capture buildings and expand your population while competing against the red team, your enemy. There are other colors on the board, such as yellow and green, which also pose a danger to building your empire. You start with one building, where your population slowly grows. The goal is to capture neutral (gray) or enemy (red) buildings by sending your population to them to destroy their layers of building and rebuild in your blue. You can send your population to them if you latch onto their building, forming a path from you to them. One of your buildings can form multiple paths, so you are not limited to just one. Creating paths with triangle buildings is best done towards enemy buildings. Triangles destroy enemy buildings at a faster rate. Creating paths with circular buildings is best done towards your own weaker buildings. Circular buildings build your own structures at a faster speed. If you outnumber the enemy or neutral building’s occupants, you take control and increase your population further. Strategy is key—you need to balance growing your population and capturing new buildings while avoiding stronger enemy buildings. As the game progresses, obstacles like walls add complexity, forcing you to plan your attacks wisely. The paths you create are also crucial in fortifying your buildings. Link blue buildings to blue buildings as much as possible to strengthen your community. Tip Capture as many buildings as early as possible. The key to winning is capturing as many buildings as possible at the start to grow your population faster than your opponents. Making the right connections is key! Circular buildings help heal allied buildings faster, while triangular buildings deal more damage to enemy structures. Use them strategically to gain an advantage in battle. You can "freeze" your opponent's time, which gives you an advantage. You will need to watch an ad to do so, but it is worth it on the more challenging rounds. More Games Like This If you want more casual games like this, we've got you covered! Try Bubble Shooter , where you match 3 of the same colored bubbles to pop the group, or Gold Miner , where you collect gold, stones, and minerals to reach your daily goal. Release Date December 2020 (Android and iOS) November 2021 (HTML5) Developer City Takeover was developed by Voodoo Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS

games.title: Sandbox City
games.description: Sandbox City is a simulation horror sandbox game where you roam a city taken over by zombies. You can drive cars, fight the enemy off with guns, complete missions for cash, and more, all while you try to avoid hungry zombies.
games.long_description: Sandbox City is a simulation horror sandbox game where you roam a city taken over by zombies. You can drive cars, fight the enemy off with guns, complete missions for cash, and more, all while you try to avoid hungry zombies. It's a physics-based playground with ragdolls, slow motion, and plenty of tension. How to Play Sandbox City The game starts with your character and accessories ready to be customized. This is your home base before getting into the gameplay. Start with customizing your character or your car using the two Customize buttons, or open Missions, the Shop, or Settings from the top right corner. It's also worth reviewing the full controls list on this screen, which has tabs for Keyboard, Xbox Controller, and PS Controller. The game also supports Xbox and PlayStation controllers. When you're ready, hit Play to enter the city. The first time you press Play, the Mission Guy walks you through a quick intro. He welcomes you to Sandbox City, warns you that zombies are on the loose and the citizens are in danger, points out the Shop where you can arm yourself, and tells you to come find him for missions. Follow the on-screen marker (it shows the distance, like "Talk to Mission Guy 114 m") to reach him and start earning. Exploring the City Once you're in the world, your HUD shows your health, money, and current weapon. A few things to look out for: Cargo drops : Wooden crates scattered around the city. Break them open for pickups. Cash pickups : Grab money as you explore to build up your balance. Cars : Walk up to a vehicle and press E to hop in. Press E again to exit. The subway : You can use the subway to get around the city (it's also a daily mission). Buy Home : Keep an eye out for the "Buy Home" building. Entering your home is a campaign mission that pays 1,000 cash. Missions Press M or tap the Missions icon to see two tabs: Campaign : Story missions like "Talk to Mission Guy" (50 cash) and "Enter home" (1,000 cash). Daily : Rotating challenges that reset every 24 hours, like killing 6 zombies with a gun (100 cash), killing 6 zombies with melee weapons (150 cash), and using the subway once (100 cash). There's also a Daily Reward of 500 cash you can claim each day. Missions are your main source of income, so check back daily. The Shop Press P or tap the Shop icon. It's organized into tabs: Featured : Highlights like Remove Ads, free Daily Ammo, and customization shortcuts. Weapons : Melee weapons like the Baseball Bat and Tennis Racket (50 cash each), plus the Grenade (250), MP-40 (500), and Assault Rifle (500). Most weapons can also be unlocked at a discount by watching an ad. Ammo : A free Daily Ammo pack of 50 rounds every 24 hours, plus Small (100 rounds), Large (300 rounds), and Sniper ammo packs. Boosts : Temporary 2-minute power-ups: Speed Boost, Money Pickup Multiplier (double cash from pickups), and Health Boost (raises max health to 150). Each costs 500 cash or an ad. Money : Cash packs, including a free 250 cash for watching an ad. Customization : Quick access to character and car customization. Customization Character: Choose from 28 skins (each with multiple material variants), then dress up with hats and helmets, masks, hairstyles, faces, and backpacks. There are over 100 accessory items, each costing 500 cash, or 100 if you watch an ad. Car: Pick your vehicle (like the Muscle Car), then change the paint, wheels, and other parts. Settings Worth a look before you play. You can adjust language, interface size, graphics quality (or let the game auto-detect the ideal preset), camera sensitivity, music, and sound. Two standouts: Slo-Mo after Collision : Toggles the cinematic slow motion when you crash. Disable Zombies : Turns zombies off entirely if you'd rather just cruise around the city in peace. Tips Claim your freebies daily. The free Daily Ammo, the Daily Reward, and the daily missions add up fast. Upgrade your weapons. The Baseball Bat and Tennis Racket only cost 50 cash, and the melee daily mission actually pays more than the gun one. More Games Like This If it’s adventure you’re after, have a go at games like House of Hazards , Getting Over It , or Getaway Shootout , guaranteed fun! Release Date November 2020 (Android) July 2021 (iOS) December 2021 (WebGL) Developer Yilmaz Kiymaz made Sandbox City - Cars, Zombies, Ragdolls!. Platforms Web browser Android iOS

games.long_description: Night City Racing is a car-driving game with fantastic races, epic stunts, and incredible supercars. Gear up for heart-pounding races and wild challenges that will test your skills! Rack up cash as you speed through the tracks and use it to upgrade to flashy, jaw-dropping cars. Whether you’re showing off your racing skills in epic two-player mode or going for solo glory, the trophy is yours for the taking. So buckle up, race hard, and let everyone know you’re the ultimate speed demon! How to Play Night City Racing Race against the competition Get in the driver’s seat and tackle some of the world’s best sports cars head-on. As you progress, there are 16 racing challenges to complete that increase in difficulty. Take on anything from the tricky corners of city streets to the open landscapes of an airfield in these thrilling races. In each race, you'll face four AI-controlled opponents, and you can also challenge a friend by playing on a split screen on the same computer. Complete various challenges Earn some extra cash by completing five fun challenges. For example, you’ll race against an airplane or the clock to the finish line on a range of obstacle-laced tracks. If you’re successful, the money flows into your account. Challenges can be repeated indefinitely, allowing you to accumulate currency for the next car upgrade. Go for a spin in the free drive Go stunt crazy in the open-world free-drive game mode. Rack up some cash by pulling off epic stunts and speeding around without limits in an open arena filled with ramps and other stunt-worthy objects. Buy and upgrade your supercar Use all that gold coinage you’ve earned as a reckless steering-wheel protagonist to expand your supercar collection. Tune up the engine and brakes, wear flashy new wheels, and treat yourself to a two-toned paint job. Night City Racing puts you in the driver’s seat. games.long_description: Mahjong Titans is an iconic Mahjong game where you continually match two tiles to remove them from the board until there are none left. games.title: War Mahjong
games.description: War Mahjong (Tiles of the Unexpected) is a mahjong-style tile-matching game with a war theme. Although it's not like typical mahjong games, your objective is to clear the tiles by clicking on groups with the same image.
games.long_description: War Mahjong (Tiles of the Unexpected) is a mahjong-style tile-matching game with a war theme. Although it's not like typical mahjong games , your objective is to clear the tiles by clicking on groups with the same image. How to Play There are two layers of tiles stacked on top of each other in War Mahjong. Your goal is to clear tiles that are the same and beside each other until all the tiles have disappeared. You clear them by clicking on groups of the same tile. When you clear tiles from the second layer it creates blank space that causes the tiles above to fall in their place. This can potentially create a combo effect. When you get combos, you'll earn bombs. A combo happens when you match tiles, and it creates a cascading effect that leads to more tiles being matched. The bombs are vital for end-game play, as you can use them to clear any tile when you have no matches left. More Games Like This One game with the same mechanics as War Mahjong is Simpsons Mahjong . It's the same concept but with Simpsons characters! Both games are part of our Flash games collection, which seeks to bring back the classics. For a more classic mahjong game check out Mahjongg Solitaire. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)
