Impress the judges with your flair and creativity as you aim to outshine the competition and claim the title of the most stylish contender! How to Play Fashion Battle Step into the spotlight and unleash your fashion flair! In this stylish game, you’ll dress up models from head to toe as they strut the runway, facing off against a rival in dazzling backdrops and themed competitions. Each battle starts with a unique theme, whether it’s nightclub chic, sporty vibes, or red-carpet formal. As your model walks down the runway side-by-side with your competitor, you’ll need to act fast, choosing the perfect outfits from the prompts that appear along the way. You’ll start in a simple swimsuit, but by the time you reach the end of the runway, your model should be dressed to impress. Be strategic with your choices: only three items are offered at each stop, so pick wisely. Missing a prompt or skipping a wardrobe item will leave your model incomplete, and the judges won’t be forgiving. If you win the competition, you’ll send your rival packing with style. But if you lose, it’s game over, so time to hit the road and try again. Remember, the key to victory is dressing for the theme. A sporty battle demands athletic attire, while a formal theme calls for elegance. Nail the look, steal the show, and claim your title as the ultimate runway star! games.title: Model Wedding
games.description: Model Wedding is the ultimate beauty dress-up game where you get to style four gorgeous brides on one of the biggest days of their lives. Some characters include supermodels and celebrities, so the pressure is on to make over these high-profile brides.
games.long_description: Model Wedding is the ultimate beauty dress-up game where you get to style four gorgeous brides on one of the biggest days of their lives. Some characters include supermodels and celebrities, so the pressure is on to make over these high-profile brides. Mix and match stunning dresses, dazzling shoes, elegant veils, stylish handbags, beautiful bouquets, and sparkling jewelry. Show off your fashionista flair as you create the perfect bridal looks. With endless combinations to explore, unleash your inner designer and have a blast making each bride shine! How to Play Model Wedding The game aims to get your bride looking as beautiful as possible on her big day. Once you choose one of the four blushing brides, you will be met with a series of choices to make. Your bride is an open canvas, dressed in nothing but her undergarments. You will need to choose from the following: Dress: Ball gown, A-line, drop shoulder, cowl neck, empire, scoop neck, sweetheart style. Which will you choose for that big moment? Corset and skirt: Lace, satin, crêpe, ruffle, sequin. You may love them all, but you can only choose one! Shoulder wrap: Fur wrap, bow tie wrap, shoulder cover, satin. Gloves: Long, short, satin, studded, or a simple diamond bracelet. Tough choice. Hairstyle: Long brown hair, ash blonde hair, short platinum hair, Tiara or Headpiece: Flowers, diamonds, side piece, or full. Heels: White, ice blue, red, gold, open-toe, pink stilettos. Go bold or traditional? Bouquet: Carnations, roses, pink, red. Who will catch this lovely bouquet? Purse: Gold, satin, flower, ruffle. Jewelry: Diamond necklace, ruby, gold. What jewels should your bride wear? Veil: Short, long, over the face, train. The final touches. Wedding photo background Say Cheese There is no way to "win" this game. Instead, your task is to have fun and play around with all the options, and there are many. Once you've chosen the perfect outfit, you have a few backgrounds to choose from for your bride, which include a pristine green garden, a seaside backdrop, a beautifully decorated bedroom, or a gorgeous historic atrium. Choose your backdrop and take as many photos as you like. There is a screenshot button where you can take photos of your bride and save them to your computer or phone. Share them with your friends and compare fashion phenomena or faux pas! More Games Like This If you love beauty games , you can also try some of our popular games like Love Tester , where you can discover your compatibility with your crush, and Good Doggo , where you train and groom your loyal canine companion. Release Date March 2017 (Android) May 2023 (WebGL) Developer Model Wedding is made by ARPAPLUS. Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android

games.title: Exhibit of Sorrows
games.description: Exhibit of Sorrows is a short horror game set in a curious circus-themed exhibit. Explore this strange interactive museum, follow instructions, and don’t upset the clown!
games.long_description: Exhibit of Sorrows is a short horror game set in a curious circus-themed exhibit. Explore this strange interactive museum, follow instructions, and don’t upset the clown! How to Play Exhibit of Sorrows Not all is well in the Exhibit of Sorrows. Progress through this progressively creepy exhibition and explore the strange dolls on display. Each piece of art is a puzzle, requiring interaction to reveal the keys. Be prepared to do terrible things to escape. The dolls you'll find in this unique art showcase are: Mr. Floaty Mr. Washy Ms. Stretch Mr. Handy The mood gets darker and more unsettling as you progress. You will encounter the same exhibitions in disturbing new forms as you become increasingly more panicked to escape. You will have to make cruel decisions in order to leave. Regardless of the sinister undertone to the game, there is a story to learn that will keep you gripped to the end. And the end totally depends on the choices you make during the game; there are different possible endings, so you can play this multiple times and discover the different finales. Exhibit of Sorrows is an excellent horror game worth seeing through. Short history of Exhibit of Sorrows This game was developed by Maxim Tsai, known as adayofjoy on Reddit and Itch.io, in collaboration with US animation artist Theresa Kao, who is interested in exploring how animation can be adapted to macabre contexts. Exhibit of Sorrows only took four months to develop, and it is a successful example of an indie game finding a large audience. Features Original concept 10-minute playtime Unsettling experience Free to play More Scary Games Browse our horror and scary categories for more strange, creepy, and terrifying games. Weird, although not frightening, playing experiences are also guaranteed by Friday Night Funkin' and Sprunki , if you are into music games. Release Date April 2022 Developer Maxim Tsai developed this game. Platform Web browser

games.description: Horror Tale Kidnapper is a frightening first-person horror adventure game. Solve the disturbing mystery of the missing children at Lakewitch.
games.long_description: Horror Tale Kidnapper is a frightening first-person horror adventure game. Solve the disturbing mystery of the missing children at Lakewitch. Who is the kidnapper, and why are they doing it? Where are the children disappearing, and how can we save them? It's up to you to find out. How to Play Horror Tale Kidnapper In this episode, your name is Tom, and you meet your friend Harry, who plans to keep you and the other kids from your neighborhood safe from the Kidnapper while you're waiting for your parents to return. The story begins with your parents leaving you at home. Your mom leaves you a note, asking to collect eggs from the hen-house and bring them to Tom. While cycling to your meeting point, you’ll encounter the famous Kidnapper… You'll have to find Tom and, together with him, you will fortify the tree house so the spooky Kidnapper can't get you again. On the way to your goal, puzzles, moments of fear, screams, unexpected twists and turns, and lots of fun await you! You will experience some jump scares in this story set in rural United States during the ‘90s, but Horror Tale is rated PEGI 12, so it’s very moderate and not as violent as other titles of the same genre. Locations to discover in Horror Tale Kidnapper: The Treehouse Tom’s parents’ Farm the Kidnapper's Lair The Sawmill the School In each of these, you’ll have to pick up items and use them with the scenarios you are presented with to progress, in escape-game style puzzles. games.title: Skinwalker
games.description: Skinwalker is an adventure puzzle escape game where you are trapped in the heart of a frozen wilderness. Your goal is to survive a winter forest while escaping from a relentless, terrifying creature.
games.long_description: Skinwalker is an adventure puzzle escape game where you are trapped in the heart of a frozen wilderness. Your goal is to survive a winter forest while escaping from a relentless, terrifying creature. Your survival hinges on your ability to gather essential items and stay one step ahead of a relentless and terrifying creature How to Play Skinwalker In Skinwalker, players find themselves alone in a chilling forest where their primary objective is to keep a fire burning to survive the cold while evading a terrifying creature known as the Skinwalker. To play effectively, you'll need to gather resources, such as sticks, to maintain the fire's warmth. As you explore the environment, beware of the dangerous Skinwalker, which disguises itself among the wildlife. You’ll encounter various items and tools, including a shovel, but it's crucial to understand how to use them strategically. You'll need to search for wooden planks to cross bridges and to locate the key to a safe. The game requires quick thinking, as you’ll have limited time before the cold sets in, and if you stray too far from your fire, you risk freezing to death. As you navigate through the forest, always be on high alert; the Skinwalker could be lurking around any corner. Utilize your gathered materials wisely and keep the fire alive to outlast the dangers that await you. The key to survival lies in managing your time and resources effectively while confronting the chilling threat that haunts the woods. This is not for the faint of heart, so tread lightly and keep that fire burning! More Games Like This There are plenty more adventure games you can play at CrazyGames. Continue the adventure with Mirrorland , a turn-based strategy set in a fantastical realm teeming with heroes and monsters; Magic World , a game where battles with mythical creatures and epic clan wars will keep you on the edge of your seat! Join existing clans or create your own to combine forces against other players or monsters. Release Date May 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: House of Celestina
games.description: House of Celestina is a 3D survival horror game that can keep you on the edge of your seat, but only for so long, as the game's objective is to find the key to escape. The game is designed to explore the House of Celestina, where you'll find clues and keys to help you figure out where you are and how to get out.
games.long_description: House of Celestina is a 3D survival horror game that can keep you on the edge of your seat, but only for so long, as the game's objective is to find the key to escape. The game is designed to explore the House of Celestina, where you'll find clues and keys to help you figure out where you are and how to get out. How to Play House of Celestina You have been kidnapped and find yourself in the house of the evil Celestina. Why are you there, and what are her plans? There is no time to think it through, or she is likely to sneak up on you. You must move around the house, scouring every dark corridor, room, and corner, all in the dark, with only the narrow light from a flashlight to guide you. Each level is a different puzzle to solve. You will receive clues along the way, sometimes from past victims of Celestina who didn’t make it out, to help you find what you are ultimately looking for - the keys to escape this house of ghouls. Be wary, as Celestina and her spooky companions will pop up when you least expect them, and when she does, your blood pressure will go through the roof! To lower your blood pressure, you need to press the space bar like your life depends on it because it does. If you don’t lower your blood pressure on time, it’s game over for you. Can you survive this creepy game and escape with your life? Tip Press the letter Q to adjust sensitivity and speed, giving you more time to solve the puzzles. Release Date April 2019 Developer Ricreator developed House of Celestina. games.title: Geometry Dash Subzero
games.description: Geometry Dash Subzero is a side-scrolling avoid game, another excellent title from the Geometry Dash series. Your task is to take control of your small yet speedy geometric cube and try to make your way through a series of (significantly) challenging levels!
games.long_description: Geometry Dash Subzero is a side-scrolling avoid game, another excellent title from the Geometry Dash series. Your task is to take control of your small yet speedy geometric cube and try to make your way through a series of (significantly) challenging levels! How to Play Geometry Neon Dash Subzero Geometry Neon Dash Subzero is not for the faint of heart. It is a high-speed action platformer game that requires timing, stealth, and memory. Guide your cube through levels upon levels, donned in dazzling neon lights while maintaining a constant jumping motion to avoid obstacles below, above, and even straight on. Be sure to time your jumps perfectly, or you will have to start from the beginning. As you progress, you must also try to collect white orbs that you can use to purchase new cube models from the store. Your points will be tallied at the end of each level, measuring your time, the number of jumps taken, and the number of level attempts. All factors into your points. Brief History of Geometry Dash Subzero This game was announced in December 2017 and released just a few days later. Its release was not casual or random, as it served as a marketing vehicle and a preview of the main game's upcoming update, marked by version 2.2. Geometry Dash Subzero is sometimes erroneously referred to as Geometry Neon Dash Subzero. Robert Topala, a game developer from Sweden who works under the studio name RobTop Games, is the person behind this and the other instalments of the Geometry Dash series. Topala, AKA "RobTop" or "RubRub," is a solo developer, responsible for almost all aspects of the game, including programming, level design, and some of the music tracks. Tips Be prepared for anything. Your cube will enter spheres that allow you to fly, and certain bounces will take you backwards. Keep your eye on the very next step and focus on being reactive. That’s how you will get ahead. Release Date January 2018 Features Subzero-themed maps with many sparkling lights Easy one-button controls Buyable new cube models The number of your attempts can be seen Developer The game was created by RobTop Games for mobile. CrystalKeeper7 made this Scratch version. Platforms Geometry Dash Subzero is a web browser game that is available on both desktop and mobile devices. More Games Like This If you are looking for more casual games, you may want to try Moto X3M and Idle Breakout .

games.title: Free Kick Classic (3D Free Kick)
games.description: Free Kick Classic (3D Free Kick) is an immersive sports soccer game that puts your precision and skill to the ultimate test. Step up to the pitch as you take on the challenge of firing free kicks from a variety of positions, each one more difficult than the last.
games.long_description: Free Kick Classic (3D Free Kick) is an immersive sports soccer game that puts your precision and skill to the ultimate test. Step up to the pitch as you take on the challenge of firing free kicks from a variety of positions, each one more difficult than the last. With stunning 3D graphics and lifelike physics, every shot feels realistic, giving you the thrill of being in a high-stakes match. Your goal is to perfectly execute your free kicks with just three attempts, but as you advance, the obstacles and defensive walls become increasingly difficult to overcome. The pressure mounts with each shot, and only the sharpest players will rise to the occasion. How to Play Free Kick Classic (3D Free Kick) Test your aiming skills Free Kick Classic is a simple game to play, yet it challenges your primary aim and instincts. Click on the ball, drag it toward the net, and release where you want to shoot. You can even affect the direction of the ball in mid-air. It can take a little while to get used to this mechanic, but it’s pretty intuitive and doesn’t take too long to understand. Survive the pitch You get three free kicks to make under increasingly difficult conditions. Starting with an empty net, the game progresses to have a goalie and, later, an increasing wall of defenders that really ramps up the challenge. When you’ve missed three goals, it’s game over. games.title: Kiomet
games.description: Kiomet is an immersive, real-time Io strategy game that challenges you to grow and defend your kingdom in a dynamic, ever-changing world. Expand your realm by strategically capturing new territories, all while defending against rival players and unpredictable threats.
games.long_description: Kiomet is an immersive, real-time Io strategy game that challenges you to grow and defend your kingdom in a dynamic, ever-changing world. Expand your realm by strategically capturing new territories, all while defending against rival players and unpredictable threats. Rally your forces to claim vital lands, strengthen your holdings with upgrades, and skillfully plan your conquests to rise to the top of the leaderboard. With every decision you make, you’ll inch closer to ultimate domination. How to Play Kiomet The goal of Kiomet is to expand your territory and master tactical moves in a dynamic real-time strategy setting. Take control by dragging units to towers to capture them, then fortify your strongholds by selecting and upgrading towers with enhancements. With 27 unique towers and ten diverse unit types marked by distinct symbols, every decision matters as you build your path to ultimate domination. Victory hinges on capturing and holding as many towers as possible, but defending your king is critical—losing it will cost you the game. Develop a strategy that balances offense and defense: build supply lines for resources, strengthen your buildings to boost capabilities, and consider alliances with other players to maximize your success. Working with allies can be a game-changer, as it may prevent being overrun by enemy forces while expanding your territory and resources. To gain ground, drag and drop your forces to unclaimed areas, but be strategic, as occupying new territory takes time, leaving you vulnerable to counterattacks. Follow the directional arrows to see where to expand next, but think carefully about each choice, as capturing the right buildings can amplify your strength. Make tactical decisions to avoid being surrounded, and position yourself to attack your enemies to claim more land and resources. In this multiplayer experience, teaming up with other players can add a crucial layer of strategy. Use the chat messaging function to request or accept alliances, which prevent attacks between allies. Keep communication open to coordinate defenses and time attacks, and build a formidable coalition. You can dominate the battlefield and expand your empire—one tower at a time. More Games Like This Once you’ve mastered the strategic art of Kiomet, check out some more of our IO games . Other popular titles include Bloxd.io , which features Minecraft graphics and various game modes. The game modes feature parkour, sandbox creativity, and combat; Fly or Die , a survival game now known as EvoWorld.io, where you begin as a small fly but not for long as you eat your way to a more powerful player; or lolbeans , a racing game where you have to avoid obstacles. Release Date September 2022 Developer Kiomet was made by Softbear Studios. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Super Star Car
games.description: Super Star Car is a driving Formula 1 racing game that puts you in the driver’s seat of high-speed action with a vast selection of cars and iconic circuits. Start your career as a professional racer and climb the ranks through thrilling campaign races, upgrading your car to enhance performance along the way.
games.long_description: Super Star Car is a driving Formula 1 racing game that puts you in the driver’s seat of high-speed action with a vast selection of cars and iconic circuits. Start your career as a professional racer and climb the ranks through thrilling campaign races, upgrading your car to enhance performance along the way. With simple controls that let you navigate sharp corners effortlessly, stunning 3D graphics, realistic engine sounds, and customizable camera views, the game offers an immersive and adrenaline-packed experience. How to Play Super Star Car Super Star Car is all about speed, precision, and strategy as you race through an exciting career mode. Every time you finish a race in this mode, you’ll earn stars and money, helping you climb the leaderboard and unlock new opportunities. Use your winnings to upgrade your car strategically, boosting its performance and ensuring that every race feels fresh and thrilling. The game features several tracks, each with its own unique challenges. You can select from iconic maps such as Arcport Circuit, Yafield Park, Riverside Circuit, and many more. Each track will test your skills, particularly when it comes to navigating those sharp curves. As expected, corners are the most challenging part of the game: you’ll need to hold your steering steady to maintain control. If you find yourself off the track, simply press the space bar to reset and get back into the action. To aid your racing strategy, there’s a mini-map in the bottom-left corner of your screen, giving you a sneak peek at upcoming turns and obstacles so you can prepare ahead. Keep an eye on your speedometer, located at the bottom-right corner, to adjust your pace and avoid spinning out on tight bends. One of the standout features of Super Star Car is its multiple view modes. You can race from a bird' s-eye view, chase your car from behind, or fully immerse yourself in the action by switching to the driver’s seat view. This versatility lets you experience the game from different perspectives, adding to its excitement and variety. The heart of the game lies in its career mode, where every win brings you closer to the coveted championship trophy. It’s not just about crossing the finish line first; it’s also about improving your car with carefully chosen upgrades. A better-performing car will help you dominate tougher races as you progress through the campaign. Get ready to tackle adrenaline-pumping tracks and outmaneuver your rivals. games.title: Doodle Road
games.description: Doodle Road is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity with problem-solving. In this fun browser game, your primary objective is to draw a path that will successfully guide a car from the starting point to the finish line.
games.long_description: Doodle Road is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity with problem-solving. In this fun browser game, your primary objective is to draw a path that will successfully guide a car from the starting point to the finish line. With a multitude of levels to explore, each one introduces new challenges and exciting obstacles that test your creativity and strategic thinking. Draw your way to victory and see how far your creativity can take you! How to Play Doodle Road You start in Doodle Road by practicing drawing a straight line from the car to the target. Sounds simple, right? Wait until you see how straight your line really is! The true challenge is how easy it is for your car actually to drive across that path. Next challenge – draw a line to the target, but now there's a wall in your way. Remember, your car can’t fly! So, think about how to draw your path – you don’t have to go over the wall; you can go under it! As you go, you'll see that drawing a straight line is harder than it looks. If you don’t start the line from behind your car, it’ll just dangle off into oblivion. How do you get over an L-shape? Or a huge gap in the ground? And the challenges keep coming. By level 5, your engine shuts off, so you’ll need your physics brain to figure out how to use hills and momentum to get across. Some levels have trampoline-like springs that’ll launch you toward your target. The challenges change each time, keeping you on your toes. Buckle up because it's going to be a bumpy ride, depending on how well you draw! More Games Like This The fun has just begun! Browse our casual games , including Marble Run , a fun simulation game where you create a marble run using a range of tools. Other casual games worth playing include World’s Hardest Game , a casual game that certainly lives up to its fun name all these years later, or Gold Miner , a classic casual mining game that will remind you of the 2000s gameplay. Release Date August 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Draw Climber
games.description: Draw Climber is a quirky racing casual game where you control your characters by sketching their legs. Create any shape to keep moving, and if you get stuck, simply redraw to overcome obstacles.
games.long_description: Draw Climber is a quirky racing casual game where you control your characters by sketching their legs. Create any shape to keep moving, and if you get stuck, simply redraw to overcome obstacles. Experiment with different designs to find the fastest way to the finish line. Can you outdraw and outrun the competition? How to Play Draw Climber In Draw Climber, you start as a simple square block placed on a wild obstacle course filled with everything from deep holes to steep steps, tricky valleys, and towering peaks. Your goal? Outrace your opponent to the finish line—but how you get there is entirely up to your imagination. To move, you'll need to draw “legs” for your block. A small pad at the bottom center of the screen lets you sketch out any shape you want, and once you do, your block springs to life, moving according to the design. Need speed on flat terrain? Draw wheel-like legs. Climbing a steep wall? Try claws or hooks. Facing wide gaps? Long legs might just do the trick. The fun part is you’re not locked into one design—you can switch up your leg shapes at any point during the course. But be careful: legs that are too long can get trimmed down in tight spaces, so balance is key. Tip Experiment with different shapes and strategies to adapt to the terrain. At the end of each race, your final burst of speed determines how far you’ll launch—and the farther you fly, the more points you’ll rack up. Creativity, timing, and a bit of physics know-how are your best tools to come out on top. More Games Like This Ready for more fun? Browse our casual game collection for more gameplay. Try titles like Frogger , a classic arcade game. Control the frog over hazardous roads and rivers to reach the other side; Papa’s Pizzeria , a fun game where you manage a pizzeria by taking orders, adding pizza toppings, putting the pizzas in the oven, and cutting the pizzas; Pop It Game , a satisfying arcade game to pop all the bubbles in different character figures.

games.description: Ragdoll Throw Challenge is a physics-based casual game where you control a wobbly character, help them grab weapons, and fling them at your enemies for ultimate chaos and fun! The gameplay is simple, but movements can be complex and challenging to master.
games.long_description: Ragdoll Throw Challenge is a physics-based casual game where you control a wobbly character, help them grab weapons, and fling them at your enemies for ultimate chaos and fun! The gameplay is simple, but movements can be complex and challenging to master. How to Play Ragdoll Throw Challenge There are several challenges you can choose from at the start of the game, all of which are quite different from each other but have a common thread: simple physical movements with very big repercussions. You can choose from various gameplays: Bow and Arrow Your ragdoll is standing on a ledge with a bow and arrow. Rotate your arms clockwise or counterclockwise, point, shoot, and aim. You won't always get your opponent to fall off the game screen when struck. Depending on the intensity of the hit, you may need a few arrows. Each challenge gets harder with ragdolls at various points on the game screen. Dynamite This challenge can be trickier. Your ragdoll's mission is to grab dynamite and throw it towards your opponent. Are you throwing it too far, too close, over the edge? You must find that perfect balance of rotating your hands, grabbing the object, and letting go to get to the next challenge. Easier said than done. Simple Arrow Click the play button at the start of the game, and you will be equipped with a simple arrow. This challenge will teach you the basics of this game. The arrow and movements very much mirror those of the Dynamite challenge. Basketball You aim to dunk the ball in the hoop. How much force is needed to shoot, and how far should you be before letting go of the ball? Practice makes perfect in this challenge. Cannon Hold, release, and fire! You will shoot your ragdoll out of a cannon and get him safely on a platform. Don't be afraid to hit him against other platforms to lose a bit of force and gain a bit of direction - all for the sake of physics! In-Game Shop Every successfully completed challenge earns you one golden coin. When you have enough, you can spend them in the shop and buy cosmetic improvements for your character: you can purchase hats, t-shirts, gloves, and trousers. These do not affect the playability of the game but only its aesthetics. Challenge your reflexes as you intercept your rival's shots and maintain control over the game: master timing and precision to dominate the court and secure victory in intense matches. How to Play Basket Battle Basket Battle is a fast-paced, action-packed game that puts your basketball skills and strategic thinking to the ultimate test. Your objective is simple: shoot the basketball into the hoop before your opponent does. But don’t let this simplicity fool you, this game is packed with twists, surprises, and escalating challenges that will keep you on your toes. The gameplay starts with intuitive controls that let you tap, aim, and launch your basketball toward the hoop. You want to score, but it's not just about scoring. You’ll need to outmaneuver your opponents, disrupt their shots, and position yourself strategically to stay ahead. Bumping into their basketball mid-air or intercepting their trajectory can give you the edge in tight matches. Each level introduces new obstacles and mechanics, keeping the gameplay fresh and dynamic. Customization adds another layer of fun to Basket Battle. Unlock unique skins for your basketballs and players, showing off your style as you dominate the court. These features keep players engaged as they climb the ranks from beginner to seasoned pro. For those seeking a more significant challenge, the game offers tournaments where you can test your skills against tougher opponents and earn rare rewards. Advanced techniques, like shooting from tricky angles or bouncing the ball off walls for dramatic shots, allow for creative gameplay that can surprise even seasoned players. games.title: TileMan.io
games.description: TileMan.io is an awesome multiplayer IO game in which you must try to claim as much territory as possible. You start with a random block color, and you must try to convert all the blocks on the map into the same color.
games.long_description: TileMan.io is an awesome multiplayer IO game in which you must try to claim as much territory as possible. You start with a random block color, and you must try to convert all the blocks on the map into the same color. This might sound easy, but don't forget there are other players to contend with! While heavily influenced by popular predecessors like Splix.io and Paper.io, Tileman.io offers additional features that distinguish it from these older games. For example, here you can pause the movement of your character by pressing E or P, a tactical move that can enable you to eliminate opponents more easily. How to Play TileMan.io TileMan.io gameplay is relatively simple, but the strategy is not as straightforward. You are in the center of a grid board, and your objective is to expand your territory by claiming more and more tiles. To do this, move your mousepad or use the WASD keys to move left, right, up, and down. Easy enough? The catch is that you need to expand your territory without getting cut off by one of the many other players in the game. You can get cut off if your line of path is cut. Be careful because you can actually cut within your own path and lose the game by accidentally killing yourself. The only way to protect yourself is by remaining on your territory, but doing so won't get your expansion strategy very far. Territory is "claimed" when you convert blocks by creating a complete square—the enclosed blocks will turn to your color once you close the gap. If you go too far and attempt to expand too fast, you will find yourself too far from safety and will likely be killed by an opponent player. You must avoid your opponents or try to trap them within your squares and make them crash into you. Use a careful approach, and don't go in all guns blazing! Can you conquer the TileMan arena? How is Tileman.io scored? Tileman.io is scored based on the number of tiles captured, the number of amounts killed, and rank. Tileman.io Game Options Classic Extreme Speed No Kills Rats Arena Classic game In this game, you play with multiple opponents in an attempt to expand your territory across almost 160,000 tiles. Gameplay moves at a quick pace, but achieving continental domination is possible with persistence and caution. Extreme Speed Similar to the classic game, this one is significantly more challenging, so extreme caution or extreme risk will win. The choice is yours. No Kills Gameplay is similar to the classic game, but you don't get killed by opponents cutting into your path. Instead, lose your pathline and have just a few seconds to return to safe territory. Don't stray too far, or you won't make it back, and then it's game over. Rats Opponents are everywhere in this game, the map is smaller and there is more density. Keep your captures close to home base. Arena The gameplay in Arena is almost like a "practice space". There are no opponents, and approximately 1,500 squares to capture. Sounds easy, but it's also easy to become too confident and make a mistake. More Games Like This There are plenty more games like Tileman.io in our Io selection. In Agar io you compete against other players for dominance. Alternatively, you can try Sprunki or Friday Night Funkin' , two popular music games that are great fun. Release Date December 2018 Features A .io game that is inspired by Paper.io . You can stop the movement Various game modes, including an Extreme Speed mode to play the game at an insane speed Playable on mobile browsers Platforms Tileman.io is a web browser game (desktop and mobile).

You are in the center of a grid board, and your objective is to expand your territory by claiming more and more tiles. To do this, move your mousepad or use the WASD keys to move left, right, up, and down. Easy enough? The catch is that you need to expand your territory without getting cut off by one of the many other players in the game. You can get cut off if your line of path is cut. Be careful because you can actually cut within your own path and lose the game by accidentally killing yourself. The only way to protect yourself is by remaining on your territory, but doing so won't get your expansion strategy very far. Territory is "claimed" when you convert blocks by creating a complete square—the enclosed blocks will turn to your color once you close the gap. If you go too far and attempt to expand too fast, you will find yourself too far from safety and will likely be killed by an opponent player. You must avoid your opponents or try to trap them within your squares and make them crash into you. Use a careful approach, and don't go in all guns blazing! Can you conquer the TileMan arena?

games.title: Bridge Race
games.description: Bridge Race is a competitive casual collect-building game where you gather blocks to construct your bridge while outsmarting rivals. Stay alert as other players may try to steal your progress, adding an exciting twist to the challenge.
games.long_description: Bridge Race is a competitive casual collect-building game where you gather blocks to construct your bridge while outsmarting rivals. Stay alert as other players may try to steal your progress, adding an exciting twist to the challenge. Strategize and race to complete your bridge first in this thrilling test of skill and speed! How to Play Bridge Race Bridge Race is an oddly satisfying game where you aim to collect as many blocks of your color as possible and carry them across the board to build a bridge. The objective is to create a path that leads you to the next collection area and, ultimately, to the finish line. Victory is sweet, but the challenge continues as each round gets more difficult. The game is designed to be both simple and rewarding, with delicate sounds that create a satisfying atmosphere. You'll encounter obstacles like slides and elevators, which add a fun element as you navigate through the level, taking you closer to the next challenge. But you’re not alone in this race. Other players are also collecting blocks to build their own bridges, and they’re more than happy to challenge you along the way. If you’re not careful, your opponents can sabotage your progress by building over your bridge, undoing all the hard work you’ve done. And if you run out of blocks and need to return to collect more, be prepared for your opponents to steal your blocks, changing their color to match yours and forcing you to start the process over again. You’ll also have to watch out for being knocked down by other players, which causes you to lose all the blocks on your back. Throughout the game, you’ll encounter rewards scattered across the map. Green rewards multiply the number of blocks you carry, giving you an advantage, while red ones will diminish your collection, so it’s important to avoid them at all costs. Stay vigilant, collect wisely, and you’ll be on your way to victory! The game is full of obstacles to watch out for, and gates scattered around each floor can make or break your race. Green gates boost your points, either multiplying what you're carrying by x2 or adding a flat bonus like +9, while red gates subtract blocks, with penalties like -5, so don’t run through those! The multiplier gates are where strategy comes in - the more blocks you have on your back, the more it makes sense to walk through multipliers. So for example, if you have three blocks on your back and you walk through a x2 multiplier, it doesn’t really pay off as much as it would with more blocks to double. It’s also a good idea to look below you. Some floors have open holes cut right into the middle of the board, and falling through one drops you off the platform entirely, so steer around them even if the shortest route to a block cluster runs straight across. The safest route is rarely the straightest one. Every level is a race to the podium, and finishing last means failing the level outright. When that happens, you can restart and try again or watch a short ad to skip ahead to the next level. Finish first and you're crowned on the top spot of the podium with a Victory banner and three stars, with your closest rivals filling out second and third place below you. More Games Like This Unwind and keep the fun going with some of our most popular casual games , including Happy Wheels , a physics-based game with tricky levels and unique characters, and if you want something more involved and community-based, try Grow A Garden , where you can look for the magic rainbow flower. Other fun games include Papas Pizzeria and Brick Breaker .

games.title: Stickman Project
games.description: Stickman Project is a 2D physics-based action battle game where you take on your opponents by unleashing mutant chaos. You’ll battle through dynamic levels using fluid combat and fast reflexes.
games.long_description: Stickman Project is a 2D physics-based action battle game where you take on your opponents by unleashing mutant chaos. You’ll battle through dynamic levels using fluid combat and fast reflexes. Choose between endless more or level-based missions and test how long you can survive in this intense, stick-figure showdown. Made by Neron's Brother, Creators of Supreme Duelist. How to Play Stickman Project Stickman Project is a ragdoll physics-based action game, which means you’ll never have complete control over your character’s movements. That’s part of the fun; every battle is unpredictable. The game combines fluid combat, tricky level layouts, and a variety of weapons, challenging you to push through each stage and reach the next. The first few levels are simple and serve as a good opportunity to get used to your character’s movement. You’ll encounter obstacles that require you to use the jump control repeatedly and persist until you clear them. As you face enemies, you can fight barehanded with kicks, but weapons give you a significant advantage. Learn to pick them up quickly, and watch out for bats, swords, shields, dynamite, and potions that boost your size and power. At the end of each round, you’ll need to project yourself into an elevator to get to the next round, but it won’t open until you’ve defeated every enemy on the level. If it stays closed, search for any opponents you might have missed. Each round becomes progressively more complex, with more dangerous enemies and trickier environments. Master your movement, collect weapons, and adapt to the chaos to survive. More Games Like This Want more action? Browse our action collection for even more fun! A few recommended games include Snow Rider 3D to satiate your need for speed, Geometry Dash Online for intense side-scrolling action, or Moto X3M for thrilling dirt bike rides.

games.long_description: Motherload is a classic mining game where you dig deep into the ground of an alien planet to mine various raw materials. This addictive title was released in 2004 using Flash, but you can play it here in HTML5. How to Play Motherload Mine deep into the ground Your mission is to mine resources, bring them back to the mineral processing plant, and sell them. Refuel and sell your minerals Initially, your mining vehicle won’t be able to travel far, and you’ll need to resurface frequently to refuel and sell your resources. Upgrade your capabilities You can purchase various upgrades to your fuel tank, cargo capacity, drill, engine, hull, and radiator using your earned money. You’ll find these at the junk shop. Beside this shop is the emendation station where you can get your hull repaired. You can also purchase one-off items like spare fuel tanks and explosives here. Find rare artifacts and resources Once you’ve made some upgrades, you’ll be able to travel deeper into the ground safely, where you’ll find more valuable minerals like platinum and emeralds. Once you hit roughly -1000 ft, you’ll also find religious artifacts that instantly grant you $50,000. Motherload Tips There are precious resources the deeper you go, like religious artifacts - so focus on getting there as quickly as you can Use backup fuel tanks to prolong your mining expeditions Use your flying ability to avoid fall damage Running out of petrol makes you explode, so think carefully about how far you travel More Games Like This Enjoy playing classic web games? games.long_description: Bartender the Right Mix is a casual game where you help the bartender mix drinks in the right ratios to make the ultimate cocktail. Choose from a shelf full of drinks, such as Vodka, Whiskey, Vermouth, Tripple-Sec, Gin, etc., and mix them together for the ultimate drink for a good night out. Add ice or lemon to the drinks to give them that extra kick, but be careful. Mixing the drinks in the wrong amounts or simply mixing the wrong drinks could end in the worst of ways! How to Play Bartender the Right Mix First, you must add your choice of spirit to begin your cocktail. Maybe you will choose Kahula, Vermouth, or even Tequila? Next, you can add an accompanying juice such as orange, lemon, and cranberry. Will you add some ice to cool your drink or maybe a lemon to add a little sourness? Shake your drink and serve your concoction to Miguel. Will he like your cocktail, or will it send him to an early grave? Can you create the right mix and serve the perfect drink? No bartending school is required! Bartender The Right Mix is a Flash game that, thanks to Ruffle, can now be played without the discontinued plugin. Tip Don't shake your drink too long, or you might inadvertently explode. Every move counts when you're a bartender so make them smooth and deliberate. When you earn enough XP, your civilization will evolve through the ages, offering new technologies to utilize in combat. How to Play Age of War You start in simple times. Your mission? To leap from one precarious rooftop to another with the finesse of a seasoned freestyle runner, all while maintaining breakneck speed. Collect stars and coins during your run and jump across buildings' roofs, smash office windows while doing so, and carefully plan your path to avoid enemies trying to block you. Use the red trampolines to reach further and navigate the obstacles that this challenging urban landscape presents. Initially launched in June 2020 for iOS, followed by an Android release in September of the same year, Rooftop Run offers intuitive controls that put you in command of every move. games.title: Find Me: Lost Objects
games.description: Find Me: Lost Objects is a puzzle adventure where you join Octo the Octopus on a thrilling quest across stunning underwater realms and even into outer space! Uncover hidden objects, face exciting challenges, and assist Octo in rescuing his true love.
games.long_description: Find Me: Lost Objects is a puzzle adventure where you join Octo the Octopus on a thrilling quest across stunning underwater realms and even into outer space! Uncover hidden objects, face exciting challenges, and assist Octo in rescuing his true love. With enchanting worlds, surprising twists, and heartwarming moments, this quest will keep you hooked from start to finish! How to Play Find Me: Lost Objects In Find Me Lost Objects, you'll work through several rounds, including Hello Octopo, Sweet Home, Abandoned Reef, Sea Trip, Ancient World, Walk in Space, In the Insect World, Ghost Town, Polar Expedition, Toward the Dream, and Pirate Island. Let’s start with the first level, Hello, Octopo. Meet Octopo, who needs your help in this point-and-click game! Their friend Octopka has disappeared today, and your task is to find her hats. The first one is a striped black-and-white hat with a red ribbon. There are plenty of hats around, but you won’t move on until you find it. You can explore by holding the mouse and moving the landscape, zooming in and out – there’s more to this underwater area than meets the eye. Next, Octopo’s hats are dark brown with a brim, and finding them won’t be easy with the colorful, vast sea around you. Keep your eyes peeled! Octopo is getting worried because their favorite Octopushka hasn’t returned, so they suggest heading outside to look for her. Your next task awaits in Sweet Home, where you’ll need to find Octopushka. In Sweet Home, ask around to see if anyone has seen Octopushka. You’ll also need to find a few more objects. One hint is that Octopushka asked the chef Octopus if they had any mushrooms for soup – she must have gone looking for them! Another octopus mentions she was last seen by a fish near the Abandoned Reef, a dangerous place filled with pirates. Better get moving! Click on seahorses and fish for points! As you move through each round, new underwater challenges await. Look for items listed in the right menu by exploring the image, and if you’re stuck, use the hint button shaped like a magnifying glass. Good luck! More Games Like This Explore our adventure category for even more excitement. Jump into Battle Arena , a gripping RPG that combines intense action with strategic battles; Magic World , an adventure puzzle game where you defeat mythical creatures and fierce enemies through clever gem-matching; or Dead Land Survival , a survival horror experience set in a zombie-infested apocalypse, where you rely on powerful skills gained during your journey to stay alive.

games.title: Paint Room Escape
games.description: Paint Room Escape is a puzzle escape game where creativity is key to finding your way out of a room with four walls, a desk, a shelf, an air conditioner, a safe, and a locked door. The only way out is to problem-solve your way to freedom by solving riddles using colors, paints, and painting tools that can be found throughout the room.
games.long_description: Paint Room Escape is a puzzle escape game where creativity is key to finding your way out of a room with four walls, a desk, a shelf, an air conditioner, a safe, and a locked door. The only way out is to problem-solve your way to freedom by solving riddles using colors, paints, and painting tools that can be found throughout the room. Each clue will lead to the next, until finally, your colorful journey leads you to an exit. How to Play Paint Room Escape In Paint Room Escape, your objective is to unlock doors by solving color-based puzzles. One of the first tasks is to paint the colorless door using hints scattered throughout the room. Search for items like palettes and pencil holders and get guided into selecting the correct colors. For example, one puzzle requires painting a door with specific color patterns by observing how circles and squares are divided on a palette. As you progress, different combinations of colors help you unlock new areas and doors, with red and yellow paint being crucial early on. As you move through the rooms, you will come across more complex puzzles. In one scenario, you must rotate color samples and match a sequence of pale blue to dark blue shades. You'll also encounter digit-based locks, like a door that requires entering a secret code to unlock. Completing these challenges rewards you with items such as paint tubes, allowing you to progress by filling in corresponding door sections. New color clues emerge as you rinse objects in water, revealing hidden numbers and hints for further puzzles. Manipulating various tools, such as temperature controls and stencils, adds even more challenging layers of complexity. At one point, you must adjust the temperature to paint the door a certain color, then adjust it once more to switch to another color. One of the final challenges involves arranging pencils, rotating objects, and solving shape-based puzzles to activate switches and unlock the exit door. Mixing colors like blue and yellow to create green and using a screwdriver to access hidden compartments are essential steps to achieving your ultimate creative goal—escape by color! More Games Like This Want more puzzle game fun? Try some of our popular games like Zoom Boom , a fun animal-themed match-3 game with a mission-based style; Candy Riddles , a puzzle match-3 game where you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels; or Fairyland Merge & Magic , a casual merge game where every move you make has the power to shape your own whimsical world. Check out more of our escape games as well!

games.title: Burnout Drift
games.description: Burnout Drift is a drifting game in our driving category featuring a range of custom cars and tracks. Choose your ride, take it to the streets, and earn money for your drifting skills.
games.long_description: Burnout Drift is a drifting game in our driving category featuring a range of custom cars and tracks. Choose your ride, take it to the streets, and earn money for your drifting skills. Use your cash to customize your car and buy epic new motors to take around the tracks. How to Play Burnout Drift The first car you start with is a Ford Mustang, but there are drifting classics like the Nissan 350z to pick-ups and supercars like the Bugatti Veyron. You can buy these powerhouse vehicles when you earn enough. You can use the money you earn from doing awesome drifts to buy new cars. Manage your speed and steering to keep your car drifting. Balancing acceleration and braking helps maintain longer drifts, which earn more points. There are three excellent tracks to zoom your latest set of wheels around in Burnout Drift. Rocky Pass is a typical mountain track with plenty of tricky turns and long corners — it’s a great middle-ground track. Ridge is a wide city road - probably the best track for drifting once you get into it. Winter Pass is a little tougher, featuring snow that slows you down and causes additional sliding. Tips The easiest track to drift and earn money on is the Ridge The longer you keep up the same drift, the quicker you’ll earn points Crashing will cause you to lose all your drift points, so be careful! games.description: Garage Parking is an awesome and unique driving game in which you must test your parking and driving skills in a series of multi-story car parks! You must hop into your vehicle and race around the parking lots carefully to avoid taking any damage.
games.long_description: Garage Parking is an awesome and unique driving game in which you must test your parking and driving skills in a series of multi-story car parks! You must hop into your vehicle and race around the parking lots carefully to avoid taking any damage. Follow the markers and head for your designated parking space! How to Play Garage Parking The goal of Garage Parking is to master a variety of challenging parking scenarios using smooth, easy-to-learn controls and realistic graphics. The game begins in one of the most common places around, you guessed it—a parking garage, one of the best places to really show off your parking skills. You can fully customize your car, from neon lights and paint color to the roof, spoiler, rims, engine, brakes, and speed. At the start, you'll only have access to basic options like choosing your car's color and under glow neon. But as you progress, you'll unlock and earn upgrades to personalize every aspect of your ride, making it truly your own set of wheels. Upgrades Enhancing your engine, brakes, and speed will cost $1,000 each—roughly the reward for expertly parking ten cars. Invest wisely to boost your vehicle’s performance and dominate every parking challenge! The gameplay is fairly simple: use the WASD or arrow keys to navigate your car and the space bar as a brake. The car won't move unless pressed down, so the challenge is maneuvering smoothly with precision and ease. Arrows will direct you to where you need to park, so don't haphazardly park anywhere. It will add time to your final success tally. As you successfully park in each level, and there are forty of them, you'll earn cash rewards that can be used to upgrade and customize your vehicle with cool features. From precision parking to more complex maneuvers, every challenge is an opportunity to prove your skills behind the wheel. Do you have what it takes to park in the most challenging of circumstances? More Games Like This Once you’ve mastered parking, it’s time to take it to the roads. games.description: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense is a thrilling action defense game where players must fight against hordes of zombies trying to overrun the world. games.long_description: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense is a thrilling action defense game where players must fight against hordes of zombies trying to overrun the world. In this post-apocalyptic scenario, your mission is to defend cities across the globe by strategically placing soldiers with different weapons, each offering unique stats like damage, shooting speed, and reload speed. How to Play World Z Defense The world is in chaos, and only you can save it. World Z Defense puts you on the front line of a global zombie outbreak, and it’s up to you to save humanity. No pressure. You will start at an ammunition base, where you can recharge your ammunition and prepare for the relentless zombie onslaught. Zombies may be slow, but they’re persistent and will stop at nothing to break through your defenses. To defend yourself, click, drag, and drop your character to aim at approaching zombies. Once you’ve aimed, your position is locked, and all your bullets fire in the chosen direction until you return to the ammunition base. Timing is everything—your ability to take down multiple zombies at once depends on careful planning and aim. As you play, you’ll earn rewards that allow you to upgrade your character, improving crucial stats like reload time and firepower. These upgrades become essential as the hordes grow larger and faster, leaving you less time to react. If zombies break through your barricade, it’s game over—so don’t let your guard down. Explore a map filled with different geographical areas, each teeming with zombies waiting to be defeated. Your strategy is key: try to line up as many zombies as possible in your line of fire, as you can only shoot in one direction when away from the ammunition base. Use your resources wisely to become a more potent fighter and save the world from the undead menace. You've got this! More Games Like This Why stop the excitement here? games.title: Stick Epic Fighter
games.description: Stick Epic Fighter is an action-packed, arcade physics-based fighting game where you are in control of a stick fighter to battle enemies in a dynamic, geometric world. Your mission is to evolve your character into an unstoppable force by unlocking powerful upgrades, mastering epic combos, and unleashing devastating fatalities that will destroy your foes.
games.long_description: Stick Epic Fighter is an action-packed, arcade physics-based fighting game where you are in control of a stick fighter to battle enemies in a dynamic, geometric world. Your mission is to evolve your character into an unstoppable force by unlocking powerful upgrades, mastering epic combos, and unleashing devastating fatalities that will destroy your foes. Conquer waves of enemies with precision and skill as you dominate each battle. Only after crushing every opponent will you unlock the portal to the next level, where even more significant challenges await. Sharpen your reflexes, perfect your strategies, and prove you have what it takes. How to Play Stick Epic Fighter You begin in a classic arcade-style side-scrolling screen, where you’ll quickly get accustomed to the game’s controls. Use the up arrow to jump, the down arrow to attack, and the left and right arrows for movement. Before long, you’ll encounter enemies: attack them by holding the down arrow to unleash a series of sword strikes. Holding down the attack key continuously lets you deliver multiple hits, which is essential since enemies require several strikes to be defeated. Though you can jump and sprint past enemies to reach the end of the level quickly, you won’t be able to progress to the next round until all foes are eliminated. If you leave any behind, you’ll have to backtrack and take them out. Once every enemy is defeated, and you reach the final portal, your stickman will celebrate with a happy dance, signaling that you’ve successfully cleared the level! As you advance, the difficulty ramps up with more enemies and tougher challenges, so stay alert and fast on your feet! Use the arrows for guidance on enemy locations and areas you may have missed. Throughout the course, prompts will also direct you to jump to high platforms or descend into lower areas. Each round rewards you with points that can be used to purchase upgrades, boosting your power and making it easier to defeat stronger enemies. Plus, you can customize your stickman by changing skins, giving your hero a fresh look as you fight your way through each increasingly intense round! More Games Like This Keep the fun coming. Browse our action category for more games that pack a punch. If you liked Stick Epic Fighter, you might like House of Hazards , where you avoid traps and finish tasks faster than your friends; Getaway Shootout , a two-player game where you race three others to the finish line; or Cuphead , a boss battle where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead. Check out our arcade games for even more fun.

games.description: Mini Mine is a thrilling adventure arcade game where you dig deep, fight fierce monsters, and trade smartly to save Noob’s kidnapped girlfriend. Mine resources to upgrade weapons and tools, build a thriving village, and uncover hidden treasures.
games.long_description: Mini Mine is a thrilling adventure arcade game where you dig deep, fight fierce monsters, and trade smartly to save Noob’s kidnapped girlfriend. Mine resources to upgrade weapons and tools, build a thriving village, and uncover hidden treasures. Unlock unique characters, set up automated production, and take down Cheater in an epic showdown! How to Play Mini Mine Your mining adventure starts with an honorable task: freeing a kidnapped noob girl trapped by Cheater and claiming the coveted god’s pickaxe. Your mission includes exploring new islands, building bridges, and uncovering unique tools to assist you in your journey. Resources are key, and they can be gathered by delving into the mine. Your primary goal is to mine gems and resources of various types, including orange, green, blue, and white gems, coins, stones, and more. Start mining by walking to the main block and chipping away continuously. Extracted rewards will scatter: simply walk over them to collect them. Keep an eye out for alerts to “jump into the portal.” Entering the portal will occasionally replenish your mine, revealing new, unique, and more valuable resources to collect. However, note that the mine won't always replenish when you jump into the portal. Mining has a gradual pace and requires persistence. The more you mine, the more rewards and currency you accumulate, unlocking the ability to purchase better tools and progress to higher levels. Early levels may feel slow: for instance, by level 2, you might have only mined seven coins. But patience is essential, as higher rewards and tools become accessible as you advance. Tools & Upgrades Use your earnings to purchase tools and potions that enhance your mining efficiency: Potions start at $2500 and include: Double block destruction speed. Double the number of mined items. Increase resource production from quarries and sawmills. Pickaxe cost Stone Pickaxe: $100 Iron Pickaxe: $500 Golden Pickaxe: $2000 Diamond Pickaxe: $5000 Cheater Pickaxe: $15,000 Game Tips Sell your stones. This will allow you to boost your purchase power by selling stones at the store. Slow and steady wins the race. Prices are high, so consistent mining is crucial to afford the best tools and upgrades. content_guide.summary: Mini Mine is a thrilling adventure arcade game where you dig deep, fight fierce monsters, and trade smartly to save Noob’s kidnapped girlfriend. Mine resources to upgrade weapons and tools, build a thriving village, and uncover hidden treasures.
content_guide.how_to: Your mining adventure starts with an honorable task: freeing a kidnapped noob girl trapped by Cheater and claiming the coveted god’s pickaxe. Your mission includes exploring new islands, building bridges, and uncovering unique tools to assist you in your journey. Resources are key, and they can be gathered by delving into the mine. Your primary goal is to mine gems and resources of various types, including orange, green, blue, and white gems, coins, stones, and more. Start mining by walking to the main block and chipping away continuously. Extracted rewards will scatter: simply walk over them to collect them. Keep an eye out for alerts to “jump into the portal.” Entering the portal will occasionally replenish your mine, revealing new, unique, and more valuable resources to collect. However, note that the mine won't always replenish when you jump into the portal. Mining has a gradual pace and requires persistence. The more you mine, the more rewards and currency you accumulate, unlocking the ability to purchase better tools and progress to higher levels. Early levels may feel slow: for instance, by level 2, you might have only mined seven coins. But patience is essential, as higher rewards and tools become accessible as you advance. Tools & Upgrades Use your earnings to purchase tools and potions that enhance your mining efficiency: Potions start at $2500 and include: Double block destruction speed. Double the number of mined items. Increase resource production from quarries and sawmills. Pickaxe cost Stone Pickaxe: $100 Iron Pickaxe: $500 Golden Pickaxe: $2000 Diamond Pickaxe: $5000 Cheater Pickaxe: $15,000 Game Tips Sell your stones. This will allow you to boost your purchase power by selling stones at the store. Slow and steady wins the race. Prices are high, so consistent mining is crucial to afford the best tools and upgrades. Invest in potions and upgraded pickaxes as soon as possible to speed up your progress.

games.title: Stickman Epic
games.description: Stickman Epic is a fast-paced action arcade game that puts your fearless stickman hero on a mission to eliminate hordes of relentless zombies. In this adrenaline-charged adventure, your objective is to battle through waves of enemies while upgrading your character to become stronger and more resilient to even more difficult challenges along the way to victory.
games.long_description: Stickman Epic is a fast-paced action arcade game that puts your fearless stickman hero on a mission to eliminate hordes of relentless zombies. In this adrenaline-charged adventure, your objective is to battle through waves of enemies while upgrading your character to become stronger and more resilient to even more difficult challenges along the way to victory. How to Play Stickman Epic In Stickman Epic, your main goal is to clear each level by defeating zombies and bosses while constantly upgrading your hero. The game will start with a quick tutorial teaching you what your stickman is capable of. You will learn to walk left and right, easily enough. Other moves are jumps and double jumps: these are crucial to master as levels progress. The space bar is used to fight your opponent. Multiple clicks will do the job. There are 15 chapters in Stickman Epic, and they include: Chapter 1: Start of the journey Chapter 2: Dive Chapter 3: Giant Zombie Chapter 4: Spider nest Chapter 5: Minecart battle Chapter 6: Insidious Witch Chapter 7: Zombified Piglin Chapter 8: Wither-Skeleton Chapter 9: Dungeon of Souls Chapter 10: Stickman King Chapter 11: Desert Chapter 12: Cave with creepers Chapter 13: Wither Chapter 14: Keeper’s House Chapter 15: Herobrine Chapter 1 is fairly easy, and you can practice your moves while gathering coins and rewards. Chapter 2 begins to get trickier immediately, with new obstacles such as lava introduced to quickly keep you on your toes, forcing you to practice your jumps. Chapter 3 is the real test of your stickman's strength—this is where you and a giant zombie will battle to the finish. You may have to repeat this round several times to get enough rewards to unlock the rest of the rounds. With a wide array of 72 different armor options, you can customize your stickman’s defense to withstand even the toughest of foes. The right combination of armor will give you a tactical advantage, making you an unstoppable force. Whether you’re facing off against challenging zombies or navigating terrifying terrain, every decision you make will impact your chances of survival. Conquer 15 thrilling levels and test your combat skills in epic showdowns with six powerful bosses, or prove your endurance in Survival Mode for endless action. games.long_description: Autogun Heroes is an action arcade platformer game that throws you into the heart of an alien-infested battleground alongside a team of fearless heroes. Armed with overloaded weapons and the ability to stack endless upgrades, you’ll blast through relentless waves of enemies in a vivid, fast-paced world teeming with chaos. Every step forward demands sharp strategy, quick reflexes, and the right gear to overpower the alien onslaught. Whether you’re unleashing devastating firepower, unlocking new abilities, or leading your squad into battle, the fight to reclaim your home is as intense as it is exhilarating. How to Play Autogun Heroes Autogun Heroes is a vibrant, action-packed shooter where the chaos never stops, and your eye-patched, muscle-bound hero, Gus, is on a mission of vengeance. The game features automatic shooting, so your focus is all about movement and aim—use the WASD keys to navigate, the space bar to jump, and press down to drop. As you blast through enemies, you’ll travel across dynamic levels filled with surprises, enemies attacking from all directions, and plenty of opportunities to prove your skills. At the edge of each area, you’ll be transported to new sections of the battlefield, keeping the action fresh and intense. Along the way, you’ll unlock a cast of epic characters, each with their own unique flair and abilities, like Odessa, the masked undercover spy, Doc Justice, the gunslinging cowboy, and Spark, a plasma-wielding inventor. To access these heroes, you’ll need game credits, which you can earn as you progress. Power up your gameplay with easy-to-earn upgrades like bullet power, increased hit points, or veteran status. Advanced skills are also available through Alien DNA upgrades, giving you access to a robust skill tree to enhance your strategy. Throughout the game, you’ll encounter thrilling perks like poison attacks, bullet wall bounces, and even the rare chance of a headshot for instant kills. Watch ads to unlock certain stages or cool off between battles. Equip items at basecamp, upgrade your gear between levels, and take the fight to the Galactic Alliance worlds to free them from the clutches of the Vortex Invaders. With enemies swarming from above, below, and all around, quick reflexes and sharp aim are your keys to survival in this non-stop, adrenaline-filled adventure. games.title: Punchers
games.description: Punchers is a 3D boxing sports action game with ragdoll physics. Use move keys to dodge enemy punches and hit back with random punch combinations.
games.long_description: Punchers is a 3D boxing sports action game with ragdoll physics. Use move keys to dodge enemy punches and hit back with random punch combinations. You can play against another player or AI. How to Play Punchers Punchers throws players into the boxing ring for an intense boxing match where technique is key. Use the WASD keys to maneuver your fighter and get ready to throw jabs, cross punches, and more. The game features both realistic real-time matches as well as slow-motion combat, allowing players to perfect their moves and time their punches with precision. You’ll be scored on total punches, landed punches, power punches, and accuracy. While you can spam the keys, success depends on skill and precision rather than random attacks. Take advantage of slow-motion mode to practice your moves and learn the timing needed for effective jabs and cross punches. Each punch has a recovery move, meaning you need to manage your timing carefully. Too many reckless attacks can leave you open for counter-punches. A stamina meter tracks your energy, helping you decide when to go on the offense or focus on defense to recover. After each round, you’ll get feedback on your performance, including stats like your best punch and overall effectiveness. If you win, expect a fun celebration with cheers, but if you lose, brace yourself for a bit of frustration. More Games Like This Explore other exciting sports titles including popular soccer games like Soccer Random , a chaotic 2-player soccer game with bouncy physics and one-button controls, or Basket Random , where you bounce around and battle for the ball across various crazy basketball courts If you want to change the sport and try your luck at archery, Bowman , a game where you and an opponent take shots at each other. You win when you’ve hit the opponent fatally. Release Date May 2020 Developer Vardan Aleksanyan developed this game. You should also check the developer's other physics-based fighting game Striker Dummies . Platform Web browser

controls.Controls: Left player use the WASD keys and Y, U Right player use arrow keys and numpad 1, 2

games.title: Drunken Boxing
games.description: Drunken Boxing is a fun sports action ragdoll boxing game that delivers an unpredictable twist on traditional sports gaming. See the chaos that happens when two boxers play when they are a little tipsy in the ring.
games.long_description: Drunken Boxing is a fun sports action ragdoll boxing game that delivers an unpredictable twist on traditional sports gaming. See the chaos that happens when two boxers play when they are a little tipsy in the ring. With its whimsical physics and outrageous character movements, you'll discover that landing a solid punch is far more challenging than it appears—after all, your inebriated state keeps you stumbling and swaying. How to Play Drunken Boxing Drunken Boxing gameplay is pretty straightforward using your WASD keys, but each move will yield mixed results, so keep bashing to try and get some kind of ‘punching’ action going. As a physics-based game, each move may appear a bit clumsy, but that’s a natural consequence of your guided controls. Use the left and right arrows to throw punches with each hand while pressing the down arrow, which shifts you into a defensive stance, retreating and potentially cornering yourself. Conversely, the up arrow propels you into an offensive position, charging forward toward your opponent. If you’re playing the 2-player game, use WASD to move if you are on the left side. If you’re on the right, use the arrow keys. Your movements may not always be as crisp as you'd like, so it’s crucial to start punching immediately—hesitate, and you risk being attacked and losing control of your punches. Your objective is to knock out your opponent before your energy runs out. An energy bar above each player indicates how close you are to a knockout. If your energy depletes completely, you'll be knocked out of the ring and lose the round. To win the game, you need to be the first to secure five match victories—the first to five takes home the championship! If you're on the left side, use WASD to maneuver; if you're on the right, use the arrow keys. You can challenge the CPU for practice or join a friend for a head-to-head showdown, just like in many of our other exciting two-player games. More Games Like This Check out some more of our fun physics games , including games like House of Hazards , where your challenge is to outlast your friends by finishing tasks and avoiding hazards in this chaotic multiplayer game. If you're looking to continue the sports game fun instead, try some of our more popular titles like Basket Random , an arcade sports game with quirky, unpredictable physics, or Soccer Random , a chaotic two-player soccer game with one-button controls. Release Date January 2021 Developer This game is made by RHM Interactive. Platform Web browser

controls.Controls: Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys

games.title: Snake Shooter: Tower Battle
games.description: Snake Shooter: Tower Battle is a fast-paced casual defense game where you use precise archery skills to take on a massive creeping dragon. Aim, shoot, and upgrade your bow to fend off relentless attacks.
games.long_description: Snake Shooter: Tower Battle is a fast-paced casual defense game where you use precise archery skills to take on a massive creeping dragon. Aim, shoot, and upgrade your bow to fend off relentless attacks. Unlock powerful abilities like fire arrows and multi-shot to strengthen your defenses. With vibrant visuals and nonstop action, every battle tests your strategy and reflexes. How to Play Snake Shooter: Tower Battle An enormous snake is slithering toward you, and the only way to stop it is by shooting its segmented body until each part is destroyed. Each segment has a numeric value representing its durability: keep shooting until the number reaches zero to break that section apart. To survive, focus your attacks strategically. Aim for the segment closest to you to prevent the snake from advancing, or target weaker segments with lower numbers to shorten its length and buy yourself more time. As you rack up points, you’ll unlock powerful upgrades: 🏹 Double Arrows – Fire two shots at once for extra damage. 🏹 Critical Hits – Boost your chance to deal devastating blows. 🏹 Explosive Arrows – Blast through segments with high-damage shots. 🏹 Attack Speed Boost – Fire faster to break down tough segments quicker. 🏹 Piercing Arrows – Hit multiple segments in one shot. The battle intensifies as the snake grows faster and stronger, even gaining the ability to attack from a distance. Equip battle gear and level up to keep pace with its increasing power. It's important to strategize. Be smart in your approach, strike the front to slow its advance, but take the shot if you see an opportunity to wipe it out entirely! Can you defeat the snake before it reaches you? More Games Like This Explore the world of casual gaming with our extensive collection of fun and engaging titles. Try fan favorites like Friday Night Funkin' , a rhythm-based game where you battle in freestyle music duels or Blob Opera , an interactive musical experience powered by machine learning that lets you create stunning operatic melodies with ease. For a quirky challenge, check out Snow Rider 3D , where your mission is to reach the end of a silly dangerous mountain slope while surrounded by white caps.
