games.description: Archer Ragdoll Masters is a stickman archery action game with ragdoll physics. Line up your arrow and shoot your enemies down one by one.
games.long_description: Archer Ragdoll Masters is a stickman archery action game with ragdoll physics. Line up your arrow and shoot your enemies down one by one. Pick up power-ups and equip new items to your stick archer to own the enemy with greater precision and power. How to Play Archer Ragdoll Masters Fight waves of enemy stickmen. Line up your first shot and fire! From there, it’s an endless journey of bow-and-arrow-based combat. Shoot your enemies down with haste and shoot the bonuses along the way to increase your longevity. These bonuses feature health, arrow upgrades, and more. Some of the waves do not involve opposing archers, though: there are cases in which you have to shoot against arrows coming at you from nowhere, others where you have to hit fruit jumping in front of you, a reminiscence of the famous casual game Fruit Slice. Your aim is crucial when it comes to taking down opposing archers, as headshots will likely be immediately lethal, while hitting a limb might only slow them down or make it harder for them to hit you. Use your gold to buy new things. The game ends when you die. Here, you’ll earn gold based on your performance. There are also 30 unique achievements that deliver gold when you’ve met the goal. You can use the gold to buy new bows and helmets. New bows provide different powers to give you an advantage and make it easier to eliminate your opponents. In contrast, helmets give you additional protection from enemies' arrows, as well as additional health. Unlock exclusive items. The Special Items tab offers even more exclusive items to earn. You can win battles to earn cups. If you reach the top 10 in the daily leaderboard, you’re rewarded with tokens to spend here. games.title: Slingshot Fortress
games.description: Slingshot Fortress is a casual destroy 2D action game that turns every shot into a flashback of your younger, more menacing days. Get ready to shoot stones, bombs, and shurikens, and let your slingshot shine as you smash through towering fortresses to uncover and defeat sneaky hidden creatures.
games.long_description: Slingshot Fortress is a casual destroy 2D action game that turns every shot into a flashback of your younger, more menacing days. Get ready to shoot stones, bombs, and shurikens, and let your slingshot shine as you smash through towering fortresses to uncover and defeat sneaky hidden creatures. Each level takes you to vibrant, ever-changing landscapes—from lush forests to icy tundras. Slingshot Fortress is the ultimate test of your aim and ingenuity. Sling, smash, and conquer in this nostalgic game. How to Play Slingshot Fortress Master the art of destruction in Slingshot Fortress and destroy structures in sight with basic sticks and stones, the good old-fashioned way. Each round will present you with an intricate structure filled with cakes, little creatures, diamond rewards, balloons, and more hidden between a structural foundation that can, and should, easily be destroyed. Begin by clicking and holding the projectile in your slingshot, then pull back by dragging your mouse to adjust the angle and power of your shot. When ready, release to launch. But here’s the twist: some projectiles come with special effects! Click mid-air to trigger their unique abilities before they hit anything, adding an extra layer of strategy to your aim. This physics-inspired game challenges your precision and creativity as you knock down increasingly complex towers to advance through levels. Start simple with stones and wooden structures, aiming for weak points or TNT barrels to cause a satisfying chain reaction of destruction. As the levels get harder, you'll need to carefully study each structure to find its Achilles' heel, with fewer projectiles at your disposal to make every shot count. Strategy is everything. If there’s no TNT, aim for the base of the structure; it’s all about that base! Some objects require a smarter approach: target support beams to unbalance the tower or pop balloons holding parts of the structure afloat. The game rewards clever thinking and sharp aim, keeping every level fresh and challenging. Are you ready to conquer gravity and bring down every fortress in your path? Grab your slingshot, take aim, and let the destruction begin! More Games Like This Slingshot Fortress is a popular destroy game in our casual category , and there are plenty more fun games to play in this selection. Have a play at Backpack Battles is a strategy game where smart item placement in your backpack determines victory, or Happy Wheels , a ragdoll physics game where you must survive crazy levels using unique characters.

controls.Controls: Aim = Click and hold on the projectile in the slingshot Pull Back = Drag the mouse to adjust the angle and power Release = Let go to launch the projectile Activate Effect = Click while the projectile is in the air to trigger its special effect before it hits anything

games.title: Archers Arena
games.description: Archers Arena is an exhilarating mix of action and skills that tests your precision, decision-making, and adaptability. It’s designed to provide a challenging and adrenaline-filled experience for players who thrive on competition and enjoy mastering their skills.
games.long_description: Archers Arena is an exhilarating mix of action and skills that tests your precision, decision-making, and adaptability. It’s designed to provide a challenging and adrenaline-filled experience for players who thrive on competition and enjoy mastering their skills. This game promises a dynamic gameplay experience that blends skill progression, tactical combat, and exciting visuals, making it a must-play for fans of action games. How to Play Archer's Arena In Archer's Arena, precision is key as you face off in intense, one-on-one battles where you’ll carefully track your vitals like health, base damage, and headshot damage. The gameplay is simple yet challenging: hold the left mouse button to aim and release to shoot, but your movement is limited, you can only adjust your bow’s angle up and down, never your character's position. Accuracy is paramount, with some rounds offering helpful guidance on where to aim. Each player takes a shot in turn, with the round continuing until one player runs out of energy. While taking a hit won’t cost you your life, running out of energy will cost you the round. As you progress through multi-level challenges, you’ll need to prove your accuracy and adaptability, navigating diverse heights, angles, and obstacles. Upgrading your hero and arsenal will be crucial, unlocking new abilities and weapons as you gain experience points. Prepare to face off against skilled opponents with ever-evolving strategies, testing your skill and creativity. Whether you’re fighting in dense forests or towering castles, each location brings new opportunities and challenges to keep you on your toes. More Games Like This We’ve got plenty of games to like this so you can keep playing. Run 3 , an addicting, endless runner-type action game in which you play as a little grey alien. Squirrel with a Gun is another title to consider, a quirky arcade shooting game where you take on the role of a checkered squirrel armed with awesome weaponry and acrobatic moves. And if it's archery games you're after, there are two fan favorites to suit your whims: Narrow One , a fast-paced battle using your trusty bow and arrow, or Bowman , a game where you and an opponent take shots at each other.

games.title: Vegas Clash 3D
games.description: Vegas Clash 3D is a 3D third-person shooter set at a Las Vegas casino. Rob the casino like a true rock' n’ roll legend while exchanging plenty of bullets with officers looking to chase you down.
games.long_description: Vegas Clash 3D is a 3D third-person shooter set at a Las Vegas casino. Rob the casino like a true rock' n’ roll legend while exchanging plenty of bullets with officers looking to chase you down. How to Play Vegas Clash 3D Complete a casino heist You and a gang of sassy Elvis impersonators are engaged in a massive battle with the law as you rob a glitzy Vegas casino. Take down as many cops as you can while picking up health packs and extra weapons scattered around the map. Explore the awesome casino and have an Elvis party in the money vault! Golden weapons can be unlocked with 100 wins, but getting there will require significant scurrying around the Vegas strip as you pick up sacks full of money to rush them back to the van while avoiding fire and crossfire. The more money sacks you accumulate, the more points you accumulate. Health packs are vital. You will lose energy in this fast-paced game while being chased down and shot at. Health packs are first aid kits. Grab as many as you can to replenish, or you may end up caught by the cops. Gameplay movements are relatively simple; WASD keys help you navigate, but you'll need to find the right shoot-and-aim dynamic to suit the energetic pace set by cops. You do have some options for agility, such as crouching and jumping to avoid bullets. Make Elvis unstoppable You can upgrade the firepower of your two primary weapons on the home screen. You can also increase your maximum health. Play more games and dominate the leaderboard to earn even more points for upgrades. Don't shoot! Elvis is your friend, not your foe Watch out for friendly fire along the Vegas Strip and in Vegas venues. The gameplay is quick, and reflexes are on alert, so it's easy to miss-shoot other Elvises. You don’t want to shoot your own team members because if you do, you will lose points. It's easy to identify who's in on the heist with you - they’re dressed like Elvis. Tip While you're in Vegas venues, there are plenty of places to hide. But be careful you don't get ambushed. You're on a money heist, so sitting idle for too long will get you killed. games.title: Gladiator Fights
games.description: Gladiator Fights is an action fighting game that transports you back to the blood-soaked sands of ancient Rome, where every battle is a fight for survival and glory. As you step into the digitalized Colosseum, you'll feel like a true gladiator, immersed in the brutal world of hand-to-hand combat.
games.long_description: Gladiator Fights is an action fighting game that transports you back to the blood-soaked sands of ancient Rome, where every battle is a fight for survival and glory. As you step into the digitalized Colosseum, you'll feel like a true gladiator, immersed in the brutal world of hand-to-hand combat. Battle your way through fierce arenas, squaring off against formidable foes who will push your strength and strategy to the limit. Each fight is a raw test of skill, where victory means honor and defeat could be your last breath. How to Play Gladiator Fights In Gladiator Fights, your mission is clear: fight to the death in brutal arenas set in ancient Rome. You'll use the arrow keys to move around the battlefield, positioning yourself for the best chance of survival. Attacking is simple—press Q or E/R to unleash your weapon of choice. Combat is fast and intense. Use left-click to attack with your sword and right-click to fire arrows. Each battle is a test of both skill and strategy, and you'll need to stay sharp to outmaneuver your enemies. There are several battle modes to choose from. In Custom Battles, you can set up your own matchups, whether it’s a classic one vs. one duel, a chaotic three vs. three fight, or even a daring one vs. two challenge for the ultimate test of skill. For a more structured experience, enter the Tournaments, where you'll fight your way through ten grueling rounds, each one more difficult than the last, as you strive to become the ultimate gladiator champion. There's also a Rating Battle mode where you'll face off in ranked duels, battling to climb the leaderboard and prove your dominance. Weapons in Gladiator Fights vary from swords and hammers to axes and arrows, each offering a unique fighting style. Some weapons are so large that you won’t be able to carry a shield, so you’ll need to rely on agility and timing to defend yourself. Your enemies are armed with their own deadly tools, so always keep an eye on what they’re wielding. To avoid arrows, the best defense is to simply dodge—quick movements will save you from certain death. If you’re up against a sword-wielding opponent, use your shield to block their attacks. And if you find yourself facing fire, your best option is to run! The key to survival is staying on the offense—if you hesitate, your enemies will strike first, or worse, the battle will drag on with no clear winner. There's no place to hide, and the only way out is to eliminate every opponent in your path. Stay aggressive, adapt to your enemies' tactics, and fight your way to glory! More Games Like This Take your fighting experience with your other battle games in our action category . Popular titles include Rooftop Snipers is a wild two-button sniper game where you jump and shoot your way to victory; Battleship , a classic two-player naval strategy game; Jacksmith , where you forge weapons for soldiers and join them on the battlefield as they slay monsters; Cuphead, a side-scrolling boss battle game where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead—and these are just a few games to choose from. Have a look at our fighting category for more titles.

games.title: War Lands
games.description: War Lands is an ARPG-style game with roguelike gameplay. Battle your way through a series of levels picking up buffs and loot, all while decimating hordes of enemies.
games.long_description: War Lands is an ARPG-style game with roguelike gameplay. Battle your way through a series of levels picking up buffs and loot, all while decimating hordes of enemies. How to Play Battle repeatedly War Lands is an awesome roguelike game similar to popular titles like Hades. In War Lands, you’ll go through a sequence of battles (let's call it a trial), that get increasingly more challenging. At the end of each trial, you’ll have the chance to upgrade your gear, level up, and claim rewards in the town using the various items you looted in your run. Embrace the grind War Lands has the addictive ARPG feel you’d expect in a game like Diablo or Path of Exile. But, it's free to play in your web browser, meaning you can jump into the action quickly anywhere. It's perfect if you don't have time to fire up a bigger game and want some addictive ARPG action ASAP! Wield various weapons The weapons you wield define what your class is, and your special abilities will change to match. You can switch things up as they benefit you throughout battle. There are staffs, swords, greatswords, shields, and bows for ranged combat. Game Tips Play tactically, as death can mean starting over Make the most of your abilities and play extra cautiously when starting, as your HP is very low. Choose the level path that benefits your character type the most You’ll notice small icons on the level path. They signify what rewards are available in the level. Discard items by dragging them out of your inventory You can only discard items when you’re in the town. That means if you fill up your inventory, you won’t be able to empty it until you’ve finished the whole round of levels. Choose your loot wisely! Smash barrels to get gold and loot This one is pretty self-explanatory. Break open all the barrels and boxes to get gold. Max out your strongest skills Focus on the strengths that will benefit your class most. If you’re dual-wielding swords (great choice), for example, you might want to focus the vast majority of skill points on strength and agility. Enchant your weapons Enchant your weapons to give them magical properties that help you in battle. You’ll need all the gold you can get, as the chance of enchantment becomes trickier as your item increases in rarity. More Games Like This If you enjoyed playing War Lands, check out our RPG games and roguelike games for more. For something quite similar and addictive, check out Endless Waves Survival or Fantasy Madness , both games are from the roguelike category and feature similar gameplay. Your mission: master ten essential detective skills and become the first-ever legendary detective! How to Play Detective IQ: Brain Game With each mystery solved, your Detective IQ: Brain Game rises and brings you closer to the upper ranks of the Detective Society. It’s all about thinking critically, solving puzzles, and honing the skills real detectives use daily. Each brain game you tackle helps sharpen your observation and logical reasoning, challenging you to become sharper, quicker, and more insightful. In Detective IQ, you’ll encounter hundreds of thrilling cases to test your abilities and observation skills. Master detective skills—like observation, logic, and problem-solving—and rise through the Detective Society ranks, just like Detective Mehul. What is your ultimate goal? Legendary status. Weekly new stories and criminals keep the challenges fresh, so there’s always a new case to crack. And once you catch a criminal, choose from unique punishments to bring justice to each case. Start as a rookie and climb the path to becoming a legendary detective! Join the adventure in Detective IQ, available in 9 languages. Solve mini mysteries like: “Who ate the cake?” (Was it the boy with cake on his face?), “Who’s faking their pregnancy?” (Could it be the woman with the pillow under her shirt?), and “Who’s hiding the evidence?” (Where’s the handprint? Where’s the knife?). Solve puzzles, uncover clues, and claim rewards as you test your detective mettle. Can you match wits with Detective Mehul and rise to the top? Try some of our popular titles like Cut the Rope , where you feed large pieces of candy to a hungry creature called Om Nom; BlockBuster Puzzle challenges you to clear blocks and advance through levels. games.long_description: Craft Drill is a casual arcade game where you command a powerful drill to uncover coal, iron, gold, and diamonds. How to Play Idle Craft Drill Take control of a powerful circular chipper and carve your way through a massive board filled with rocks and precious gems! You can move up, down, and sideways, breaking through obstacles as you mine for valuable resources. Keep an eye out for colorful gems; they're worth the most. Each upgrade makes mining faster and more efficient, letting you take on tougher terrain with ease. Some rocks won’t budge with a standard drill. That’s where dynamite 💥 and the drill hammer come in: use them to smash through the hardest obstacles and keep progressing! games.title: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway
games.description: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway is an adventure puzzle escape game where you're a determined kid with pretty strict parents who wants to break free from being grounded in your room. Tiptoe across quiet hallways, avoid being seen, and use clever tricks to carry out your great escape.
games.long_description: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway is an adventure puzzle escape game where you're a determined kid with pretty strict parents who wants to break free from being grounded in your room. Tiptoe across quiet hallways, avoid being seen, and use clever tricks to carry out your great escape. Your friends are waiting for you on the outside. Do you have what it takes to join them? How to Play Schoolboy Escape The game begins with a bad report card, filled with low grades and teacher complaints about your behavior. Your parents are furious, and rightly so. You are grounded and will have to stay in your room and study as punishment. Your ultimate goal is to sneak your way out without being caught. Running or making noise will get you noticed, so be stealthy. You will have to solve mini escape puzzles to be able to leave, such as finding the spare key hidden somewhere in your room. Move around the house, checking inside cabinets, shelves, and drawers whenever possible. If your mom or dad catches you, you’ll be sent back to your room. Your mom comes in and out of your room from time to time, so to fool her and make her believe you’re studying, you will need to place a math book on your desk. Search around, including the hallway, for valuable items. You’ll need keys to access other rooms, like the storage and bathroom. Avoid crossing paths with your parents, especially when they check on you. Beware of Your Parents' Bedroom Some essential items are in your parents’ room, but you must wait for your dad to leave before trying to access the safe. Find the password to open it. As you progress, you’ll face new challenges in school, the village, and other locations, solving puzzles and sneaking past watchmen and other obstacles. Use distraction tactics to avoid detection and find keys, tools, and codes to unlock doors and safes. Always watch your surroundings, hide when necessary, and collect helpful items to aid your escape. How far can you get before your parents catch you? More Games Like This Fan of adventure games like this? We've got you covered. Browse our adventure collection or escape collection for more of the same. You may also want to try some of our more popular titles like Idle Breakout , Sprunki , and Friday Night Funkin , among a few, within our vast collection of free online games.

games.title: Mirror Room Escape
games.description: Mirror Room Escape is a puzzle adventure where you must navigate a mysterious room filled with reflective illusions. Solve intricate challenges by deciphering clues hidden within the mirrors and testing your wits and perception.
games.long_description: Mirror Room Escape is a puzzle adventure where you must navigate a mysterious room filled with reflective illusions. Solve intricate challenges by deciphering clues hidden within the mirrors and testing your wits and perception. Every step unveils secrets and unexpected twists as you race against time to unlock the path to freedom. Will you outsmart the reflections? How to Play Mirror Escape Room Step into a room filled with mirrors and intricate puzzles, where every reflection holds a clue. Your goal is to decipher the hidden patterns, align the mirrors correctly, and unlock the path to escape. This first-person pov game will have you nudging at door knobs and circling the room looking for the next clue. Start by analyzing the mirror with digit tiles: observe how numbers reflect and use them to crack the passcode. As you progress, you'll encounter color-coded symbols, stepping platforms, and a locked drawer requiring precise rotations. Each puzzle builds upon the last, challenging you to interpret mirrored hints, decipher sequences, and manipulate objects strategically. Use collected mirrors to reveal new clues, unlock compartments, and align reflections. Rotate objects according to their mirrored angles, match colors based on their reflections, and follow step-by-step sequences to activate hidden mechanisms. Keep an eye on details like the positioning of arrows, reflections of letters, and the direction of laser beams bouncing off mirrors. With each successful puzzle solved, you'll gather keys, tools, and hints leading you closer to the final escape. Precision, observation, and logical thinking will guide you through this mind-bending mirrored maze. More Games Like This There are plenty more puzzle games for you to explore. Try some from our Match 3 catalog like Zoo Boom , Candy Riddles , or Mergest Kingdom . Other fun puzzle games include Mahjong Online and Mahjongg Solitaire , all in our Mahjong category .

games.long_description: Russian Checkers Free is a strategic board game that lets you challenge both a powerful AI and real players. With 8 difficulty levels, interactive hints, and the ability to undo moves, you can refine your skills. Whether playing online, against the computer, or sharing the same screen, this game offers various modes and customization options for an engaging experience. Features: Choose the type: online or with a computer or together on the same screen Playing with the computer, select the opponent's level, handicap and hints Playing with a friend, choose time control or unlimited Rules of the game: A simple checker moves diagonally forward one square. The king walks diagonally both forward and backward on any free square, but cannot jump over her own. Taking is mandatory. Beaten checkers and kings are removed only after the turn is completed. After the capture, if it is possible to continue taking other opponent's checkers, then this continues until it reaches a position from which the fight is impossible. The capture is performed both forward and backward. The king, after taking it, stands on any free field after a beaten checker. When fighting through a last row, a simple checker turns into a king and continues the fight according to the rules of the king. The rule of the Turkish strike is that a checker that has already been beaten, but not removed from the board, stops the beating king or the opponent's checker. With several options for taking, for example, one or two checkers, the player chooses the option of taking at his discretion. Release Date August 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.description: DUO With Friends is an advanced variation of UNO with new tournaments, rules, gameplay modes, special cards, and much more. Unlike UNO, DUO With Friends allows space for up to 8 players in an online game.
games.long_description: DUO With Friends is an advanced variation of UNO with new tournaments, rules, gameplay modes, special cards, and much more. Unlike UNO, DUO With Friends allows space for up to 8 players in an online game. How to play DUO DUO With Friends follows rules similar to those found in UNO. Match your cards with the same type last placed on the pile. If you can’t, then you must draw cards from the stack until you reach a playable card. You can also utilize several wild & unique cards to avoid having to draw more or balance the playing field. Set up an online match You can play DUO online with up to 8 players. The online game creator can fully customize the card game’s rules, dictating how many points are needed to win, how many cards are dealt at the beginning, what special cards will be available, and much more. Get immersed in the DUO card game Duo With Friends features numerous game modes and areas to explore. You can set up a quick game and get instantly matched with another player, create games and invite your friends, and join other games by browsing the available matches. Along with the fully customizable gameplay options, you can visit the shop to find custom skins, sound effects, and more. Cards unique to DUO With Friends Much like UNO, DUO has special cards of its own. These are: Wild 'Find 0': The next player has to keep drawing until they find a card featuring the number zero. Wild 'Switch Cards': The player swaps all their cards with the next player. Wild 'Double': The next player draws as many cards as they have in their hand. Wild 'Number Shuffle': Randomizes the numbers on all number cards. Wild 'Watcher': All player cards are uncovered for 5 turns. Features Set up a custom match with your own flexible rules Join one of many open online DUO matches Customize your cards, player bar, and more Experience a colorful and free online card game Developer Robin made DUO With Friends. Platform Web browser

games.title: Rodha
games.description: Rodha is a 2D casual jumping game where you hop through 60 obstacle-filled levels, each one throwing new challenges in your path. Cannons, moving saws, and all kinds of contraptions stand between you and your destination.
games.long_description: Rodha is a 2D casual jumping game where you hop through 60 obstacle-filled levels, each one throwing new challenges in your path. Cannons, moving saws, and all kinds of contraptions stand between you and your destination. The game can be quite challenging, but not to worry, because if you die and choose to respawn, you will find yourself back at your last checkpoint, so you're never sent too far back. How to Play Rodha Your job in Rodha is seemingly simple. You are meant to get through each level without getting taken out. You'll be leaping over walls, spikes, and gaps, all while trying to make it to the portal at the end. Watch out for thin platforms as they vanish shortly after you land on them, so keep moving and don't linger. Checkpoints come in the form of flags scattered through each level. Run past one, and it's yours, so if you fall, you'll pick back up from there rather than starting all over. Rodha is a fast-paced game, so if you get distracted, even for a second, you will find yourself stopped in your tracks and back to the beginning. Some levels have stars hidden in them. Grab those whenever you can, as they're your ticket to unlocking new skins back in the main menu. Coins are also worth collecting throughout your run, and you can spend them in the shop on 9 unique character skins ranging from 50 to 250 coins. Rodha has a bit of a learning curve at first. You need to get used to the controls, but more importantly, to the speed. Once the timing of your jumps starts to click, the whole game opens up, so stay patient, and you will find yourself moving on from level to level in no time. More Games Like This Browse our platform games for more! Popular platformers with tricky puzzles include games like Getting Over It or OvO Game . Other casual games worth a try are Happy Wheels , Deez Balls or X-Trench Run . Release Date June 2022 (WebGL) October 2022 (iOS) Developer Liminal Creations made this game. Platform Web browser

controls.Controls: A / left arrow key = jump to the left D / right arrow key = jump to the right Press the button twice for a double jump

games.title: Noob Miner 2: Escape From Prison
games.description: Noob Miner 2: Escape From Prison is an adventure arcade mining game where your survival depends on your skills and strategy! You control your noob miner to dig, fly, eat, purchase goods, and pretty much do everything possible to not only survive but escape from confinement.
games.long_description: Noob Miner 2: Escape From Prison is an adventure arcade mining game where your survival depends on your skills and strategy! You control your noob miner to dig, fly, eat, purchase goods, and pretty much do everything possible to not only survive but escape from confinement. How to Play Noob Miner 2: Escape From Prison You’ve been caught stealing diamond apples... again! Now you’re locked up in a prison, forced to toil away in the mine as part of your punishment. But this isn't just any ordinary prison labor: there’s more at stake here than just digging for ores. You need to stay sharp and well-fed, so always stock up on food and enhancement potions before heading underground, or you’ll starve to death! As you work through your grueling days, you’ll be assigned to incomplete building projects and resource extraction, where you’ll uncover hidden opportunities that could lead to your freedom. Keep your eyes peeled for the Super Pickaxe, a tool so powerful it could be your key to escape! Along the way, visit merchants to purchase better pickaxes, potions, and other essential supplies to boost your mining efficiency. These tools will help you dig deeper, extract more valuable resources, and stay one step ahead of your captors. Who knows what secrets the mine holds? Keep digging, upgrading, and planning your way to freedom! Challenge yourself and earn maximum coins. Get to know the characters of the prison. Be attentive; perhaps they are hiding something from you. Get as many upgrades as possible so you can mine resources faster and more efficiently. Increase your luck to mine more resources per block. Upgrade your mine to generate more ore. Find, buy, and sell resources to merchants: new, different kinds of picks, food, torches, dynamite, and much more. Don't get too used to this vibrant life in prison—your aim, after all, is to escape. Tip Every day, prices at shops are updated, so choose the moment when you can earn the most! More Games Like This Enjoy even more adventure games or arcade games , so the fun can continue. If you liked Noob Miner, you might also enjoy games like Jacksmith, where you forge weapons for soldiers only to help them in battle yourself; We Become What We Behold, where you witness how being observed can easily change your actions in both a game and in real life; or Bloxd io , an adventure game with awesome Minecraft graphics worth a play. Release Date December 2023 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.long_description: Frogger is a classic arcade game. Control the frog to navigate hazardous roads and rivers and reach the other side. Rinse and repeat. This newer version features updated graphics but remains essentially the same as the original Frogger. How to Play Frogger The concept of Frogger is simple. Just get that frog from A to B. Yet it’s a challenge to execute. Move your frog using the arrow keys. Be careful. Avoid the moving vehicles. On the river, jump across the logs to get your frog to its “frog home”. There are five of these homes, so you have to repeat this four more times. Then you move to the next level. Each level adds even more difficulty. Expect crocodiles, snakes, faster-moving vehicles, and rapid-flowing rivers as you get further into the game. This poses a challenge to a mere frog with three lives. Game Tip Everything in Frogger moves predictably. The vehicles are all moving in time. The logs have set speeds and orders that a savvy gamer can exploit. The same goes for those pesky snakes and crocodiles, too. Get a feel for the timings, hone your reflexes, and play frequently to master this game. About Frogger The original Frogger needs little introduction. It was a hugely successful game when released in 1981. Since that time, numerous remakes have been released to modernize the visuals and gameplay. However, you can’t beat the simple charm of the original Frogger. It’s a game that transcends boundaries. This version of Frogger maintains everything that makes the original game great while improving the visual fidelity for modern screens. More Arcade Games You love the originals. games.title: TenTrix
games.description: TenTrix is a fantastic puzzle game set on a 10x10 playing board. The objective is to fit all the pieces together in rows like Tetris, but the pieces don’t fall.
games.long_description: TenTrix is a fantastic puzzle game set on a 10x10 playing board. The objective is to fit all the pieces together in rows like Tetris, but the pieces don’t fall. Instead, you can match rows in any direction and place pieces where you want. How to Play TenTrix TenTrix provides you with a choice of 3 pieces at a time, and you must use all of those pieces before being able to see any more. As the game progresses, the free space will reduce as you struggle to find the ideal placement for each block. The game ends when you have a piece to place on the board but no space for it. At the end of each game, you receive a high score to aim for the next time you play. There is no time pressure, and you have the total freedom to use the available space on the board for your pieces. Tentrix is potentially endless, as in, if you have room for new pieces, it will continue indefinitely until you don't. Use the simple tap-and-drag mechanism to carry the pieces from the bottom of the screen onto the game board: good luck! TenTrix vs Tetris - what's the difference? TenTrix and other 10x10 games are like Sand Tetris but lack the physics. This difference means you can place blocks at any point around the board and clear rows both vertically and horizontally. This change in physics completely alters the strategy of the game. As such, there is a more diverse array of pieces you wouldn’t find in a game like Tetris. TenTrix Tips Don’t play TenTrix like it’s Tetris: you can build in any direction. Learn the different pieces so you know what to expect. Knowing what’s to come will allow you to plan ahead. Avoid creating too many small enclosures, as many pieces are large and could quickly end the game. More Games Like This If you enjoyed TenTrix, you might also like similar puzzle games like Mahjongg Solitaire, a well-known table game that offers tile-matching fun that tests your strategy and concentration. Digging further among our casual games, fan-favorites are Moto X3M and Eggy Car . Release Date July 2016 Platforms TenTrix is a web browser game (desktop and mobile).

games.long_description: Five-O puts a numerical twist on the classic crossword board game! Instead of letters, you place number tiles, forming sequences that must add up to multiples of five, with no more than five tiles per sequence. Think strategically, maximize your bonuses, and outscore your opponent in Five-O! How to Play Take turns placing intersecting number sequences that sum to a multiple of five. games.long_description: Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color is a classic puzzle game where you sort various colored nuts onto screws until they are all the same color. As you progress through the levels, the puzzles get trickier, requiring you to plan your moves carefully and think several steps ahead. With each successful sort, you'll feel a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Get ready to test your strategy and problem-solving skills as you work your way through increasingly complex and colorful challenges! How to Play Nuts Puzzle: Sort By Color Organize the nuts To play Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color, start by tapping on the nut you want to move, then select the screw where you want to place it. You can only place a nut on another screw if it’s either empty or if the top nut on that screw matches the color of the nut you’re moving. This simple rule sets the stage for the puzzle-solving challenge, as you’ll need to strategically plan your moves to ensure each screw ends up with nuts of a single color. As you progress, the game introduces more nuts and a wider range of colors, making the puzzles increasingly complex. New challenges, such as hard mode levels, add an extra layer of difficulty by hiding the color of nuts until you move a piece from above them. These added twists will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you work through each level, striving to complete the puzzle with fewer moves and greater efficiency. Use helpers It’s at this point that you may need to use the undo, reset, and extra screw options, which are available on every level. However, you can only win extra screws from chests and from the winner's wheel. Clicking the screw icon adds an extra screw to free up more space. The undo button has a finite number of uses, but these are restored on each level. You can use the reset button to start the level over from scratch if you have no choice. games.description: Truck Driving Simulator Game is a driving game that immerses you in the thrill of truck driving throughout Asia. The graphics offer a realistic experience with unique truck models and captivating environments.
games.long_description: Truck Driving Simulator Game is a driving game that immerses you in the thrill of truck driving throughout Asia. The graphics offer a realistic experience with unique truck models and captivating environments. How to Play Truck Driving Simulator Game Navigate through exciting terrains while transporting a variety of cargo, including livestock, weapons, and cars. With customizable trucks and multiple missions, embark on a journey through rural landscapes, mastering the art of trucking in this immersive simulator. WASD keys or arrow keys control movement. As you move backward, the game's perspective shifts in tandem with your movement, providing a full view of the landscape behind you. Begin by choosing your game mode. The game offers several modes, which include: Animal Transport Mode Robbery Mode Parking Mode Open World Oil Transport Euro Truck Travel in India Police Truck Chase Once you've chosen your mode, you can select your truck and get ready to enjoy the landscape. Each mode offers a different selection, but the backdrop of the game is that it is set in Asia, with peculiar references to the countries of India and Pakistan, especially. Every mode presents different tasks and challenges, such as attaching and transporting oil tankers, capturing and transporting livestock, driving tractors back to the farm, and avoiding collisions with cattle while driving in India, among others. As usual with driving games, completing missions allows you to earn in-game currency, which in turn is helpful to buy new vehicles and improve your ride. A unique, unlockable feature of this game is to provide users with the ability to write poetry on the truck lorry, a common practice in South East Asia, where "Truck Art" is a popular phenomenon. Tip Watch out for the curves. The game gives clear warnings about potential obstacles. Choose to follow them or explore what the game is capable of. games.description: BattleDudes.io is an action-packed 2D multiplayer IO battle game where chaos reigns supreme. Engage in fierce battles against other players, unleashing a powerful arsenal of guns, tanks, and explosive weaponry to dominate the battlefield.
games.long_description: BattleDudes.io is an action-packed 2D multiplayer IO battle game where chaos reigns supreme. Engage in fierce battles against other players, unleashing a powerful arsenal of guns, tanks, and explosive weaponry to dominate the battlefield. With multiple maps and diverse game modes, every match offers a new challenge and a chance to show off your strategic prowess. Log in, level up, and unlock powerful upgrades that will make you an unstoppable force! How to Play Battle Dudes You can use over 20 different weapons to take down your opponents. You will have multiple weapons in each loadout, and you can easily switch these weapons using the number keys. (Some of the) game modes in Battledudes.io are: Team modes Team Deathmatch Capture the Flag Hardpoint Solo modes Gun Game Free-for-all Parkour Search & Destroy Drive vehicles In this top-down shooter, you can use jeeps and tanks, along with handheld weaponry, to traverse the map quickly. With powerful rockets and armor, the tanks can cause the most damage, but they’re single-seaters. There’s room for one more in the jeeps, where a passenger can get in and shoot out of the window at enemies. Level up Everyone starts equally in Battledudes.io. However, as you level up, you will unlock new perks and weapons that will give you an edge on the battlefield. These include perks to increase your health, weapon damage, and various speed boosts to increase your efficiency in battle. Speak with your team BattleDudes.io is an online multiplayer game, so you can communicate with your teammates using the emoji wheel. Simply right-click to access this menu. If you are loyal to the BattleDudes' mission, you’ll also be able to unlock new emojis, showing off your elite status. There’s also a weekly leaderboard for logged-in users. Sign up and get involved Battledudes is updated frequently and seasonally with a range of new features. While you can freely play any random game, registering your account will give you access to daily challenges, exclusive seasonal items, and a shop packed with awesome items like hats, weapons, emotes, and more! Compete with other players to reach the top rank of the season in the leaderboards. Tips and Tricks Perks are stackable, meaning that two of the same perk will double the effect Ammo and health packs are droppable, and you can drop them to help your friends Grenades do low damage against vehicles, but lots of damage against other players Every object is destructible! games.long_description: Tanks Arena.io: Craft & Combat is a thrilling PvP action tank battle game where you are combating intense tank wars with a vehicle built and customized by none other than yourself. You will get to challenge players from around the world, so be prepared for plenty of surprises and a variety of strategies from your opponent. How to Play Tanks Arena io: Craft & Combat Your goal in Tanks Arena.io: Craft & Combat is pretty much to destroy or be destroyed. The sky's the limit in terms of creativity and tactical prowess as you determine what kind of vehicle you will use to destroy your enemy. Start by building your ultimate battle machine. Pick from a variety of chassis, turrets, armor plating, and weapons to craft a tank that reflects your unique style—or even emulate legendary tanks like the T-34 or Leviathan. Once you've built your tank, the real action begins. Your first challenge is against Tobi the Tower, a rookie opponent to help you get a feel for the battlefield. Earn rewards like coins, jewels, and new tank parts as you progress, which can be used to unlock upgrades and make your tank even mightier. As you climb the ranks, you’ll face tougher opponents like Frank the Mole, each with their own strategies and strengths—some tanks are much bigger than you, but it's not the size that counts. Outmaneuver them by targeting their weak spots—aim for their wheels to disable their movement or flip their vehicle to expose vulnerable areas. The key to victory is constant improvement. Keep upgrading your weapons, armor, and gadgets to stay ahead. A stronger tank means better odds of winning battles and dominating the arena. Prove your skills by crushing opponents in the championships and advance to the prestigious Bronze Division. With each victory, you’ll climb the leaderboard, earning bragging rights and unlocking more rewards. Strategic hits can turn the tide of battle. A well-aimed shot to your rival’s wheels can render them defenseless—so aim wisely! games.title: StarBlast
games.description: StarBlast is a fun multiplayer arcade shooter set in space. Mine asteroids and fight other players in your own fully upgradable spaceship.
games.long_description: StarBlast is a fun multiplayer arcade shooter set in space. Mine asteroids and fight other players in your own fully upgradable spaceship. Work together with your teammates to ensure victory. How to Play StarBlast In the game, you shoot asteroids and enemies to collect crystals. With these crystals, you can upgrade your ship, buy new ships, and buy more lives for the ships you already have. Training There's an excellent tutorial level on StarBlast.io that will teach you all the basics, from fighting to mining rocks and upgrading your ship. Complete this training section, and you'll be ready to take the fight online! Choose your game There are four game modes in StarBlast. These modes are: team mode survival mode invasion pro deathmatch. Team mode is a good starting point for a new player, as you'll have a crew to back you up. Choose from three primary teams: Federation Sovereign Trappist Colonies Orion Arm Guild Mine gems Gems are the backbone of the StarBlast economy. You'll find them by mining asteroids and destroying the ships of opposition forces. Shoot rocks until they explode! Ensure you target rocks suitable for your ship's size and power. Upgrade your ship You can buy upgrades with all of those precious gems you've earned. You can also use gems to buy upgrades, and you can convert them into credits to buy additional weapons at your team's base. There are seven ship tiers you can evolve to, as well as enhanced cargo capacities. You'll notice an upgrade menu at the bottom. Gems can be instantly converted into upgrades for these items. From left to right, this is the order of upgrades you'll see there: Shield capacity Shield regeneration Energy capacity Energy regeneration Laser damage Weapon speed Ship speed Ship agility You also have 31 different ships you can choose from as you progress in the game. Secondary Weapons and Power-ups There are additional weapons available in Starblast.io, known as secondary weapons. When playing Team Mode, you can purchase them at the team’s base, using gems that have been converted into credits. In other game modes, secondary weapons can be found floating in space, as a result of destroyed ships or asteroids. Secondary weapons are: Projectiles Mines Pods/Drones Utilities Battle with other players Fighting other ships is a huge part of the enjoyment. It's wise to use your speed as a small ship to escape battle and mine resources until you're powerful enough to fight. Be sure to keep a fresh stock of additional weapons and make sure you buff your attack and defense stats as much as possible! Eliminating competitors is a faster and riskier approach to mining resources, as destroyed enemy ships will drop all the gems they were carrying. More Games Like This At the heart of StarBlast is the simple and addictive online gameplay characteristic of many .io games . Other online titles you might enjoy for multiplayer combat include Agar io . You can also check out our fan favorites, like Geometry Dash or Little Alchemy . Features Fun gameplay with plenty of ship upgrades and rewards Four exciting game modes and three factions Active online games with intense spaceship battles An active player-driven modding community Release Date November 2016 Developer Neuronality made this game. Platforms Web browser Android iOS Steam

games.title: Airline Tycoon Idle
games.description: Airline Tycoon Idle is a clicker management game where you take control of the skies as you build and manage your very own airline empire! Start small with just a handful of planes and airports, then strategically expand by treating travelers to lavish VIP lounges, purchasing state-of-the-art planes, and expanding to international airports.
games.long_description: Airline Tycoon Idle is a clicker management game where you take control of the skies as you build and manage your very own airline empire! Start small with just a handful of planes and airports, then strategically expand by treating travelers to lavish VIP lounges, purchasing state-of-the-art planes, and expanding to international airports. Like most management games, you can't do all the work yourself. Hire skilled managers to automate your flights, upgrade your fleet to maximize efficiency, and ensure top-tier passenger satisfaction. Unlock powerful bonuses and climb the ranks to airline tycoon! How to Play Airline Tycoon Idle Your objective in Idle Airline Tycoon is to transform a small operation into a global airline fleet. Start with a modest amount of airplanes, two to be exact, with limited destinations, but soon you'll be connecting dozens of cities worldwide. Gameplay is simple and made to keep you engaged (and relaxed!) as you click your fleet to take off as often as possible, driving up revenue and unlocking more upgrades. Fly as much as you can, and you will soon find yourself upgrading your airports and planes to gradually grow your airline empire. Purchasing a new airplane will set you back around $5,000, but it's a crucial step in expanding your airline. To gather the necessary funds, you'll need to fly your planes to the initial routes offered, like Rome, London, and New York, running consistent flights to build up your earnings. The goal is to master these routes and venture into new cities, steadily growing your airline’s reach. Every flight you run brings you closer to unlocking more destinations, Each choice you make shapes your airline’s success—expand air routes, optimize flight paths, and invest in airport upgrades to attract more passengers and increase your earnings. The game combines strategy with the ease of idle gameplay, allowing you to earn profits with a click. But don’t just sit back—efficient management is key. Carefully plan your routes between cities to ensure smooth operations and steady profits, avoiding costly mistakes that could disrupt your flights. Bon voyage! More Games Like This Clicker games are the perfect way to unwind. Try a few of our more popular titles if you want more of the same simple yet satisfying gameplay. Planet Clicker , a game where you aim to colonize other planets, all with one click; Mr Mine , a game where you build a mining empire from the ground up; and Idle Breakout , an Atari-inspired arcade game where you click blocks for rewards. Release Date July 2024 Platform Web browser

games.title: Fighter Aircraft Pilot
games.description: Fighter Aircraft Pilot is a super realistic flight simulator game, part of our driving airplane collection. Sit in the cockpit of some of the most iconic aircraft in aviation history.
games.long_description: Fighter Aircraft Pilot is a super realistic flight simulator game, part of our driving airplane collection. Sit in the cockpit of some of the most iconic aircraft in aviation history. Begin your mission by choosing your plane and mastering the intricate controls as you gather speed for a flawless takeoff. Feel the thrill of precision flying as you soar through the skies, honing your skills in an immersive simulation that captures the excitement and challenge of piloting a legendary fighter jet. How to Play Fighter Aircraft Pilot Fighter Aircraft Pilot is an exciting flying simulator game where you take the pilot seat, mastering multiple controls for a safe take-off and flight. The graphics are pretty realistic and easily become addictive. There are two dynamic game modes to choose from: Free Fly and Missions. In Free Fly mode, you can select from an impressive array of fighter planes, including iconic models such as the A29, A10, F35, and KC-10, as well as legendary WWII planes and cutting-edge jets, for an immersive flight experience that lets you explore 3D simulation at your own pace. Soar through the skies, experience the thrill of piloting an aircraft, and enjoy the landscapes below. Well, that is if you don't crash. By the way. You will crash. Gameplay is addictive, but it is not simple, and the challenge of finding the right balance is what keeps you coming back. The controls are designed for both ease of use and realism, with E to start the engine, 1 or 2 for throttle adjustments, X to remove the brake, and the down arrow to initiate flight after achieving the right speed. Timing and slight movements to control your plane are everything. Use the left mouse button to fire at your target, switch weapons with the mouse scroll, and drop bombs by pressing L. Additional controls include V to toggle lights, 5 to dump fuel for added maneuverability, and 6 to refill your fuel reserves. For high-speed action, activate the afterburner with I and use P for reverse thrust, while the space bar serves as your brake for smooth landings. It's not easy, so do as much free flying as you can to get a feel for flight. For those craving a bit more of a challenge, the Mission mode presents ten missions where you'll need to target and bomb specific objectives. Precision and skill are paramount as each flight tests your tactical prowess and flying capabilities. Get ready to take to the skies, embrace the adrenaline of aerial combat, and master the art of flying. Bon voyage! More Games Like This Continue to soar in one of our popular airplane game titles Cuphead , where you control a warplane carrying Cuphead in one of the biggest boss battles. If you want to stay closer to the ground, a few more popular driving games include Mr Racer , Drift Hunters , or Moto X3M . Release Date October 2018 Developer Faramel Games made Fighter Aircraft Pilot. Platform Web browser

games.title: Mafia Takedown
games.description: Mafia Takedown is a fun, one-button casual game that will keep you entertained for hours. Your mission?
games.long_description: Mafia Takedown is a fun, one-button casual game that will keep you entertained for hours. Your mission? Take down the notorious mafia boss, the Don, but beware of sneaky traitors lurking in the shadows! Explore unpredictable scenarios and unlock them all as you hone your skills in the art of deception. Sometimes, you are deceiving, but most of the time, you will be deceived. Can you outsmart the mafia and rise to the top? How to Play Mafia Takedown The goal of Mafia Takedown is to avoid being murdered by the many staff, lovers, family, friends, police, or rigged falling objects! As the mafia Don, you'll enjoy extreme protection, but it also means you'll have to look over your shoulder constantly. The game begins with you as one of the Don's foes, with one clear intention: to literally stab the Don in the back, strip him of his clothes, and gain immediate mafia power and protection. Once you are the Don, you will strut all the way to the end of the corridor to meet your final fate. Will that be dinner with your lover or a lifetime in prison? It all depends on how savvy you are and how quickly you can spot your friends from your foes. The cycle continues from there. It's kill or be killed, so keep your eyes wide open. The gameplay is relatively straightforward. A series of people will approach you, tiptoeing toward your back. Once you see them raise their arms to either strike, stab, or shoot you, you must immediately turn and catch them in the act, calling your bodyguards to send them to a lifetime of prison life quickly. But be warned, not everyone is out to get you. Some of the people approaching you may very well want to kiss you! If you're too cautious, you may find yourself with a life of no love. Unlock Scenarios Various scenarios can be unlocked, each leading to a different end. You may be swarmed with love at a romantic dinner, poisoned by your butler, captured by your chef, turned into a chihuahua... yes, anything is possible! The fun part of this game is unlocking the scenarios, so don't be overly cautious if you just want to have fun and explore the difference between friends and foes. Be careful of the stampeding parade and police officers. Once they catch you, it's game over! More Games Like This Browse our one-button games and enjoy popular titles like Idle Breakout , Geometry Dash , and Bubble Shooter . Release Date August 2023 Developer Go Panda Games developed Mafia Takedown. Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS

games.long_description: Chicken Scream is a laugh-out-loud casual arcade platform game where your voice takes control! Unleash your inner chicken and scream your way to victory in this hilarious voice-controlled adventure. Searching for a quirky game that gets you talking (or yelling)? Look no further: Chicken Scream is the perfect game for you! How to Play Chicken Scream In Chicken Scream, your voice is the only control or prompter that you’ve got to guide your character. The game aims to get your chicken safely across a side-scrolling game. Allow your microphone to access your voice for only this game or more, and watch your chicken glide across the screen, all thanks to your voice control. Stay silent, and your chicken stands still. Speak softly, and it starts walking. Shout, and it takes off running, or jumps straight into trouble. It’s a wild, voice-guided adventure where mastering your volume is the key to victory. Take on classic platforming levels or race against other chickens, all scrambling to the finish line with nothing but their voices to guide them. The challenge? Too much yelling sends your chicken into chaos, while too little leaves it stuck in place. This hands-free, laugh-out-loud game is best played with headphones unless you don’t mind turning heads in public. For an extra twist, try singing your way through a level. The results? Utter madness. 🎤🐔 You can play a solo level or play against others in a race where all chickens are pretty much trying to get to the other side. Good cluck! More Games Like This We have plenty more arcade games for you to explore, like Squirrel With a Gun , a quirky shooting game where you take on the role of a checkered squirrel armed with awesome weaponry and acrobatic moves. And if instead, you want to stay within the clicker category , you can try Planet Clicker , a simple clicker game where you expand your reach across space by upgrading energy systems, or Clicker Heroes , a blazing clicker where you destroy monsters with the help of the heroes you'll summon.

controls.Controls: Enable your microphone for voice or the left mouse button (if the microphone is denied as a secondary control).

games.title: Skibidi Toilets: Infection
games.description: Skibidi Toilets Infection is an action meme game in which you play as a mysterious cameraman agent tasked with destroying the Skibidi Toilet monsters, aka heads in moving toilets.How to Play Skibidi Toilets Infection You are in a dystopian post-apocalyptic setting with pretty catchy music that gives you that extra energy to face your dismal surroundings.
games.long_description: Skibidi Toilets Infection is an action meme game in which you play as a mysterious cameraman agent tasked with destroying the Skibidi Toilet monsters, aka heads in moving toilets. How to Play Skibidi Toilets Infection You are in a dystopian post-apocalyptic setting with pretty catchy music that gives you that extra energy to face your dismal surroundings. You are surrounded by toilets, and in those toilets are live heads: those are your targets. They are everywhere. You have the ability to walk and run, but you can't run too far because the more you progress in the game, the more you will be bombarded with Skibidi toilets. The only way out is to kill these infections by flushing their heads down the toilets or zapping them. Skibidi Toilets!?! The Skibidi Toilets meme was born in 2023 from the creativity of Alexey Gerasimov, a Georgian animator who launched a bizarre YouTube series with heads popping out of toilets fighting a horde of humanoids whose heads are made of cameras, speakers, or TV sets. It quickly became viral and sparked off a number of other digital products, as well as video games, like this one. Rely on fellow cameramen. You have help. Throughout the game, other cameramen help you flush the toilets, but remember that you will need to protect them, too. Your objective is to flush and destroy all the evil Skibidi toilets and to protect your allies and fellow cameramen while doing so. In the first few levels, you can destroy them only by hand. Things get harder as you progress: in level three, for example, you'll face not just the Skibidi toilets but also some small infective agents which turn the cameramen against you; you need to shoot the cameramen with an anti-parasite gun to turn them to the good side again. The more rounds you progress, the more toilets you have to face. Get ready for intense action! Tip Don't forget that you can't do it all by yourself, so make sure your agents survive. Don't hesitate to approach them so that they can help you. Features Various Skibidi Toilets to eliminate Cure your fellow camera heads More challenges as you progress Many levels to explore Release Date August 2023 Developer Skibidi Toilets: Infection was developed by BORNIS GameLab. Platform Web browser More Games Like This Check out some more popular Skibidi Toilet games like You vs 100 Skibidi Toilets and Cars vs Skibidi Toilet . You can explore titles that are just as thrilling in our action category . Experience some other meme-based games with Sprunki or try something completely different like Little Alchemy .

controls.Controls: WASD = move Shift = run Left-click = flush toilet / shoot Tab = Pause

games.long_description: Suez Canal Training Simulator is a chaotic cargo-hauling adventure where you command colossal ships through tight canals and unpredictable physics. Load up, steer with care (or sheer luck), and try not to become the next global traffic jam. Features Captain your ship: Pick up containers, follow the big arrow, and deliver the goods Upgrade and repair: Earn cash to fix, upgrade, and slightly improve your floating disaster Battle physics: Navigate wobbly waters, sketchy steering, and highly questionable decisions Build your fleet: Unlock bigger, riskier, and even more gloriously unstable ships Can you master the canal or will you become a meme? Load up, set sail, and embrace the chaos. Your cargo (mostly) depends on it. How to Play Load Cargo: Dock at a port and use the slider to choose how many containers to load Buy Stuff: Visit ports to purchase ships, upgrades, or repairs—because duct tape has its limits Ship Stuck?: If you beach your ship or capsize, press Reset. games.title: The Prank King
games.description: The Prank King is a laugh-out-loud casual game where you step into the shoes of prankster Nick, the ultimate trickster on a mission to outwit Misty, the notoriously cranky Scary Teacher. Each level is a new adventure as you sneak around her house, setting up hilarious traps and creating chaos at every turn.
games.long_description: The Prank King is a laugh-out-loud casual game where you step into the shoes of prankster Nick, the ultimate trickster on a mission to outwit Misty, the notoriously cranky Scary Teacher. Each level is a new adventure as you sneak around her house, setting up hilarious traps and creating chaos at every turn. Your goal? To catch Misty off guard and watch her reactions as she falls victim to your cleverly planned pranks. With tons of creative tricks to choose from, you’ll craft moments of pure comedy gold that will have Misty fuming and you grinning from ear to ear! How to Play The Prank King She's snoozing away, blissfully unaware of the chaos that's about to unfold. But you're not here to let her sleep, are you? Time to give her the rudest wake-up call ever! You have two deliciously devious options: slather her alarm clock with sticky glue or blast her awake with an ear-splitting air horn. Which one will jolt her out of dreamland? Yep, you know it—the air horn! As the deafening noise fills the room, she shoots out of bed, already regretting her decision to close her eyes. But the fun is just beginning! Now, she needs to brush her teeth. What could make this simple task a morning nightmare? Should you sneakily replace her toothpaste with fiery hot sauce or maybe swap it with a dollop of shaving cream? If you chose hot sauce, you’re on a roll! Watch her eyes widen in shock as the fiery paste hits her tongue—she’s not just awake now. She’s wide-eyed and fuming. In a desperate attempt to cool off, she grabs her trusty thermos for a refreshing drink. But you're not about to let her off easy! Should you spike it with a splash of vinegar or go soft with some soda? Soda? Nah, that’s way too nice! Vinegar is the ultimate prankster's choice. As she takes a big swig, her face twists in disgust—now she’s really boiling, and you’ve just leveled up to round two! It's your choice The Prank King is all about making mischievous choices that turn everyday moments into a comedy of errors. From swapping her shampoo with bleach and setting up sneaky tripwires to tying her shoes together before she hits the treadmill and sabotaging her barbells with glue, you’re the mastermind behind every misstep, every tumble, and every furious outburst. Your mission? To keep Scary Teacher stumbling, falling, and absolutely losing her mind at every turn. It’s the ultimate game of pranks where the goal is simple: make her day as miserable—and hilarious—as possible! More Games Like This If you liked The Prank King or Prankster 3D, you should check out our casual games with popular titles like Blob Opera , Snow Rider , Go Chicken Go! and more! Release Date April 2021 (Android) May 2021 (iOS) August 2024 (WebGL) Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS

controls.Controls: Use the left mouse button / AD to choose the prank.

games.title: Stickman Escape School
games.description: Stickman Escape School is a fun adventure game where you need to find a way to escape from school. You are a student who doesn't exactly like to study and decides to cut class and ditch your boring teacher's class.
games.long_description: Stickman Escape School is a fun adventure game where you need to find a way to escape from school. You are a student who doesn't exactly like to study and decides to cut class and ditch your boring teacher's class. There are a lot of different items you could use to escape from school, but if you choose the wrong one, you can be caught and forced to study for pretty much your entire life. The risks are steep, but the rewards are plenty: you get to skip school! Try to choose the right items so you can escape successfully! How to Play Stickman Escape School In Stickman Escape School, your objective is to sneak out of school without getting caught by the teacher. The game begins with your stickman roaming the school, but the only thing is, you must be alert to avoid being detected. The teacher is always watching. Sneak up on doors quietly, and consider using objects in your environment to create distractions that will help you move without raising too much suspicion. The more you explore, the more you will come across various objects that can assist in your escape. Tools like chainsaws, bombs, or other gadgets can help you overcome obstacles towards freedom or simply create distractions so the teachers don’t notice. Using these tools effectively is crucial for advancing through the game and avoiding capture. Each item has a unique purpose, so think strategically about when and how to use them. You might need to play the game several times to find the best object—that's part of the fun! As in any great escape game, you don’t only get tools, but you also get hazards, so be mindful and try to avoid them as best as possible. The teacher and security guards are constantly on the lookout for students trying to escape. If you’re caught, you’ll be sent back to class, forcing you to try it all over again. Staying out of their line of sight is vital, so do what you can to avoid them—hide under benches or sneak through windows. These are just some tactics you can use to go unnoticed. As the game progresses, the challenges will increase, introducing more obstacles like cameras and tougher guards. You’ll need to sharpen your strategy and adapt to the changing environment to successfully play hooky. It’s a race against time, so use your school smarts to outwit your teacher! Browse other fun games in our puzzle selection , or have a go at our escape games . Release Date August 2022 Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android

games.title: Tile Jumper 3D
games.description: Tile Jumper 3D is a thrilling music game that tests your timing and reflexes. Leap across tiles in sync with the beat, aiming for precise jumps to keep the melody alive.
games.long_description: Tile Jumper 3D is a thrilling music game that tests your timing and reflexes. Leap across tiles in sync with the beat, aiming for precise jumps to keep the melody alive. Challenge yourself to reach higher scores while grooving to hit tracks. Compete on the leaderboard and show your rhythm skills: how far can you go? How to Play Tile Jumper 3D Tile Jumper 3D is a high-energy music game where every bounce follows the rhythm of the beat! Guide your ball across floating blocks, timing each jump to match the song. It may seem simple at first, but miss a beat, or a bounce, and you'll plunge into the void! With a variety of levels and tracks to choose from, there's always a new challenge waiting. Prefer an endless run? Test your endurance in nonstop rhythm-based action! Choose Your Soundtrack: Select a song that matches your vibe from a dynamic playlist: 🎵 Bounce! 🎵 Retrowave 🎵 Feel My Heart 🎵 Love Angel 🎵 Happy Birthday 🎵 Retro Dance 🎵 Move It! 🎵 Arabian Night 🎵 Sporty Techno Rhythm Meets Reflexes Levels ramp up in speed, intensity, and complexity, keeping you on your toes as the beats drop faster! Watch out for deceptive tiles; lighter-colored blocks are illusions and will send you tumbling if you're not careful. 💎 Collect diamonds along the way, but beware as some may lead you off course! Want to crank up the difficulty? Try playing without music and discover just how much you rely on the rhythm to stay in sync. Ready to take on the challenge? Let the music guide you! More Games Like This If you like this music game , you will love other similar games. Test your musical rhythm in freestyle music battles in Friday Night Funkin’ . Another fan favorite is Blob Opera , where you create opera music by moving colorful blobs in this experimental game powered by machine learning and real vocal samples

games.title: Catch Tiles: Piano Game
games.description: Catch Tiles: Piano Game is an arcade music rhythm game where tiles fall down the screen in step with a song, and your job is to tap them before they slip past. Every tile you catch plays a note, so a clean run means you're pretty much playing the song yourself.
games.long_description: Catch Tiles: Piano Game is an arcade music rhythm game where tiles fall down the screen in step with a song, and your job is to tap them before they slip past. Every tile you catch plays a note, so a clean run means you're pretty much playing the song yourself. Miss a tile and the music stops. It's simple to pick up, but keeping perfect rhythm on faster tracks can be quite difficult. How to Play Catch Tiles: Piano Game As soon as you start the game, you will land on the song menu. Each song in the list shows the track name, the artist, and a three-star rating slot that fills in as you improve your score. Songs with a green play button are ready to go. Songs marked with an orange Free button unlock by watching a short ad. Finding Songs Tap the magnifying glass at the bottom of the screen to open the search and browse view. Here you can: Search for a specific song or artist by name. Jump back into your Recently Played tracks. Browse by Genre , including Christmas, Pop, Dance, and Classical. Opening a genre shows you every track in that category, so it's an easy way to find new songs once you've played through the starting list. Playing a Song Pick a song and hit play to load the game board. The screen is divided into four vertical lanes, each mapped to a key on your keyboard: A - S - K - L Tiles quickly begin falling down the lanes in rhythm with the music. Press the key matching the lane as each tile reaches you. The faster the song, the faster the tiles fall, so keep your fingers resting on A, S, K, and L at all times because the game moves really fast. At the top of the screen, you'll see a progress bar lined with stars and crowns. As you catch tiles, the marker moves along the bar. Reach the stars to earn your rating for the song, and keep going to claim the crowns at the end for a top score. Your highest score for each track is saved, so you can always come back and beat it. If you want to do a health check, at the top, you'll see your player profile with your level, your hearts, and your coin balance. If You Miss a Tile If you don't click one of the dropping tiles in time, the run ends, and you'll need to watch an ad to continue. Hit the Continue Game prompt with the Spacebar, watch the ad, and you'll pick up right where you left off instead of restarting the song. Themes Above the song info bar during gameplay, you'll find a row of unlockable themes, including a swan, a fluffy white cat, a tabby kitten, a glowing heart, and a snowman. Each theme changes the entire look of the board, from the background scenery to the design of the starting tile, so you can customize it to something that gives you a bit more musical inspiration. Swap between them anytime to match your mood or the song you're playing. Tips Never take your fingers off the keys. Keep one hand on A and S and the other on K and L so you never have to look down. The song can go quite fast, and every second counts. Start with slower songs to train your rhythm and your tap speed. Three-starring an easy track builds the muscle memory you’re going to need for faster tracks. More Games Like This Music games can be incredibly fun, like Friday Night Funkin and some can also be incredibly odd, like Sprunki . Try them both or browse more within our casual category . Release Date January 2021 (Android) March 2024 (HTML5) Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android
