games.title: Italian Brainrot Clicker Game
games.description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a chaotic meme clicker incremental game where you tap your way through the viral Italian Brainrot universe, unlocking all the brainrot characters and upgrades as you progress! You will get the chance to collect Italian Brainrot characters such as: Bombardino Crocodilo, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, Bombombini Gussini, Cappuccino Assasino, Lirili Larila, Brr Brr Patapim, Burbaloni Luliloli, Bobritto Bandito, Trippi Troppi, Chimpanzini Bananini and more!
games.long_description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a chaotic meme clicker incremental game where you tap your way through the viral Italian Brainrot universe, unlocking all the brainrot characters and upgrades as you progress! You will get the chance to collect Italian Brainrot characters such as: Bombardino Crocodilo, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, Bombombini Gussini, Cappuccino Assasino, Lirili Larila, Brr Brr Patapim, Burbaloni Luliloli, Bobritto Bandito, Trippi Troppi, Chimpanzini Bananini and more! Can you collect them all? How to Play Italian Brainrot Clicker The aim of Italian Brainrot Clicker is to click as much as possible to unlock upgrades and rewards along the way. The more you click, the more you earn, the more you can upgrade. You start the game with one skin, Tralalero Tralala, a shark wearing Nike shoes, and one weather: Normal. This is just a starting point, and your goal is to click to the next level quickly. Just above the 200-click range, you unlock Bombardino Crocodillo. Around the thousand coin mark, you will unlock a new weather—rain! It will take some persistence to get there and beyond, but you will find yourself quickly getting addicted to speed and upgrades. You can get help with your click speed and strategy by upgrading using your earned coins. Use Your Coins to Upgrade for a Faster Game 💰 50 coins: Cursor, +1 Brainrot per click 125 coins: Auto Click, +1 Brainrot per second 500 coins: Mr Clicker, +5 Brainrot per click 1,100 coins: Trallero Trallala Farm, +6 Brainrot oer second 12,000 coins: Mystery reward Upgraded Skins After Tralalero Tralala, clicks will take you to even more skin upgrades. These are all locked and can't be bought, only earned. Bombardiro Crocodilo: This skin is a crocodile fused with a bomber plane. It speaks in chaotic Italian and ejects bombs in rapid fire. Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur: This is a heavily memeified skin, carrying a bat with a teacup sidekick. It is known for rhythm-like chants and memes that loop infinitely. You are likely to have come across this one on social media. This skin relies on AI-generated speech. Brr Brr Patapim: This skin comes from a windy forest full of whimsy. Patapimmo lost his golden hat to a brr-ing frog named Slim and chased a wizard's advice to blow him away in a balloon, leaving him free to dance once more. Lirili Larila: Lirilí Larilà is a wandering desert elephant with a ticking clock, a shell, and a knack for spotting surreal sights like sandal-wearing cacti. Bobrito Bonito: This is a rodent dressed like a boss, wielding a high-powered weapon and a slick hat. Bombombini Gusini: This is Bombardiro Crocodilos' brother. Burbaloni Luliloli: Burr baloni luli loli—Capibarello Cocossini is a mythical coconut found on Bali's shores, containing a capybara and worshipped by locals in a fiery celebration. Cappucino Assassino: This is a lightning-fast, dual-katana-wielding master of dexterity, feared even by the elusive Trippi Troppi. Chimpanzini Bananini: The viral “Chimpanzini Bananini” skin is an adorable monkey-fruit hybrid. Tripi Tropi: This is a shrimp-cat hybrid. It features typical AI surrealism and sound madness. Upgraded Weather These are unlocked 🔐 : Normal These are locked 🔒 and can only be unlocked with upgrades: Rain Sunny Star Rain Windy Snowing More Games Like This Clicker games can be quite addictive thanks to their simple yet fun gameplay. Try some of our more popular clicker games like Planet Clicker , where you tap your way to interplanetary domination in this idle game, or Clicker Heroes , a clicker game where you slay down monsters with the help of different heroes.

games.long_description: Stabfish.io is a free IO game where you play as a deadly oceanic beast. Join a multiplayer arena of fish equipped with fatal tusks and take down your share of prey while avoiding the sharp end of another player’s stabber. Collect the fish like trophies, eat food for boosts, and dominate the sea. How to Play Stabfish.io Eat food to gain boosts and a higher score. Eliminate other fish by attacking from the side and behind. Each kill adds length to your tusk. Once your tusk is long enough, you can be bolder with your attacks. What you can customize Fish: Stabfish features several fish upgrades. By reaching milestone achievements, you can unlock more sea beasts, such as killer whales and hammerhead sharks. These unlockable skins provide in-game advantages, like additional kill bonuses. Weapons: Every player starts with a basic tusk. Once you reach level 4 with the tusk, you can upgrade your tusk to a trident. The same logic applies to upgrading to a chill blade and chainsaw. More Games Like This Stabfish.io is similar to many arena games in the io genre . Browse the collection for many more of these addictive gems. games.title: Cat and Granny
games.description: Cat and Granny is a chaotic first-person action game where you play as a clever orange cat determined to outsmart the new black cat that Granny brought home! Cause havoc by knocking over flower pots, scattering objects, and scratching up furniture, all while making Granny believe the black cat is to blame.
games.long_description: Cat and Granny is a chaotic first-person action game where you play as a clever orange cat determined to outsmart the new black cat that Granny brought home! Cause havoc by knocking over flower pots, scattering objects, and scratching up furniture, all while making Granny believe the black cat is to blame. How to Play Cat and Granny You’re a mischievous orange tabby with a knack for chaos, but you’ve got a plan. Blame it all on the sweet, unsuspecting black cat. Walk up to anything breakable like lamps, potted plants, chandeliers and press F to knock it down with your paw, which is how you are going to try to frame your rival, but be warned, it doesn’t always work! Granny is more clever than that, especially if you are within clear sight of the incident. Everything you do feeds the meter at the top of the screen which tracks the blame race between you and a black cat in the house - the two cat icons slide along the bar toward the little door as each of you racks up suspicion, and whoever Granny sees first and blames the wrongdoing on gets punished. Your whole job is making sure the black cat's icon reaches that door before yours does. Goldfish crackers are key, with your running total displayed in the top left corner. You'll spot bonus pickups around the house, like a sparkling bag of treats worth +150 goldfish if you're willing to watch a short ad to claim it. The shop works the same way, offering a free sausage in exchange for an ad view. The counter next to the sausage icon shows how many you have, so you always know whether a distraction is ready to go. Tip Granny’s house is full of boxes. If she’s getting too close, jump into one and hide! Make it in time and you’ll stay safe. Miss your chance, and prepare for a stern talking-to from good old Granny. Features Interactive environments packed with breakable objects A unique twist—frame the black cat for your mischievous deeds Hilarious reactions from Granny as she falls for your tricks Simple, fun, and highly addictive gameplay Unleash your inner troublemaker and take back your territory in Cat and Granny! More Games Like This There are plenty more action games where this one came from! Explore our action category for titles like Jacksmith , a crafting adventure where you forge weapons and join soldiers in battle to defeat ferocious monsters, or House of Hazards , where every day household objects become obstacles. You may also like 99 Nights in the Forest , a survival game where you gather resources in the daytime to make it through the nighttime in the forest.

games.title: Jungle Deer Hunting
games.description: Jungle Deer Hunting is a first-person shooter game that transports players to an African safari wildlife expedition, casting them within range of a variety of animals ready for the hunt. The objective is simple — shoot down a targeted number of animals throughout a series of landscapes, in some cases, using precision sniper skills.
games.long_description: Jungle Deer Hunting is a first-person shooter game that transports players to an African safari wildlife expedition, casting them within range of a variety of animals ready for the hunt. The objective is simple — shoot down a targeted number of animals throughout a series of landscapes, in some cases, using precision sniper skills. Not to worry, game developers have added targets on many of the animals, making distance shooting slightly more attainable. How to Play Jungle Deer Hunting The game features a series of landscapes and animals to choose from, with unlocked levels that include: Club, Adventure, Dino, and Jeep Hunt. The game is not limited to deer hunting, and you’re not always in a jungle. Depending on the round, the shooter is tasked with hunting down lions, bears, deer, and more wild animals, even dinosaurs. All landscapes equip the shooter with an appropriate weapon, sometimes one of choice. Player’s progress will be tracked with a score card that tallies your rewards and how many animals you’ve hunted. There are also a series of locked levels: Bird Hunt and Pro Hunt. You can get to these levels once you’ve played a select number of levels of the unlocked landscapes. Bonus Holiday Landscape The game features a Christmas Hunt. You don’t need to be in the holiday spirit to unlock this landscape; you just need to have played 10 levels of Club. It’s a locked landscape, so you need to up your skills and game time to spread the holiday cheer here. Tips and Tricks The key to the game is precision and patience. Some of the levels have targets on the animal’s back, particularly for those at a great distance. But don’t rely too much on time being on your side, the tables can turn, as animals might hunt you too. More Games Like This For more shooting games, check out our Shooting category and browse the selection. A few shooting games worth playing are: Bullet Force Multiplayer , an FPS multiplayer battle game; or Duck Hunt , based on the original Nintendo classic. Release Date December 2017 (Android) May 2023 (iOS) March 2024 (WebGL) Platforms Web browser Android iOS

games.title: Winter Clash 3D
games.description: Winter Clash 3D is a Christmas-themed shooting game in the Clash 3D series. You’re fighting on Santa’s team against a gang of disobedient elves.
games.long_description: Winter Clash 3D is a Christmas-themed shooting game in the Clash 3D series. You’re fighting on Santa’s team against a gang of disobedient elves. Rack up as many kills as you can to make it to the top of the leaderboard. How to Play Winter Clash 3D Crush the elf rebellion The game is played on a dock: on one side of it, there is the Santa Claus brigade, to which you belong. On the other side, the elves, and they are rebelling. Both teams need to score points to win in a round timed at nearly 4 minutes. Points are scored by taking down enemies and by rescuing a snowman on an island off the docks and bringing it to the base. You are equipped with a sniper rifle, and it will take 3 or 4 shots to take an elf down unless you hit them in the head for a one-shot kill! Ensure you use the scope for maximum range, which can be easily activated by right-clicking the mouse. Also, make sure to keep your character in constant motion, as this makes it harder for snipers to hit you. Supercharge your Santa Claus Each time you finish a round, you earn points to increase Santa’s power. You can put these points into your health, sniper rifle power, or shotgun power. There are power-ups on the map: you can get the magic boots to have a speed advantage when running around, and health packs can help you staying alive. Earn achievements Slaying elves is a numbers game. Kill an impressive amount of elvish foes to make it to the daily leaderboard. Here, you’ll see the top 10 players for the day. You can also view your achievements, there are nine of them that you can complete as you gain experience, and aim to reach those that are incomplete in the next game. More Games Like This There are many more shooting games like Winter Clash 3D to play on CrazyGames. Check out our FPS game and third-person shooter pages for many more. Popular alternatives with a totally different gameplay include Bubble Shooter and Eggy Car . Features Take down as many elves as you can! Upgrade Santa with more health and weapon power Find power-ups around the maps Invite your friends to join in the action Release Date December 2019 Developer Freeway Interactive developed Winter Clash 3D. games.title: Skillfite.io
games.description: Skillfite.io is an MMORPG adventure battle game set in a large open-world environment with up to 100 players. Prepare yourself for the ultimate survival experience!
games.long_description: Skillfite.io is an MMORPG adventure battle game set in a large open-world environment with up to 100 players. Prepare yourself for the ultimate survival experience! Gather materials, craft powerful gear, and sharpen your skills to dominate in these intense PvP battles. Explore a vast, open world brimming with surprises, hidden treasures, and challenges at every turn. Whether you prefer teaming up with a guild to conquer foes or going solo to prove your mettle, the choice is yours. As you advance, you will build up your abilities, craft deadly weapons, and become a formidable fighter ready to take on anything the world throws! How to Play Skillfite.io Start from scratch Skillfite has many features reminiscent of old-school browser-based MMORPGs like Runescape. Starting as a level 1 noob with no gear or experience, you have to chop trees, mine rocks, and catch fish to level up your skills and sustain yourself during battles with low-level enemies like rabbits. Harvest and craft Use the raw materials you gain from chopping and mining to craft armor for protection and weapons for attack. Early in the game, you can craft gear from the wood you’ve earned, but you can quickly find rocks to mine copper and craft something slightly better. There are 15 resource types in Skillfite.io. Build your skills Level up your skills to reach milestones that unlock better resources. For example, when you reach level 5 wood chopping skills, you can cut down the more giant pinewood trees. It’s worth attacking animals, even peaceful ones, as they drop loot, which can be helpful. Explore various zones There are various zones to explore in Skillfite.io. Teleport around the map and head into non-PvP, PvP, and high-risk PvP areas. In the high-risk PvP areas, you can team up with and fight players of any level. You can initiate trades with players in all zones. More Games Like This If you enjoy playing online multiplayer games, check out our vast collection of adventure games or battle games with popular titles like Battle Arena , a game that seamlessly blends heart-pounding action with strategic gameplay; Mirrorland , a game where you venture into a magical realm filled with heroes, monsters, and puzzles; Firestone Idle RPG , where you fight hordes of Undead and Orc enemies in a party of up to five heroes. Or play more IO games like 1v1 LOL , and Agar.io . Release Date August 2023 Developer Gatarn Games developed Skillfite.io. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Underwater Hunting
games.description: Underwater Hunting is an exciting adventure where you cast your hook to catch a variety of fish. Explore the depths, discover unique species, and test your skills to reel in the most valuable catches.
games.long_description: Underwater Hunting is an exciting adventure where you cast your hook to catch a variety of fish. Explore the depths, discover unique species, and test your skills to reel in the most valuable catches. Every fish you catch earns points, challenging you to become the ultimate underwater angler with strategy and precision. How to Play At the beginning of the game, you choose the direction in which you will put the hook. After the rod enters the water, you can change the direction of the rod by following the movements of the fish. When the hook touches a fish, click quickly to catch the fish. When you catch the fish, your points increase, and you can throw a new rod. There are many types of fish of different sizes and colors in the game. Some fish are more valuable and earn more points, while some fish are less valuable and earn less points. In addition, some fish move faster or slower, while others try to escape from the rod. As the difficulty of the game increases, the movements of the fish become more complex. At the end of the game, you can see the points you have collected and compare them with other players. If you want to play the game again, you can choose a new level or try the same level again. As you play the game, you can learn more about underwater life and improve your fishing skills.

games.title: EvoWars.io
games.description: EvoWars.io is an IO battle game set in a top-down online battle arena. Collect orbs and battle other players to evolve your warrior.
games.long_description: EvoWars.io is an IO battle game set in a top-down online battle arena. Collect orbs and battle other players to evolve your warrior. Each evolution improves your weapon range but slows your movement. How many will you slay before you fall? How to Play EvoWars.io Embark on an epic quest across the digital battlefield, where you’ll collect powerful orbs to evolve your warrior into unstoppable forms. As you slash through enemies with swords, axes, and a brutal arsenal of weapons, each battle pushes you closer to becoming the ultimate warrior. With more than 15 unique character models to unlock, your journey is one of constant evolution and power. You control a constantly advancing warrior with your mouse, swinging your weapon to defeat enemies and collect XP to evolve into stronger forms with bigger weapons and greater attack range. As you play, you'll unlock more evolutions and customize your warrior with different weapons and gear to eliminate all other fighters on the field while growing stronger. As you accumulate points, you will be able to upgrade gameplay dynamics. It will take some time to reach your desired destination. It's not the easiest game to master. The key to this 2D top-down game is winning battles. Each victory allows you to grow stronger, but the battlefield isn’t just about brute strength; you’ll need to define your play style and use every opportunity to outmaneuver your enemies. Whether you’re charging headfirst into combat or taking a more tactical approach, dominance is at your fingertips. There is a very large online community around EvoWars.io and when playing it you'll face opponents from every part of the world: it is particularly popular in Vietnam, where it is one of the most popular browser games. Game modes in EwoWars.io Deatmatch: Free For All, the classic Battle Royale mode where everyone is an enemy Teams: you are part of one of the two teams, either red or blue, and your objective is to defend the team’s Guardian while defeating enemies and, ultimately, the enemy’s Guardian Duel: a 1 vs 1 match with a random opponent. You and they both start at a random level. The first to win three duels wins the match Monster Hunt: a cooperative mode where you and the other players face hordes of AI-controlled monsters Classic: it’s the old version of EvoWars Tips Focus on collecting orbs around the outside of the map when you are at a low level rather than battling against other players. Your weapon range improves as you grow larger, but you also become slower, so remember to remain cautious and alert. When you're smaller, you can move faster; use this to your advantage and play more evasively at lower levels Features Intense slashing gameplay to eliminate opponents You can level up to increase the size and evolve to more than 15 character models Define your play style and use every opportunity as much as possible Sprint ability at the cost of your experience points More IO game action If you like EvoWars, make sure to try our other smash hit .io games , such as Agar.io , and ZombsRoyale.io . If you are up for something different, try Sprunki or Friday Night Funkin' , instead. Release Date March 2018 Developer Night Steed Games made EvoWars.io. games.title: Worms.Zone
games.description: Worms Zone is an Io arcade game where you join the fight to become the biggest worm. You must eat as much food as possible to grow bigger.
games.long_description: Worms Zone is an Io arcade game where you join the fight to become the biggest worm. You must eat as much food as possible to grow bigger. Slither your way towards the power-ups to get an edge. How to Play Worms Zone WormsZone.io is survival of the fittest. You're a worm, and you must eat and grow to be big and strong. Who knew being a worm could be so much fun? Try to trap your opponents so you can get all of their delicious food. Pressing the left or right mouse button allows you to turbo-speed your worm. Use it sparingly and tactically to sprint ahead of the other players and secure big rewards, but be advised: the more you use your turbo, the faster your worm shrinks. As you get larger, you get slower. Turbo also becomes more costly for your score, so use it sparingly when you are big and plentifully when you are small. Be aware that upgrades you can buy in the menu don't make your worm perform better in the arena, but improve the effectiveness and/or duration of the power-ups found while playing, so don't be tricked by those. Worm Outfits Go to the wardrobe and pick an outfit fitting for the common worm. As you level up in the game, you can treat your worm to funkier and more colorful designs. Head to the worm's wardrobe on the main menu to pick a fresh new outfit. Game Options Head to the options menu to choose your favorite colors for the game. You can also pick between 3 different food types. You can find the options menu at the bottom right of the main menu. Game Modes There are various game modes to choose from. These are: Infinity - Keep playing and growing your worm until you fail. Time - a 7-minute game featuring double points and coins Treasure Hunter - Look for treasures on the map Seasonal - these are time-limited modes that appear during seasonal periods of the year Power-ups Keep your eye out for power-ups in potion bottles scattered around the arena. There are six types of power-ups in Worms Zone: Red and blue - Increase capture radius and pull in more food. Blue - Increase the amount of food eaten by five times. Purple - Reveal where other worms have perished. Green - Increase the speed of your worm. Round green - Improves control of the worm for collision avoidance. Yellow - Zoom out for a bird-eye view of the map. You'll figure out what these power-ups look like as you slither through the land. You can also pick up coins that go into your coin stash. games.title: Slither.io
games.description: Slither.io is a popular .io snake game. You must grow your snake by consuming multi-colored orbs in a giant multiplayer arena.
games.long_description: Slither.io is a popular .io snake game. You must grow your snake by consuming multi-colored orbs in a giant multiplayer arena. Avoid other snakes to avoid becoming snake food, or take other players down by forcing them to crash into your side. How to Play Slither Do you like snakes? It's cool if you don't, because these snakes are no threat to you. The players controlling the snakes, though... They'll try to get you. Enjoy this twist on the classic snake genre with Slither.io! Like the classic game Snake that was available on cell phones and computers for decades, you grow by eating small pellets. But Slither.io introduces a multiplayer element that changes the playing field entirely. Eat and Grow The glowing orbs are your key to sustenance. By eating them, you increase the snake's size and gain more energy for boosting. The bigger the snake, the better your chance of trapping other snakes You start the game small, so don't try taking on the big boys until you've grown more powerful. Work on the strategy of eating and avoiding until you've acquired enough size to take on smaller snakes. Boost Your Speed Boost is an important feature, but it comes at the cost of your size. This method can be used when you are racing against snakes, once you have the perfect spot near the opponent's head, make a sudden cut to eliminate it. Use the boost wisely to ensure you get maximum value for the cost. Special Orbs Besides the regular orbs that are widely available around the map, there are two special orbs. When a snake dies, they drop all of their glowing pellets. The bigger the snake that falls, the more plentiful the harvest. Finding these orbs can grow your snake quickly. The other special orbs can occasionally be found floating around the arena. These floating orbs will run away if you chase them, but they are worth more than the average dots around, so it may be worth pursuing. Capture Other Snakes Once you acquire an adequate size, you can circle smaller snakes, trapping them and tightening your grip, much like a regular snake would. If your size becomes gargantuan, you can even catch a multitude of small snakes, leading to their inevitable demise and more nourishment for you! Similar Games There are other games similar to Slither.io, and it comes down to preference which games you like best. Check out some of the other snake io games: Worms Zone - same game mechanics with a different feel, graphics, and unique features. Paper.io 2 - a unique twist on snake, which involves expanding territory instead of growing a worm or snake! Features Decorate your worm using one of 12 different skins Raw, competitive gameplay with various play styles With millions of players worldwide, there's no shortage of matches Colorful, neon graphics bring your snake to life Platforms Slither.io is available through a web browser, Android, and iOS. Developer Slither.io was developed by Steve Howse, a developer from Michigan who had previously developed Circle Push and Flappy 2048 Extreme. His company is Lowtech Studios. Release Date March 2016

games.title: Splatmans
games.description: Splatmans is a casual 2-player shooting game where two stickmen duke it out in a colorful arena. Your goal in this third-person shooter game is to cover as much ground as possible before time runs out.
games.long_description: Splatmans is a casual 2-player shooting game where two stickmen duke it out in a colorful arena. Your goal in this third-person shooter game is to cover as much ground as possible before time runs out. Battle it out with the computer or play against a friend in a competitive match filled with colorful chaos. With unique paint types, diverse game modes, and rapid-fire action, Splatmans delivers an exciting and highly competitive experience that will keep you and your friends on your toes! How to Play Splatmans Your goal in Splatman is to outmaneuver and defeat your opponents in a tight arena by ambushing them with high-speed paint blasts from your weapon. You start by choosing the number of players on your team—you can go solo or team up with a partner, both playing from the same keyboard. If you're feeling bold, you can even control both characters yourself to double the challenge! Once you enter the arena, don't stay in one spot for too long. Like any great arena game, offense is key, so keep moving to gain the upper hand. Try to corner your opponents, but remember—staying on the move makes you a harder target. If you find yourself on the defensive, use obstacles in the center of the arena to avoid direct hits. Customize your gameplay by upgrading to new paint colors or more powerful paint guns. As you accumulate rewards and points, you'll unlock better equipment, with upgrades starting at 2,000 coins. It may take a few games to build up enough currency, but the right upgrades can significantly boost your chances of victory. Keep an eye on key stats like health, damage, and rate of fire to see where you might need an upgrade. If your fire rate is slowing you down, consider investing in a faster, more powerful paint gun to dominate the competition! More Games Like This We have an extensive catalog of casual games , so the fun never has to end. A few games you may like if you enjoyed playing Splatmans include Snow Rider , where you try to get to the end of a mountain track while avoiding trees and obstacles of all type; Go Chicken Go , a bit of casual fun helping a bunch of chickens cross a road, or more specifically a highway; or Doodle Jump , where you jump upwards towards infinity. Release Date July 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Idle Vlogger Simulator
games.description: Idle Blogger Simulator is a clicker simulation game where you are the rising star as a digital creator, ready to take on the internet—all from behind your desk! You get to choose quirky channel themes like hilarious meme breakdowns or classic heartwarming cat videos and upgrade your gear to produce top-notch content, even better cat videos.
games.long_description: Idle Blogger Simulator is a clicker simulation game where you are the rising star as a digital creator, ready to take on the internet—all from behind your desk! You get to choose quirky channel themes like hilarious meme breakdowns or classic heartwarming cat videos and upgrade your gear to produce top-notch content, even better cat videos. Sharpen your skills, team up with viral stars, and watch your fanbase as you become an influencer extraordinaire. Your goal is to reach the coveted 1 billion subscribers and become the ultimate online sensation. How to Play Idle Blogger Simulator You start your blogging journey in Idle Blogger Simulator by customizing your channel with a catchy name (or not so catchy) and unique avatar. Once you have these basics down, it's time to create. The objective is to create as many videos as possible. You are given themes for your videos—whether it’s gaming, lifestyle, the latest trends, or cats—and are given prompts to decide how what to focus on most in your video. You get to adjust the type of content you want to emphasize but be warned; your base followers will grow depending on whether you find that perfect sweet spot. Each theme has specific requirements, so think strategically to make your content shine. Once your video is published, it will start collecting views, but the key to success is consistency—the more videos you create, the faster your fanbase and income grow. Invest in upgrades to boost views and subscribers as your channel gains popularity. Unlock new features like advanced video equipment, fresh locations to blog from, and even additional avatars to represent your growing brand. Pay attention to trends, as trending topics generate the most buzz and help you attract hordes of new followers. You’ll get prompts like "a famous blogger giving your channel a shoutout or a brand offering a sponsorship deal after you mention their product." These opportunities can significantly boost your views and earnings, which will help you grow and eventually help you hire a crew, including scriptwriters, managers, and PR experts, to help take your channel to the next level. Other prompts include: "In one of your recent videos, you mentioned a headphone that you use yourself. You were contacted by a representative of the company and offered money." Take the money and keep the amazing conversation with your viewers going! Keep the momentum going by creating and publishing videos regularly. With each step, you’ll unlock new tools, rewards, and challenges that make the journey to internet stardom become more of a reality. Don't forget your friends when you make it to the top. Tip: Follow the trends because trending videos are the ones that get the most subscribers! More Games Like This Clicker games can be quite addictive thanks to their simple yet fun gameplay. Try some of our more popular clicker games like Planet Clicker , where you click to power up, upgrade your tech, and light up the galaxy one planet at a time; Mr Mine , an idle mining clicker arcade game that puts you in charge of building a mining empire from the ground up; or I dle Breakout , puts you in charge of building a mining empire from the ground up.

games.title: Dogs vs Aliens
games.description: Dogs vs Aliens is a casual cute simulation game where your beloved pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens. It's time to rescue them and fight back!
games.long_description: Dogs vs Aliens is a casual cute simulation game where your beloved pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens. It's time to rescue them and fight back! Evolve your dogs to defeat stronger enemies, free new companions, and collect unique resources to power up your furry defenders. To win the game, you need to save all the pets and send the aliens back to the Moon! Can you save all the dogs and defeat the alien invaders? How to Play Dogs vs Aliens In Dogs vs Aliens, a peaceful day at the park is shattered when aliens invade and steal your beloved dog, along with other pets. Your mission is to rescue your dog and stop the alien menace from taking over. As you set out on your journey, you’ll be joined by your loyal canine companion, who will automatically attack any nearby aliens, ensuring you’re never alone in the fight. To progress through the levels, you'll need to defeat all the aliens in your path to unlock gates and move on to the next area. The game offers a variety of upgrades to help you and your dog become more effective in battle. Using the rewards you earn, you can enhance your dog's abilities, such as increasing the attack range with a longer leash, improving your running speed, or expanding your backpack to carry more items. Additionally, you can upgrade to unlock a group attack feature, where multiple dogs can team up to take down enemies. As you level up, your dog can evolve into a stronger, more powerful warrior, ready to face the toughest aliens. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter different quests that add depth to the storyline. One important mission involves helping a translator understand the alien language, which requires capturing five aliens to bring back for translation. The game features a range of alien enemies, each with its own quirks and weaknesses, and you’ll face mighty alien bosses in epic battles. As you progress, you’ll explore diverse locations like the beach, park, city square, and forest. You’ll also have the opportunity to collect a variety of dog breeds, including German Shepherds, Huskies, and Dobermans, and watch them evolve into powerful animal warriors ready to take on even the most formidable alien forces. Features Dog Evolution – Watch your puppies transform into powerful animal warriors. Exciting Quests & Storyline – Unravel the island’s mystery and complete fun tasks. Unique Alien Enemies – Face off against a variety of quirky extraterrestrial foes. Mighty Alien Bosses – Prepare for epic battles against powerful bosses. Expansive World – Explore diverse locations like the beach, park, city square, and forest. Huge Variety of Breeds – Collect and evolve German Shepherds, Huskies, Dobermans, and more! More Games Like This There are plenty of casual games to keep you entertained. Choose from our vast collection with some of our more popular games like Friday Night Funkin , a musical rhythm game where you compete in freestyle music battles; Blob Opera , a game that uses a machine learning model trained on real voices to make it easy for anyone to create amazing operatic music; Snow Rider 3D , a game where the player’s goal is to drive a boblsed through a dangerous path on snowy mountains.

games.title: Playground
games.description: Playground is an action sandbox game where creativity meets destruction in an open-ended cubic sandbox! Whether you’re building grand cities, orchestrating epic battles, or just causing mayhem, the possibilities are endless!
games.long_description: Playground is an action sandbox game where creativity meets destruction in an open-ended cubic sandbox! Whether you’re building grand cities, orchestrating epic battles, or just causing mayhem, the possibilities are endless! What will you build or destroy first? How to Play Playground You start playing Playground by adding characters to your game. Click on the heart icon to choose from a variety of characters, including male and female zombies, male and female humans, pigs, and even hybrid characters like zombie-pigs. Some special characters can only be unlocked through upgrade rewards. Next, click on the gun icon to access a wide range of weapons. You'll find everything from handguns and rifles to chainsaws, shovels, machine guns, and more. For heavier firepower, click on the grenade icon. Here you’ll find high-impact weapons like dynamite, grenades, rockets, and other powerful explosives that can help you survive tougher waves. Need to set up some defenses? Click on the cement block icon to browse materials for building protective walls. Options include bricks, grass, wood, asphalt, and other building elements. Click on the shirt icon to gear up. Equip helmets, protective vests, and other armor to boost your survival chances. The wooden crate icon opens up a collection of useful props like emergency cones, tables, chairs, computers, armoires, and more: perfect for customizing your environment or creating obstacles. Use the map icon to navigate the playground and plan your strategy. Gameplay Tip: When zombies touch humans, the humans turn into zombies, so position yourself wisely and keep your weapon ready. Your goal is to eliminate the threat and make your way across the playground as quickly and efficiently as possible. More Games Like This There are plenty more action games where this one came from! Explore our action category for titles like Jacksmith , a crafting game where you forge weapons and battle alongside soldiers to defeat monsters, or Duck Life , where you train a duckling to become an elite athlete and earn money to rebuild a farm. You may also like Bloons Tower Defense , a casual game where your sole mission is to build your defenses to stop a wave of colorful balloons from reaching the end of the track.

games.long_description: PolyBusiness is a real-estate board game that follows the same format and rules as Monopoly Online. Buy cities and battle your friends for market dominance. Develop your properties to expand influence, bankrupt your friends, and create the ultimate Monopoly. Strive to Monopolize PolyBusiness follows the Monopoly formula we all either love or hate. Roll the dice and move your piece around the board. Manage your finances, choose your spots carefully, and avoid going bankrupt! Buy locations Purchase cities that charge other players when they land on them. There are also utilities and public services that increase your earnings. The colored arrow on a location indicates which player owns it. Develop properties When you buy all locations of the same color, you can develop properties that drastically increase your income when other players land on them. Trade and negotiate Got something your opponent might be interested in? Negotiate mutually beneficial trades with them. Monopolize Europe PolyBusiness features cities from several European destinations. Greece, Italy, Spain, Benelux, Sweden, Germany, Austria, and England. Just like Monopoly, the value of these properties increases the further you get around the board. Brief History of Monopoly The original concept was created in roughly 1903 by American anti-monopolist Lizzie Magie, though she is widely uncredited for it. The game was called Landlord’s Game and was intended to illustrate the negative aspect of concentrating land in private monopolies. Several variants of the game were produced thereafter, the most famous version being Monopoly, which was commercialized by Charles Darrow in 1933. games.title: Autumn Glam Gala
games.description: Get ready to light up the season with Autumn Glam Gala, a beauty makeup game, the ultimate fashion and makeup experience! Transform three besties into autumn-style icons for the gala of the year.
games.long_description: Get ready to light up the season with Autumn Glam Gala, a beauty makeup game, the ultimate fashion and makeup experience! Transform three besties into autumn-style icons for the gala of the year. Immerse yourself in a world of beauty, where every choice—whether it’s soft, earthy tones or bold, golden sparkles—captures the magic of fall. Mix and match an array of luxurious makeup shades, chic hairstyles, and dazzling outfits to craft show-stopping looks. Embrace the season’s hottest trends, flex your makeup artist skills, and watch your creations shine under the gala lights. How to Play Autumn Glam Gala Autumn Glam Gala invites you to style and dazzle for the ultimate Fall event! Available in five languages—English, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Portuguese—this game is your chance to be the ultimate stylist for a glamorous evening. Three girls are counting on you to help them shine at the gala. Start with makeup, where bold, autumn-inspired choices take center stage. One of your clients, Olivia, loves sparkles, while others lean towards radiant gold looks. Experiment with eyeshadow in warm fall hues like brown, wine, or deep reds. Add precision with a matching lip liner, then finish the perfect pout with shades of red, blush, or wine lipstick. Don’t forget mascara to make those eyes pop! Next, head to the wardrobe to craft the ultimate ensemble. Whether it’s a diamond-studded blazer, a sequined off-the-shoulder top, or a cozy striped knit, pick a look that complements their makeup flawlessly. Accessorize with bracelets, from glittering diamond bands to bold gold cuffs, and choose earrings—will they be dangling diamonds or vibrant jewel tones? Every detail counts! As you dress each girl, watch the heart barometer fill with approval. But don’t stop there! You can keep mixing and matching outfits, makeup, and accessories until your creativity knows no bounds. Once all three girls are runway-ready, it’s photo time. Capture solo shots of each look and a stunning group picture to commemorate their autumn elegance. Get ready to unleash your inner stylist and make this gala a night to remember! More Games Like This Dressing up is fun, and it can get even more fun and wackier when you are dressing up your very own pet. There are plenty more dress-up games in our beauty category . If you prefer to be more creative when it comes to glam looks, you can also explore our makeup category .

games.title: GRWM Date Night
games.description: GRWM Date Night is a stylish beauty fashion game where you help Ellie prepare for her romantic evening. Create the perfect makeup look, pick glamorous outfits, and accessorize to match her vibe.
games.long_description: GRWM Date Night is a stylish beauty fashion game where you help Ellie prepare for her romantic evening. Create the perfect makeup look, pick glamorous outfits, and accessorize to match her vibe. After the date, join Ellie for her relaxing night routine: remove her makeup, choose cozy pajamas, and get her ready for beauty sleep. Romance and self-care await! How to Play GRWM Date Night Ooh la la, it’s date night, and you’re about to get glam for a fabulous evening out! Let’s kick things off with your beauty routine. Start by perfecting your makeup: apply your foundation and blush, then move on to curling your lashes and adding a swipe of long-lasting mascara. Choose your lipstick: will you go natural or bold? It’s your night, your style! The better you look, the higher your "heart barometer" will rise, and once it’s high enough, you’ll be ready to move to the next round of prep. Now, onto the outfit and hairstyle! Choose from a sleek one-piece jumpsuit, a chic off-the-shoulder dress, or a sultry silk mini; there are endless options to experiment with. Complete your ensemble with accessories like jewelry, shoes, handbags, and more. How will you wear your hair? Straight, short, wavy? Try them all and find your perfect look! After your night out, it’s time to wind down with a skincare routine. Remove your makeup, cleanse, scrub, and apply serum and eye packs to leave your skin glowing. Finally, get cozy in your PJs: will it be comfy joggers or a chic silk short set? Add fun accessories like a headpiece, eye mask, phone, toothbrush, and some fuzzy slippers for the ultimate night-in vibe. Don’t forget to snap a photo of your stunning looks, download them, and share them with your friends! More Games Like This Discover similar beauty games you may not have played before! If you’re in the mood for casual games , check out fan favorites like Pop It , a satisfying arcade game where you pop bubbles in fun and unique character shapes!

games.title: Merge Restaurant
games.description: Merge Restaurant is a casual food game in which you are responsible for preparing a restaurant that’s not in the best shape for opening. Redesign and transform it from a neglected space to the hottest spot in town.
games.long_description: Merge Restaurant is a casual food game in which you are responsible for preparing a restaurant that’s not in the best shape for opening. Redesign and transform it from a neglected space to the hottest spot in town. How to Play Merge Restaurant Your name is Mina, and you've got a new job. You’re in charge of a restaurant that is in a fantastic location, so it has a ton of potential, but it is in disarray as it was once shut down by a "strange man" and abandoned for some time. The only hitch is that this new restaurant is in worse shape than you thought, so you need to put in significant effort to clean it up. How do you clean up the restaurant? Merge Restaurant is an interactive merge game in which you combine objects to create new ones or to restore or clean them up. It’ll take some time to get this place back in shape and ready for customers, but that is your challenge. All the restaurant needs is your loving touch to breathe life back into it. You will need to wash tables, dust, replace furniture, and revamp the menu, all by merging items within the restaurant using your left mouse to click and drag. You merge to get what you need. Since the restaurant requires a lot of clean-up, you will get quite a few sponges to merge. Keep combining so you get even more useful items. The more you combine, the more unique and practical items will appear. Once you get your first restaurant in shape, you can move on to bigger and better restaurants and use your pro skills while you follow roller coaster love stories of the "strange man" who seemingly wants to shut your restaurant down. games.title: Outlets Rush
games.description: Outlets Rush is a time-management casual arcade game where you become the master of your own shopping empire. Build and expand various stores, manage staff, and make strategic decisions to keep customers happy.
games.long_description: Outlets Rush is a time-management casual arcade game where you become the master of your own shopping empire. Build and expand various stores, manage staff, and make strategic decisions to keep customers happy. Enjoy watching your mini outlets grow into massive retail hubs as you effortlessly manage operations and maximize profits! Dive into the excitement of creating your ultimate shopping destination! How to Play Outlets Rush Are you ready to run a high-speed retail empire? Outlets Rush puts you center stage as a manager of a shopping mall. Your task is to build each shop, starting with Neki, a sports shop, from the bottom up. Start with a sneaker shop, stocking shelves straight from the warehouse as shipments roll in. Keep up with demand by quickly restocking and rushing to the counter to check out eager customers because the line isn’t getting any shorter! As you rack up earnings, reinvest in your store. Expand with new shelves for sneakers and T-shirts, unlock skateboards for faster movement, and balance stocking with customer service to maximize profits. Want to work smarter, not harder? Open an HR office to hire staff or upgrade your speed and capacity to keep the store running smoothly. With the right strategy, you’ll be filling shelves faster, making more money, and scaling up operations. Once your shop is thriving, expand your business! Earn enough stars to unlock new stores and become a retail tycoon. But be careful: each new shop requires careful management to run independently before you move on. More Games Like This Ready for more fun? Browse our casual game collection for more gameplay. Try titles like Frogger , a good old-fashioned game where you help your frog reach safety; Papa’s Pizzeria , a challenging game where you manage a pizza shop and have to take and deliver orders; Snow Rider 3D , where you need to handle a sled on a snowy downhill while avoiding lots of obstacles.

controls.Controls: Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI Use the WASD or arrow keys to move

games.title: Food Truck Chef™: A Fun Cooking Game
games.description: Food Truck Chef is a thrilling casual food game where you travel the globe, cooking iconic dishes from tacos to sushi. Manage your time, upgrade your kitchen, and serve customers to build your food truck empire.
games.long_description: Food Truck Chef is a thrilling casual food game where you travel the globe, cooking iconic dishes from tacos to sushi. Manage your time, upgrade your kitchen, and serve customers to build your food truck empire. With hundreds of levels and vibrant locations, you’ll face exciting challenges that test your skills as a master chef! How to Play Food Truck Chef Food Truck Chef is a fast-paced, fun, and addictive cooking game in which you manage your food truck and serve delicious dishes to customers on the go. There are plenty of places to choose from, all with similar gameplay styles. The pasta street food truck journey is a popular location to begin, and as you progress, you can unlock Pizza Street, Tex Mex Street, Sandwich Street, and more! The first thing you need to do is complete your training with Chef Sarah. You’ll learn the basics of the game, starting with your first customer. A customer orders pasta with red sauce. Plate the pasta, add the red sauce, place it on the counter, take the money, and voilà, your first order is complete! Your next customer wants a caffeine fix, so make sure to serve the coffee immediately after it’s filled so it’s nice and hot. After your training, you’re ready to run your pasta food truck! Keep cooking and serving to build up your experience and earn rewards. You earn coins and XP for completing orders, serving customers, and upgrading your kitchen. Fill the XP bar to level up and unlock rewards like coins and gems. You can watch ads to double your coins, which is crucial for buying new kitchen equipment and supplies. Use your coins to buy better kitchen equipment. New pans (600 coins), new plates (400 coins), and an espresso machine (600 coins) will help you serve customers faster. Remember to collect tips after serving customers. If you don't, new customers won’t show up! Get the hot plate as soon as possible to keep your sauces warm and serve dishes quickly. As you advance, you’ll unlock more additions to your dishes, like adding olives, cheese, and more to your pasta. Keep earning points, buying new equipment, and watching your food truck flourish with happy customers! New recipes will also be introduced. The white sauce, for example, burns easily if you don’t keep an eye on it, adding an extra challenge to your cooking! Game Tip To keep up with demand, have warm dishes prepped and ready to serve incoming guests. Always keep a close eye on your cooking times, especially for recipes that burn quickly. More Games Like This Other fun casual titles worth a try include Tile Guru , a casual puzzle game where you match vibrant 3D tiles in this relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle game; Merge Restaurant , a merge game where you match similar items to build your restaurant empire; or Blob Opera , is a game where you explore the world of opera by dragging and tuning blobs that sing using AI-trained voices.

controls.Controls: Use the Left Mouse Button to interact.

games.title: Pizza Maker
games.description: Pizza Maker is a casual food game and culinary adventure where you create delicious pizzas from scratch. Select the pizza you want, gather the ingredients, slice vegetables, shred cheese, and prepare the toppings.
games.long_description: Pizza Maker is a casual food game and culinary adventure where you create delicious pizzas from scratch. Select the pizza you want, gather the ingredients, slice vegetables, shred cheese, and prepare the toppings. Get ready for a culinary feast and have fun! Knead the dough, spread the sauce, and bake to golden perfection. Master 15 unique recipes and deliver delicious pizzas with perfectly melted cheese and crispy crusts. How to Play Pizza Maker The gameplay in Pizza Maker is fairly simple. It is a one-button casual game where success is measured by how much fun you have playing. The game's objective is to get through several stages of cooking until your pizza is cooked and ready to serve. Shop for Ingredients You will need ingredients to make pizza, so the game begins by shopping for them. All necessary ingredients will be on a shelf. You must take the ingredients from the shelf and add them to your cart. Prepare the Ingredients In this step, you will slice tomatoes, pick basil, shred the cheese, and more. This is all the work involved in preparing the ingredients for making pizza. Make the Sauce This is where you unscrew the tomato jar and add it to a pan with water, oil, and salt. Shake the salt, stir, and pour all the ingredients into a bowl. Roll the Dough Mix flour, water, and salt. Lay the dough flat on the table and roll it out to form a pizza crust. Add Toppings Add all toppings onto your rolled pizza dough, including tomato, cheese, and whatever other ingredients you are working with. Bake the Pizza Place the pizza in a pizza oven and let it cook away. It will cook faster if you click your left mouse button fast enough. More Games Like This If you enjoy casual one-button games, there are plenty more to try! In Geometry Dash , navigate challenging levels filled with obstacles by tapping to jump. For a different experience, Slice Master lets you slice through various objects with precision and timing. Other casual games you may like if you like Pizza Maker are popular titles like Blob Opera , a musical game, and Love Tester , where you get a glimpse into Cupid's forecasts. Release Date June 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

controls.Controls: Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI as you follow the on-screen prompts and voice instructions.
